ds1.name: Baby Flame
ds1.desc: Spits a fiery breath from its mouth to attack the opponent.

ds6.name: Baby Burner
ds6.desc: Accumulates Baby Flame in its mouth and then spits it out all at once as a much more powerful blast.

ds7.name: Triple Baby Flame
ds7.desc: Rapidly fires three different Baby Flames in three different directions.

ds8.name: Battle Hawk
ds8.desc: Brandishes an axe made of Chrome Digizoid.

ds9.name: Aerial Baby Flame
ds9.desc: The Baby Flame unleashed while airborne.

ds10.name: Mach Jab
ds10.desc: Rapidly jabs or slashes the opponent with the claws of both hands.

ds11.name: Mach Jab Combo
ds11.desc: Rushes the enemy with many rapid slashes with the claws of both hands.

ds12.name: Dynamite Kick
ds12.desc: A flurry of kicks in midair.

ds13.name: Uppercut
ds13.desc: A flaming uppercut with its claws.

ds14.name: Agumon Dive
ds14.desc: Jumps at the enemy and slams its claws down on them.

ds15.name: Wild Whip
ds15.desc: Hits the enemy with an upward swing of both hands.

ds16.name: Final Claw
ds16.desc: Jumps and slashes a falling enemy with the claws of both hands.

ds18.name: Aerial Mach Jab
ds18.desc: Rapidly jabs the enemy with its claws while both Digimon are in midair.

ds19.name: Spinning Needle
ds19.desc: Shoots needle-shaped vacuum blades from its wings.

ds20.name: God Tornado
ds20.desc: Breathes out a tornado of flame or wind from its mouth.

ds21.name: Wing Cutter
ds21.desc: Flaps its wings and sends blades of air at the enemy.

ds22.name: Tail Whip
ds22.desc: Creates a bubble of air around the tip of his tail and then slings it at the foe.

ds23.name: Big Jaw
ds23.desc: Takes a big bite using its big jaw.

ds24.name: Tornado
ds24.desc: Creates a tornado by flapping its wings.

ds25.name: Megalo Spark
ds25.desc: Fires a sphere of electrical energy.

ds26.name: Heaven's Knuckle
ds26.desc: Strikes the opponent with its fist shining gold. Gathers holy power in its fist and shoots a beam of holy light from it.

ds27.name: Holy Rod
ds27.desc: Hits the opponent with its glowing Holy Rod.

ds28.name: God Typhoon
ds28.desc: Spins its Holy Rod and/or itself to create a tornado.

ds29.name: Angel Slam
ds29.desc: Uses its Holy Rod to pick up an enemy and slam them into the ground.

ds30.name: Staff Sweep
ds30.desc: Trips the opponent with its Holy Rod.

ds31.name: Halo Attack
ds31.desc: Spins through the air swinging its Holy Rod.

ds32.name: Glide
ds32.desc: Flaps its wings in the air to slow its descent.

ds33.name: Holy Shot
ds33.desc: Fires a bullet of holy energy from its spinning rod.

ds34.name: Electric Shock
ds34.desc: Discharges an electric current emitted from its body that is over a million volts, striking the opponent.

ds35.name: Beta Slugger
ds35.desc: Removes the sharp fin from its back and shoots it like a boomerang.

ds36.name: Cutter Fin
ds36.desc: Somersaults through the air while slicing at the foe.

ds37.name: Water Tower
ds37.desc: Causes a geyser of water to erupt from underneath the foe.

ds39.name: Meteor Wing
ds39.desc: Flaps its wings and rains down fireballs from the air.

ds40.name: Fire Flap
ds40.desc: Flaps its wings, releasing a wave of fire. Burns the enemy with a dive-bomb attack.

ds41.name: Mach Glide
ds41.desc: Dives from the sky and rams into the enemy.

ds43.name: Bir-Flame
ds43.desc: Breathes a stream of fire from its mouth.

ds45.name: Phoenix Rise
ds45.desc: Shoots up into the air while flaming.

ds46.name: Talon Tear
ds46.desc: Attacks from the air with its talons.

ds47.name: Acid Bubbles
ds47.desc: Shoots bubble-like substances from its mouth.

ds48.name: Bubbles
ds48.desc: Spits out bubbles from its mouth.

ds49.name: Spinning Tail Cyclone
ds49.desc: Spins its tail, propelling it towards the enemy.

ds50.name: Death Arrow
ds50.desc: Fires a shot from its mouth.

ds52.name: Death Beam
ds52.desc: Fires a beam from its mouth.

ds53.name: Death Claw
ds53.desc: Pierces its opponent with both of its extensible arms and enforces its will on their body.

ds54.name: Leather Wing
ds54.desc: Flaps its wings to fire destructive energy from them, summon a dark tornado, or crush enemies with air pressure.

ds55.name: Hell Contract
ds55.desc: Sends a cloud of cursed Digimoji at the enemy or summons up a cursed contract to confuse them.

ds56.name: Deadly Nail
ds56.desc: Scratches using the nails on both hands.

ds57.name: Demon's Ray
ds57.desc: Radiates dark energy from its hands.

ds58.name: Sparkling Thunder
ds58.desc: Shoots a powerful bolt of lightning.

ds59.name: Body Blow
ds59.desc: Rushes at the enemy and body slams it.

ds60.name: Nine Tails
ds60.desc: Flips at the enemy and slaps it with its tail.

ds61.name: Thunder Knife
ds61.desc: Sends a barrage of small blades of electricity at the foe.

ds63.name: Little Horn
ds63.desc: Stabs the enemy with the horn on its head. Charges glowing energy in its horn to lengthen it, then slashes upwards with it.

ds66.name: Machine Gun Jab
ds66.desc: Continual throws punches at the foe.

ds67.name: Drill Horn
ds67.desc: Jumps into the air and attacks with horn by spinning.

ds68.name: Drill Horn Special
ds68.desc: Jumps into the air and attacks with horn by spinning over a long distance.

ds69.name: Crush Nail
ds69.desc: Unleashes a combo attack with its claws.

ds70.name: Fire Waltz Sword
ds70.desc: Empowers Igamon's sword with its Petit Fire to unleash a fiery slash.

ds72.name: Gabumon Shot
ds72.desc: Emits a small blast from the mouth.

ds73.name: Beast Attack
ds73.desc: Attacks the opponent with a swift blow of a powerful beast.

ds74.name: Petit Fire Hook
ds74.desc: Punches with its hand full of Petit Fire.

ds76.name: Blue Cyclone
ds76.desc: Spins around while spitting out blue fire from its mouth.

ds78.name: Upperclaw
ds78.desc: Knocks the enemy into the air with an upward swing of the claws on both hands.

ds79.name: Smiley Bomb
ds79.desc: Fires its hand at the enemy as an explosive bomb.

ds81.name: One-Two Rush
ds81.desc: A combo of punches and kicks ending in a glowing uppercut.

ds82.name: Buster Dive
ds82.desc: Leaps into the air and body slams the enemy.

ds83.name: Burning Fist
ds83.desc: Flares up its arms and either punches the opponent or throws one or more fireballs. In Digimon Masters, flares up its entire body to burn the opponent.

ds84.name: Magma Bomb
ds84.desc: Emits magma rocks that rain upon its opponents, or throws one large, explosive rock.

ds86.name: Heat Knuckle
ds86.desc: Punches the enemy, sending heat through them.

ds88.name: Giga Destroyer
ds88.desc: Fires missiles from the hatch on part of its chest.

ds89.name: Metal Slash
ds89.desc: It uses its left arm to slash the enemy.

ds90.name: Revenge Flame
ds90.desc: Unleashes a wave of fire from its Trident Arm.

ds94.name: Trident Arm
ds94.desc: Launches its Trident Arm, which is attached to a cable.

ds95.name: Energy Bomb
ds95.desc: Shoots a destructive energy blast from the Psycho Blaster.

ds96.name: Magnet Beam
ds96.desc: Fires a beam from its Psycho Blaster that causes a fiery explosion.

ds98.name: Shaft Spike
ds98.desc: Slashes the enemy with its claws.

ds100.name: Lovely Attack
ds100.desc: Shoots hearts that that can incapacitate the opponent or make them happy.

ds101.name: Boom Boom Punch
ds101.desc: Punches with a glowing paw, or smacks an enemy multiple times with both paws.

ds102.name: Silence Hug
ds102.desc: Grabs the foe with both paws.

ds103.name: Love Song
ds103.desc: Charms the enemy with a song filled with love.

ds104.name: Lovely Charm
ds104.desc: Similar to Lovely Attack, it radiates hearts that soothe the enemy, weakening their attacks.

ds105.name: Hug of Love
ds105.desc: Heals someone with a loving hug.

ds107.name: Poop
ds107.desc: Throws its own poop in order to defend itself against intruders.

ds108.name: Poop Throw
ds108.desc: Throws its own excrement towards the enemy.

ds109.name: Long-range Poop Throw
ds109.desc: Throws its poop over a long distance.

ds110.name: Continuous Poop Throw
ds110.desc: Throws poop at the enemy continuously.

ds111.name: Face Down Super Kick
ds111.desc: Swings to face backwards, then attacks with a dirty kick.

ds112.name: Super Stinky Spray
ds112.desc: Burps out toxic gas at the foe.

ds113.name: Unpleasant Tongue
ds113.desc: Licks the enemy in a disgusting way.

ds115.name: Fire Breath
ds115.desc: Spews deep crimson flames that are the same color as its body.

ds116.name: Slash Nail
ds116.desc: Slashes the opponent with its sharp and powerful claws.

ds119.name: Devil's Blown Kiss
ds119.desc: Blows a kiss at the opponent that causes them to panic. Blows a kiss that summons planetoids and asteroids to hurl at the opponent.

ds121.name: Mutilate
ds121.desc: Mysteriously damages the opponent by dancing under multicolored spotlights. Shocks the opponent with a mysterious light from its hand.

ds122.name: Hold Beam
ds122.desc: Fires a ray from its gun that prevents the enemy from evolving.

ds123.name: Sharp Leaf
ds123.desc: Throws sharpened leaves from its head at the enemy.

ds124.name: Sweet Breath
ds124.desc: Breathes out sweet-smelling pollen to confuse enemy.

ds125.name: Branch Drain
ds125.desc: Pierces the opponent with its arm and absorbs their life-force.

ds126.name: Jet Arrow
ds126.desc: Spurts out an ultra-high pressure blast of water from its blowhole.

ds127.name: Mouth-Clamping Attack
ds127.desc: Grabs the enemy using its huge mouth.

ds128.name: Giganto Press
ds128.desc: Leaps up and body slams the foe.

ds129.name: Tidal Wave

ds130.name: Absolute Zero Punch

ds133.name: Ice Punch
ds133.desc: A punch full of freezing cold power.

ds134.name: Ice Arrow

ds135.name: Bind

ds137.name: Chilblains

ds138.name: Tail Attack
ds138.desc: Sweeps its tail to hit an enemy.

ds140.name: Ground Zero

ds141.name: Oblivion Bird
ds141.desc: An evolved form of Ground Zero that has a new tracking function and upgraded power and range.

ds142.name: Ground Zero Revision
ds142.desc: Rotates its entire head to convert itself into a missile silo before launching a stronger organic missile.

ds143.name: Curse Breath
ds143.desc: Exhales purple smoke from its mouth that paralyzes an opponent.

ds144.name: Skull Destroy
ds144.desc: Fires a missile that causes a toxic explosion.

ds145.name: Death Nail
ds145.desc: Slashes the enemy with the claws of one hand.

ds146.name: Foxfire
ds146.desc: Spews blue, high-temperature flames from its mouth. Spews freezing blue flames from its mouth.

ds148.name: Ice Wall
ds148.desc: Breathes out a wall of ice to repel attacks.

ds149.name: Slamming Attack
ds149.desc: Forces the enemy to the ground and begins to maul them.

ds151.name: Freeze Fang
ds151.desc: Bites an enemy with icy fangs.

ds152.name: Ice Cannon

ds153.name: Ice Statue

ds154.name: Mega Flame
ds154.desc: Spews extremely high-temperature flames from its mouth and reduces everything to ashes.

ds155.name: Great Antler
ds155.desc: Headbutts the enemy with its powerful horns.

ds158.name: Great Horn Attack
ds158.desc: Jumps upwards, stabbing with its horns.

ds162.name: Fire Wall
ds162.desc: Creates a wall of fire to stop enemy attacks.

ds163.name: Horn Impulse
ds163.desc: Charges the opponent and attacks multiple times with its horns.

ds164.name: Tail Crash
ds164.desc: Slams its tail into the opponent.

ds165.name: Horn Spiral

ds166.name: Mega Blaster
ds166.desc: Fires a ball of electricity at the enemy.

ds168.name: Blink Thrust
ds168.desc: Sends blades of air at the foe from its horn or claws.

ds169.name: Danger Sting
ds169.desc: Grabs hold of an enemy to electrocute it.

ds171.name: Soft Tackle
ds171.desc: Softly tackles its opponent with its whole body.

ds172.name: Gatling Missile

ds173.name: Spiral Sword
ds173.desc: Rotates its right hand till it glows with energy, then throws a blade of that energy at the enemy.

ds175.name: Gatling Missile Rapid-Fire Mode

ds177.name: Holy Arrow
ds177.desc: Forms a bow with the wings on its glove and shoots a holy arrow of lightning.

ds178.name: Heaven's Charm
ds178.desc: Unleashes a deadly cross-shaped ray filled with beauty and affection that is most effective against evil Digimon. Sings a song to put an enemy to sleep.

ds179.name: Saint Air
ds179.desc: Creates a halo that radiates rainbow light to harm evil. It can heal allies and absorb their attacks to power up Holy Arrow. Creates a holy tornado.

ds180.name: Holy Kick
ds180.desc: Kick-flips upwards. Attacks with a cartwheel.

ds181.name: Holy Attack
ds181.desc: Jumps into the air and then dives diagonally downwards foot-first.

ds182.name: Holy Dash
ds182.desc: A sliding kick along the ground.

ds183.name: Holy Charge Kick
ds183.desc: Charges up, flips and then flies forward foot-first.

ds185.name: Super Jump
ds185.desc: Uses holy power to shoot upwards into the air.

ds186.name: Angel Wing
ds186.desc: Flaps its wings to gain altitude. Dive-bombs the enemy and attacks with a cartwheel.

ds187.name: Holy Charm
ds187.desc: Destroys the enemy by radiating six rings of pink light in a cross-like pattern.

ds190.name: Stinger Surprise
ds190.desc: Crosses its forelimbs and fires a shockwave from them.

ds191.name: Tail Blade
ds191.desc: Stabs the enemy with the blade on its tail like a scorpion.

ds192.name: Sand Shower
ds192.desc: Shoots a stream of sand from its mouth that puts enemies to sleep.

ds193.name: Titanic Wave
ds193.desc: Causes a rainstorm and blasts the enemy with water.

ds194.name: Horn Buster
ds194.desc: Blasts fire from rear end and rockets at the enemy, slamming into it with horn.

ds195.name: Wild Scratch
ds195.desc: Slices at the enemy several times with its claws.

ds196.name: Hell's Hand
ds196.desc: Extends a giant decaying hand from underneath its cloak to attack the enemy.

ds197.name: Death Charm
ds197.desc: Casts an evil spell of darkness that washes over the enemy and saps away its life.

ds198.name: Nightmare Wave
ds198.desc: Emits a dark wave that hypnotizes the enemy, amplifying their doubts and driving them mad.

ds201.name: Adhesive Bubbles

ds202.name: Hunting Cannon
ds202.desc: Shoots a blast of energy from the cannon on its arm.

ds203.name: Jet Gallop
ds203.desc: Uses its jets to gallop forward and kick the opponent with its hind legs.

ds204.name: Heat Upper
ds204.desc: Slams the ground to cause a fiery shock wave, or delivers a red-hot uppercut.

ds206.name: Petra Fire
ds206.desc: Unleashes a power from its eyes that petrifies whatever it looks at.

ds207.name: Beak Slide
ds207.desc: Slices at the foe with its beak.

ds208.name: Again Star
ds208.desc: Shoots blades of wind from its wings.

ds209.name: Feather Cutter
ds209.desc: Throws the crest on its head like a boomerang at the foe.

ds211.name: Variable Darts
ds211.desc: Falls upon the opponent with its gigantic claws, or throws blades of energy or knives of water.

ds213.name: Water Bullet
ds213.desc: Spits balls of water at high speeds.

ds214.name: Iron Scale
ds214.desc: Shoots tiny scales from its body at the enemy.

ds215.name: Bite
ds215.desc: Bites at the enemy with powerful jaws.

ds216.name: Hyper Heat
ds216.desc: Fires an ultra-high-temperature beam from its mouth that can melt anything.

ds218.name: Forbidden Trident
ds218.desc: Throws its trident with tremendous physical strength.

ds220.name: Thousand Whip
ds220.desc: Whips the opponent with its infinite tentacles.

ds221.name: Fire Blast
ds221.desc: Breathes super-powerful flames, changing its surroundings into a sea of fire.

ds223.name: Iron Tail
ds223.desc: Slams its powerful tail into the foe.

ds224.name: Triplex Force
ds224.desc: Combines energy from its three heads to shoot a single powerful laser beam.

ds225.name: Skull Fang
ds225.desc: Thrusts its arm forward to bite with its left hand head.

ds226.name: Crimson Nail
ds226.desc: Chops up the opponent with its gigantic claws, and beats them all bloody.

ds227.name: Red Eye
ds227.desc: Unleashes an evil power from its eerie eyes that paralyzes the enemy.

ds228.name: Demonic Gale
ds228.desc: Shoots waves of wind by swinging its arms, or unleashes a dark electrical storm from its mouth.

ds229.name: Nightmare Syndrome

ds230.name: Enigma
ds230.desc: Destroys the enemy's spirit with rainbow bubbles or a giant heart.

ds232.name: Swing Egg

ds233.name: Drill Spin
ds233.desc: Attacks the enemy with the spinning drill on its head.

ds234.name: Crusher Bone

ds235.name: Screw Claw
ds235.desc: Rushes forward and claws at the enemy.

ds236.name: Twin Neptune
ds236.desc: Swoops down on the opponent with its two pincers.

ds238.name: Love Serenade
ds238.desc: Performs a song that breaks the opponent's heart and destroys their fighting spirit.

ds239.name: Dark Spirits

ds244.name: Air Dark Spirits
ds244.desc: Uses Dark Spirits while in midair.

ds245.name: Nightmare Shock
ds245.desc: Fires a supersonic wave from its mouth. Alternatively, traps the foe in a nightmare.

ds246.name: Scratch Beat
ds246.desc: Scratches the enemy with both arms, or throws darts of energy.

ds247.name: Pretty Attack

ds248.name: Black Matter
ds248.desc: Unleashes an evil orb from the Digimon hiding within it.

ds249.name: Deadly Sting
ds249.desc: Fires the stinger on its tail to paralyze the opponent's whole body.

ds250.name: Howling Noise
ds250.desc: Uses its loud buzzing to paralyze enemies.

ds251.name: Poison Powder
ds251.desc: Spreads a cloud of poisonous powder from its wings.

ds254.name: Scissors Execution
ds254.desc: Slices through the enemy with its left claw.

ds256.name: Beast King Fist

ds257.name: Lion King
ds257.desc: Slices at the foe with its sentient magical sword, Shishiou-maru.

ds258.name: Crushing Kick
ds258.desc: Attacks the enemy with a roundhouse kick.

ds259.name: Beast King Destruction
ds259.desc: Attacks with a blast of energy from its fist.

ds260.name: Hundred Beast Fist
ds260.desc: Doing a series of movements with its arm, Leomon sends a barrage of lion heads against its enemy

ds263.name: True Beast King Fist
ds263.desc: After using Jūouken, performs a second Jūouken with its free hand.

ds264.name: Tusk Strikes
ds264.desc: Skewers the opponent with its two elongated tusks, or fires its tusks like missiles.

ds265.name: Tundra Breath

ds266.name: Snowball
ds266.desc: Fires a hard frozen snowball from its trunk.

ds267.name: Nose Stamp
ds267.desc: Hits the opponent with its trunk.

ds268.name: Ocean Love

ds269.name: Smiling Face
ds269.desc: Charms the enemy with its smile, sometimes following up with strikes from its limbs, or heals its allies.

ds270.name: Marine Squadron
ds270.desc: Summons sea creatures to attack the enemy.

ds271.name: Extra Smile
ds271.desc: Radiates patterns of rainbow light to damage the opponent.

ds272.name: Funny Smile

ds274.name: Pretty Heart

ds275.name: Guilty Black

ds276.name: Neck Hanging
ds276.desc: Chokes the opponent with its tentacles.

ds277.name: Pressure
ds277.desc: Attacks the enemy with the claws of its tentacles.

ds278.name: Gyro Break

ds279.name: Twinkle Beam
ds279.desc: Shoots a laser beam from the lens in its torso that causes the enemy to lose control of their body.

ds283.name: Dramon Attack
ds283.desc: Stabs the opponent with the blade on its head.

ds284.name: Ice Reflect
ds284.desc: Hits the water surface, creating a wall of ice.

ds285.name: Maelstrom
ds285.desc: Shoots a freezing cold blast from its mouth, summons a great wave, or summons an electrically charged tornado.

ds286.name: Thunder Blade
ds286.desc: Stabs the enemy with the electrified blade on the head.

ds287.name: Genocide Attack
ds287.desc: Fires countless organic missiles from both of its arms.

ds288.name: Ultimate Slicer
ds288.desc: Slashes the enemy with its claws, or uses its arms to create vacuum blades.

ds289.name: Mega Death Scythe
ds289.desc: Extends a scythe from one claw and slices enemy with it.

ds290.name: Metal Arm
ds290.desc: Stabs the enemy with its arm.

ds291.name: DG Dimension

ds292.name: Banana Slip
ds292.desc: Trips its opponents by throwing a banana peel.

ds293.name: Heavy Monkick

ds296.name: No. 1 Punch

ds297.name: Full Metal Hip Attack
ds297.desc: Slams its hip into an enemy.

ds298.name: Dark Recital
ds298.desc: A more powerful version of Love Serenade.

ds299.name: Dark Spirits Deluxe
ds299.desc: Calls down dark lightning made from negative energy.

ds300.name: Ultimate Stream
ds300.desc: Fires a massive beam of energy from the cannon on its snout.

ds301.name: Hell Squeeze
ds301.desc: Wraps its body around its prey and constricts.

ds302.name: Poseidon Divide
ds302.desc: Summons a massive wave of water to wash away the enemy.

ds303.name: Ultimate Storm
ds303.desc: Fires a blast of energy from the cannon on its snout.

ds304.name: Capture Beam

ds306.name: Giga Destroyer II
ds306.desc: Fires a large missile from its right hand.

ds307.name: Nuclear Laser
ds307.desc: Fires a beam from its left hand.

ds308.name: Darkside Quake

ds309.name: Demon Arm
ds309.desc: Punches the foe with its Demon Arm.

ds310.name: Elastic Bubbles
ds310.desc: Spits out elastic bubbles towards the opponent.

ds311.name: Elastic Bubbles
ds311.desc: Spits out elastic bubbles towards the opponent.

ds312.name: Icicle Rod
ds312.desc: Attacks with a giant icicle made by instantly freezing atmospheric moisture.

ds313.name: Bone Bone Boomerang
ds313.desc: Throws the bone of an Ancient Digimon like a boomerang.

ds314.name: Dancing Punch
ds314.desc: Dances forward and punches the opponent.

ds316.name: Volcano Strike
ds316.desc: Spits out a powerful flame shot.

ds317.name: Gran Fire
ds317.desc: Breathes out a wave of fire that sweeps along the ground.

ds318.name: Guardy Tusk
ds318.desc: Charges forward and spears the foe with his horn.

ds321.name: Poop Dunk

ds322.name: Oyaji Punch

ds323.name: Dead Word

ds325.name: Plug Bomb

ds331.name: Scissor Arms Ω

ds332.name: Destructive Impulse

ds335.desc: Performs a feint by jumping in place, then uppercuts the opponent.

ds337.name: Lullaby Bubble
ds337.desc: Spits out a stream of bubbles that can put opponents to sleep.

ds338.name: Child Claw
ds338.desc: Scratches at the foe with its claws.

ds339.name: Wrapping Bubble
ds339.desc: Encases itself in a protective bubble and causes a ball of water to drop on the enemy from the sky.

ds340.name: Water Jet
ds340.desc: Attacks by shooting a stream of water from its mouth.

ds342.name: Poison Ivy
ds342.desc: Extends its fingers to entangle the opponent in ivy laced with a powerful toxin, paralyzing them.

ds343.name: Plant Shock
ds343.desc: Hit the opponent with leaves, claws them, or showers them with poisonous pollen.

ds344.name: Stinky Stench
ds344.desc: Gives off a powerful stench that makes Digimon unwilling to fight it.

ds345.name: Very Stinky Stench
ds345.desc: Blows out a powerful poisonous smoke.

ds346.name: Thorn Throw
ds346.desc: Impales the opponent with its vines before throwing them.

ds347.name: Sleep Spore
ds347.desc: Shakes its petals, which releases spores that can put Digimon to sleep.

ds348.name: Thorn Thrust
ds348.desc: Stabs upwards with its extended fingers.

ds350.name: Root Stretch
ds350.desc: Slashes a foe with its claws.

ds351.name: Meteor Squall
ds351.desc: Summons a rain of tiny meteors from the sky.

ds352.name: Hypnotism
ds352.desc: Puts the enemy to sleep using strange radio waves.

ds353.name: Mind Scan
ds353.desc: Uses telepathy to dazzle the opponent.

ds354.name: Hypnotizer
ds354.desc: Hypnotizes the opponent with its eyes before shooting a star-shaped laser beam at them from its face.

ds355.name: Star Seeker
ds355.desc: Withdraws its limbs to become a spinning star that flies into the opponent while glowing.

ds358.name: Cat Punch
ds358.desc: Attacks the opponent with its long claws.

ds359.name: Cat's Eye
ds359.desc: Manipulates opponents with a piercing glare, causing them to attack themselves.

ds361.name: Cat Tail
ds361.desc: Slaps the opponent with its tail.

ds362.name: Cat Laser
ds362.desc: Emits a beam of light from its eyes.

ds363.name: Cat Scratch
ds363.desc: Scratches repeatedly with the claws of both hands.

ds364.name: Cat Trick
ds364.desc: A midair flip that hits the opponent with its tail.

ds366.name: One Two Cat Punch > Cat Rush > Cat Finish
ds366.jp: One Two Neko Punch > Neko Rush > Neko Finish
ds366.desc: Strikes twice with its claws, then back-flips to hit the opponent with its tail, and finishes by launching itself into a headbutt.

ds368.name: Tail Tip
ds368.desc: Pounces on the enemy with its foreclaws.

ds369.name: Mega Kick
ds369.desc: A downward kick from the air.

ds372.name: Petit Thunder
ds372.desc: Fires static electricity amplified by its wings.

ds373.name: Twice Arm
ds373.desc: Slices the enemy with both claws. Sometimes follows up with an uppercut.

ds374.name: Rolling Guard
ds374.desc: Spins along the ground and slams into the foe, or curs up in a ball to raise its defense.

ds375.name: Hard Claw
ds375.desc: Attacks the foe with a hard claw.

ds376.name: Rhino Spin
ds376.desc: Flips over and spins on its back while charged with electricity.

ds377.name: Dynamo Spin
ds377.desc: While flying, spins forward and electrocutes foes.

ds378.name: Shock Jaw
ds378.desc: Spins upwards at an angle while covered in electricity.

ds379.name: Rolling Whip
ds379.desc: Falls on its back and kicks with its hind legs.

ds380.name: Stumbling Attack
ds380.desc: Hits the enemy repeatedly with its claws by first hopping sideways towards them and then falling on them frontwise.

ds381.name: Electrical Discharge
ds381.desc: Discharges electrcity from its whole body, shocking anyone near it.

ds383.name: Aerial Claw Rush
ds383.desc: A midair flurry of claw swipes and kicks.

ds384.name: Samurai/Embellishing Tone
ds384.desc: Causes the enemy's configuration data to vibrate using the ultra-low frequency waves from its vocals and horns, destroying them.

ds385.name: Crush Symphony
ds385.desc: Destroys the opponent from the inside through super-high frequency oscillations.

ds387.name: Lord Jump
ds387.desc: Jumps forward after crouching in all fours.

ds389.name: Shell Phalanx
ds389.desc: Fires the blades on its shell as if they were multiple-warhead missiles.

ds392.name: Tri-Horn Attack
ds392.desc: Charges into the opponent with its three horns.

ds393.name: Golden Tri-Horn Attack
ds393.desc: An electrified version of Tri-Horn Attack.

ds395.name: Panzer Knuckle
ds395.desc: Punches the foe with a flaming fist.

ds396.name: Horn Driver
ds396.desc: Skewers the foe with glowing horns.

ds397.name: Bayonet Lancer
ds397.desc: Shoots an energy lance from its horns.

ds398.name: Cheese Bomb
ds398.desc: Throws an explosive bomb of cheese at the adversary.

ds402.name: Double Attack
ds402.desc: Scumon performs Unchi Nage, followed by Tyumon's Cheese Bomb.

ds403.name: Tell a Lie
ds403.desc: Whispers words to the enemy that make them lose their will to fight.

ds404.name: Corn Thrust
ds404.desc: Gathers energy in its horn and rams it into the foe.

ds405.name: Spread Neigh
ds405.desc: Shoots blades of wind from its horn or soundwaves from its mouth.

ds406.name: Uni Gallop
ds406.desc: Kicks with its hind legs or charges and stabs the opponent with its horn.

ds408.name: V-Breath Arrow
ds408.desc: Spews a high-temperature, V-shaped heat ray from its mouth.

ds409.name: Hammer Punch
ds409.desc: Rears up, then throws a lunging punch at its opponent.

ds410.name: Cutter Shoot
ds410.desc: Slashes with its hand to sling blades of air at its opponent.

ds411.name: Magnum Punch
ds411.desc: Focuses its power into an intense punch.

ds412.name: V-Breath Arrow MAX
ds412.desc: Concentrates its energy into a giant V-Breath Arrow.

ds413.name: Sweet Mouth Attack
ds413.desc: Grabs the enemy sweetly with its mouth.

ds414.name: Hammer Spark
ds414.desc: Strikes the opponent with the shock wave and sparks produced when it swings down Thor Hammer.

ds415.name: Horn & Tusk
ds415.desc: Attacks with its horn and tusks.

ds416.name: Hammer Boomerang
ds416.desc: Tosses its hammer like a boomerang.

ds417.name: Ice Road Bump
ds417.desc: Causes a wave of ice to rise up out of the ground and freeze the opponent.

ds420.name: Thor Fury
ds420.desc: Spins around while swinging its sparking hammer.

ds421.name: Nail Pull
ds421.desc: Sweeps low with the spike on the end of its hammer.

ds422.name: Shell Smash
ds422.desc: Slams down on an opponent from the air.

ds423.name: Anvil Smash
ds423.desc: Smashes the ground with its hammer, causing a shockwave.

ds424.name: Vulcan Revenge
ds424.desc: Charges up its hammer before smashing the opponent with it.

ds425.name: Glacier Spear
ds425.desc: Stabs the opponent with its horn.

ds426.name: [N 1]
ds426.desc: Swings its hammer to create a wave a cold air that fires giant icicles at the enemy. Strikes the ground with its hammer, causing giant icicles to stab up out of the ground.

ds427.name: Air Shot
ds427.desc: Inflates itself with air and expels a burst of air.

ds428.name: Aerial Air Shot
ds428.desc: Fires an Air Shot while airborne.

ds431.name: Air Slam
ds431.desc: Shoots forward through the air, hitting an enemy.

ds432.name: Thousand Wing
ds432.desc: Spins in the air to attack the enemy with its ears. Swings its ears in all direction to fire blades of wind.

ds433.name: Sparking Air Shot
ds433.desc: A glittering, powered-up version of Air Shot.

ds434.name: Air Gust
ds434.desc: Inhales in air and spits out multiple clouds.

ds435.name: Aero Slash
ds435.desc: Breathes in air and shoots it out as blades made out of wind.

ds436.name: Spin Kick
ds436.desc: Spins once on the ground, hitting an enemy with one wing.

ds438.name: Body Blow Bomb
ds438.desc: An attack where Patamon flies forward while spinning.

ds439.name: Aerial Body Blow Bomb
ds439.desc: Dive bombs the enemy while spinning.

ds440.name: Intercepting Air Shot
ds440.desc: An Air Shot that counters an enemy's attack.

ds441.name: Pretty Rush
ds441.desc: Runs forward and rams the enemy with its shoulder.

ds442.name: Bit Bomb
ds442.desc: Conjures up a flying bomb shaped like a bat made from a computer virus.

ds444.name: Pic Trick
ds444.desc: Twirls its arrow, creating a huge star to hit the opponent.

ds445.name: Transfer
ds445.desc: Warps the target to another space.

ds446.name: Soap Bubbles
ds446.desc: Shoots a bubble-like substances from its mouth.

ds447.name: Magical Fire
ds447.desc: Shoots a spiral of ethereal flames.

ds448.name: Chirping Attack
ds448.desc: Jumps or flies into the air and attacks the enemy with both wings. Covers itself in fire and divebombs the enemy with its beak.

ds449.name: Dash Peck
ds449.desc: Dashes at the enemy and pecks it.

ds450.name: Hard Beak
ds450.desc: Pecks the foe with its beak.

ds452.name: Ostri-Kick
ds452.desc: Flips into the air, kicking the opponent.

ds454.name: Charming Tweety
ds454.desc: Charms the enemy with a cute chirp.

ds456.name: Spiral Wing
ds456.desc: 3Cartwheels into the foe. Summons a small tornado. Briefly surrounds itself with a vortex of wind that knocks away the enemy.

ds457.name: Double Fire
ds457.desc: Shoots two simultaneous spirals of ethereal flame.

ds460.name: Needle Squall
ds460.desc: Launches its super-hard spines all at once from its metal head made from Chrondigizoit.

ds461.name: Britain Punch
ds461.desc: Strikes the opponent with its spiked brass-knuckles.

ds462.name: Sludge
ds462.desc: Lets loose a wave of sludge from its mouth.

ds463.name: Stinky Gas
ds463.desc: Releases a gas with a very strong odour from its mouth.

ds467.name: Shaking Pulse
ds467.desc: Shoots a powerful sound wave from its mouth.

ds468.name: Dolphin Kick
ds468.desc: Flips into the air and smacks opponent with its tail.

ds469.name: Bon Voyage
ds469.desc: Kicks up a wave of water with its tail that washes over the foe.

ds470.name: Infinity Arrow
ds470.desc: Hardens the countless envenomed "hairs" of its mane and fires them at the opponent, completely paralyzing them.

ds471.name: Nail Crusher
ds471.desc: Uses its gigantic claws to tear the opponent to pieces.

ds472.name: Poop Paradise
ds472.desc: Spins around, arms stretched out, as it throws several poops.

ds474.name: High Speed Poop Throw
ds474.desc: Holds a poop in both hands and spins on its X-axis, before throwing it at the opponent.

ds478.name: Defecation Pheromone
ds478.desc: Releases a pheromone that affects the opponent's bowels.

ds480.name: Black Pearl
ds480.desc: Shoots jadeite formed within its body at the opponent

ds481.name: Water Screw
ds481.desc: Shoots a jet of high-pressure water at the enemy.

ds483.name: Drill Shell
ds483.desc: Tucks its body inside its shell, then spins at high speeds to strike the opponent.

ds484.name: Spin Shelter
ds484.desc: Tucks its body inside its shell, then spins at high speeds, moving in a zig-zag pattern.

ds485.name: Guard Shelter
ds485.desc: Tucks its body into its shell to increase defense.

ds486.name: Paralyze Breath
ds486.desc: Breathes a paralyzing poison gas at the enemy, or paralyzes them with electricity.

ds487.name: Pitfall
ds487.desc: Digs a pitfall as a trap for an opponent, or burrows into the ground to attack the enemy from below.

ds488.name: Gazimon Claw
ds488.desc: Attacks with the claws of its hands.

ds490.name: Tongue Attack
ds490.desc: Whips the opponent with its tongue.

ds491.name: Noisy Echo
ds491.desc: Inhales deeply and sends a blast of noise at the enemy from its mouth.

ds493.name: Frog Jump
ds493.desc: Jumps high and attacks with the horn around its body.

ds494.name: Devil Bashing
ds494.desc: Unleashes a barrage of attacks with its clawed tentacles.

ds495.name: Squire Dome
ds495.desc: Attacks the enemy with water that takes the form of a dome, wave, vortex, or waterspout.

ds496.name: Deadly Bomb
ds496.desc: Throws a super powerful hand grenade.

ds498.name: Disassembly Chainsaw
ds498.desc: Revs up its Chainsaw and slashes the enemy with it.

ds499.name: Overrun
ds499.desc: Detonates itself to annihilate the enemy.

ds500.name: Spiral Edge
ds500.desc: Rolls into a ball and slices the opponent with its blade-like dorsal fins.

ds501.name: Frog Kick
ds501.desc: Jumps up and kicks out with its feet.

ds502.name: Water Cure
ds502.desc: Shoots a jet of water at the foe.

ds503.name: Dream Dust
ds503.desc: Causes random heaps of trash to plummet from the sky.

ds505.name: Marching Fishes
ds505.desc: Summons a school of colorful flying fish.

ds506.name: Sharp Edge
ds506.desc: Jumps up and slices at the enemy repeatedly while in mid-air.

ds507.name: Surfer Dive
ds507.desc: Jumps into the air to body slam the enemy.

ds509.name: Bubble Barrier
ds509.desc: Encases itself in bubble of water that repels attacks and hurts foes.

ds510.name: Sliding Seal
ds510.desc: Uses water to slide rapidly forward along the ground and into the opponent.

ds512.name: Water Current Throw
ds512.desc: Throws the opponent upwards with its forelegs and a blast of spray.

ds513.name: Giant Water Current
ds513.desc: Hits the enemy with a wave of water.

ds514.name: Giant Water Current Strike
ds514.desc: A larger, stronger version of Giant Water Current.

ds515.name: Gomamon Head-Butt
ds515.desc: Launches itself at the enemy head-first.

ds516.name: Power Attack
ds516.desc: Fires a large bullet of explosive energy from its Energy Cannon.

ds518.name: Angry Rock
ds518.desc: Shoots super-hard ore from the top of its head.

ds519.name: Roughneck
ds519.desc: Swings its arms wildly at an enemy.

ds520.name: Hardest Punch
ds520.desc: Punches at the foe with a rock fist.

ds521.name: Earth Shaker
ds521.desc: Slams the ground with its fists, causing pillars of rock to erupt.

ds522.name: Giga Blaster
ds522.desc: Fires an extremely powerful energy beam from its horn.

ds523.name: High Mega Blaster
ds523.desc: Shoots one or more spheres of electricity from its four arms.

ds524.name: Horn Buster Revision
ds524.desc: Rams the enemy with its electrified horn.

ds525.name: Giant Scissors
ds525.desc: Attacks with the giant pincers on its head.

ds526.name: Heaven's Gate
ds526.desc: Manifests a door to subspace that consigns the opponent to oblivion or blasts them with light.

ds527.name: Excalibur
ds527.desc: Extends its energy sword on its right arm and attacks.

ds528.name: Heaven's Heal
ds528.desc: Heals injuries to self and allies.

ds529.name: Holy Disinfection
ds529.desc: Cures cursed status ailments on allies.

ds530.name: Soul Banish
ds530.desc: Glows with holy energy before either firing one or more energy blades or unleashing a powerful kick.

ds531.name: Judgment Slash
ds531.desc: A single sword strike that destroys evil.

ds532.name: Flying Sword
ds532.desc: Rushes forward to stab with its outstretched Excalibur.

ds533.name: Shield Counter
ds533.desc: Blocks an incoming attack with its beam shield, following up with a powered-up slash of Excalibur.

ds534.name: Holy Jump
ds534.desc: Uses holy power to launch straight up into the sky.

ds535.name: Excaliburst
ds535.desc: Powers up the Excalibur and then slices the enemy.

ds536.name: Shield Strike
ds536.desc: Rams the opponent with its beam shield.

ds537.name: Holy Flame
ds537.desc: Strikes the opponent with the light energy of all justice in the form of a spiraling flame. Those who suffer this technique have their forms instantaneously erased.

ds538.name: Apocalypse
ds538.desc: Summons energy bolts that fall from the heavens, causing explosions of light, or blasts enemies with electricity from its mouth.

ds539.name: Hermit Fog
ds539.desc: Sprays forth a cold mist that corrodes anything it touches.

ds540.name: Harpoon Vulcan
ds540.desc: Shoots a missile from the horn on its head.

ds541.name: Heat Top
ds541.desc: A stab with its horn. A belly flop attack.

ds542.name: Icicle Coat
ds542.desc: Radiates cold and long, thin icicles to freeze enemies. Radiates cold to raise its defense.

ds543.name: Northern Lights
ds543.desc: Breathes out a blast of chilly air.

ds546.name: Electric Thread
ds546.desc: Entangles the enemy with an electrically-charged thread of silk spewed from its hard beak, or simply spits electricity.

ds547.name: Poison Ride
ds547.desc: Stings the foe with its poisonous tail.

ds548.name: Palsy Thread
ds548.desc: Spits an electrified thread from its mouth to paralyze the enemy.

ds549.name: Malicious
ds549.desc: Leaps on the opponent to stab them with its poisonous tail.

ds550.name: Scissor Arms
ds550.desc: Slices at the foe with its claws, or attacks them repeatedly with its pincers, or dive bombs them from the sky.

ds551.name: Power Guillotine
ds551.desc: Chops the enemy with its giant pincers, or slices them with both pairs of its arms.

ds552.name: Trap Scissors
ds552.desc: Counters an enemy's attack with its giant pincers.

ds555.name: Darkness Wave
ds555.desc: Unleashes creatures of darkness similar to bats which incinerate the opponent.

ds556.name: Poison
ds556.desc: Uses Dark Energy via either a magic circle, its breath, a heart, or kicks and claw attacks to reverse the phase of the opponent's own powers, obliterating them from within.

ds557.name: Darkness Spear
ds557.desc: Transforms its left arm into a spear and pierces the opponent.

ds559.name: Stun Whip
ds559.desc: Fires a bolt of electricity from its hands.

ds560.name: V-Wing Blade
ds560.desc: Forms a V-shaped energy blade that connects the horn on its snout to the edges of its wings, then soars towards the opponent, cutting it to pieces. Cannot be used if Aero V-dramon is not in flight.

ds561.name: Dragon Impulse
ds561.desc: Launches an explosive shock wave with the appearance of a dragon.

ds562.name: Magnum Crash
ds562.desc: Punches foe with fist of glowing energy.

ds563.name: Twister Saber
ds563.desc: Charges up blades on its wrists with energy and slashes at the foe.

ds564.name: Twister Claw
ds564.desc: An attack identical to Twister Saber.

ds565.name: Wind Guardian
ds565.desc: Uses wings to call a flurry of winds that create a wind barrier.

ds566.name: Scar-Red Eye
ds566.desc: Shoots twin jets of flame from eyes that can petrify and shatter the opponent.

ds568.name: Red Chicken Attack
ds568.desc: Runs into the enemy and head-butts them.

ds569.name: Melting Aura
ds569.desc: Spits out a wave of flames that sweeps across the ground.

ds570.name: Red Chicken Kick
ds570.desc: Kicks the foe with its enormous foot.

ds572.name: Nemesis Ivy
ds572.desc: Entwines the opponent in the claws extended from its hands, then disorients them.

ds573.name: Gloom Dust
ds573.desc: Spreads a fog of poisonous gas at the foe.

ds574.name: Hungry Hand
ds574.desc: Drains the foe's HP with its claws.

ds575.name: Darkness Zone
ds575.desc: Transforms things in all directions into darkness and nothingness.

ds576.name: Death Evolution
ds576.desc: Using its metal claws to force Digimon to devolve.

ds577.name: Gran Death Big Bang
ds577.desc: Self-destructs in an explosion that can destroy entire world(s).

ds578.name: Tentacle
ds578.desc: Spins around, slicing the opponent with the claws of its tentacles and absorbing their energy.

ds579.name: Asura God Fist
ds579.desc: Attacks the foe with flaming punches or fireballs from its four fists.

ds580.name: Asura Sweltering Fist
ds580.desc: Uses punches to unleash bursts of heat that explode on impact.

ds581.name: Asura Exploding Fist
ds581.desc: Shoots a blast of fire from all four fists at once.

ds582.name: Joy, Anger, Sorrow, and Humor
ds582.desc: Generates an arc of fire from its hands to trap the enemy, or uses its emotions to fire rainbow-colored shock waves at the enemy.

ds583.name: Rhino Charge
ds583.desc: Lowers its horn, charges the enemy, electrocultes them, and flips them into the air.

ds584.name: Lightning Wave
ds584.desc: Summons a series of lightning bolts that strike around it.

ds585.name: Rocket Butt
ds585.desc: Maintains altitude by igniting the thrusters in its rear.

ds586.name: Power Outage
ds586.desc: Slams the ground with its electrified fists.

ds587.name: Super Charge
ds587.desc: Discharges electricity from its entire body, shocking everyone around it.

ds588.name: Super Electric Strike
ds588.desc: While in midair, it spins into a ball and slams itself into the ground, causing an explosion of electrical energy.

ds590.name: Empress Haze
ds590.desc: Completely erases evil viruses with a single swing of its magic broom.

ds591.name: Tri-Banish
ds591.desc: Tests the opponent with its broom, and punishes evildoers.

ds592.name: Virus Delete
ds592.desc: Purges viruses using a giant syringe.

ds593.name: Big Smiley Bomber
ds593.desc: Creates a bomb from its fist and throws it, or uses one of its Mamemon followers as a weapon.

ds594.name: Anti-Magic
ds594.desc: Cures self or ally Digimon from poison, paralysis, and confusion.

ds595.name: Spiral Flower
ds595.desc: Hurls the flowers on its vines like shuriken, cutting through anything.

ds596.name: Pollinosis Shower
ds596.desc: Sprays the opponent with poisonous pollen.

ds597.name: Thorn Whip
ds597.desc: Lashes out at the enemy with its thorny vines, or swings its vines to spread pollen.

ds599.name: Ice Phantom
ds599.desc: Inflicts burns on the opponent with supercooled air or a cold, dark flame.

ds600.name: Mental Point Alchemy
ds600.desc: Recovers Digimon's MP points used to fight by absorbing MP used by the enemy.

ds601.name: Vision Bind
ds601.desc: Blinds enemies with bright blue flames.

ds602.name: Frost Knuckle
ds602.desc: Punches the enemy with a fist made of ice.

ds603.name: Ice Bomb
ds603.desc: Either throws a blue ball of energy that causes a freezing explosion, or causes an explosion that sends shards of ice flying in all directions.

ds604.name: Tomahawk Steiner
ds604.desc: Easily wields its gigantic battle axe and throws it like a boomerang.

ds605.name: Berserk
ds605.desc: Repeatedly chops the enemy with its glowing battle axe.

ds607.name: Brachio Bubble
ds607.desc: Spits out countless bubbles to attack the enemy.

ds608.name: Aqua Shatter
ds608.desc: Slams the ground with its forefeet, causing a wave of ice and water to erupt towards the enemy.

ds610.name: Melt Wax
ds610.desc: Flaps melted wax from its body onto the foe.

ds611.name: Karma Flamer
ds611.desc: Spins around while creating a tornado of flame that repels attacks.

ds615.name: N/A
ds615.desc: Generates a resonance between its two horns to paralyze the opponent.

ds616.name: Selfdestruct
ds616.desc: Charges towards the enemy, then selfdestructs.

ds617.name: Heat Viper
ds617.desc: Shoots heat rays from its mouth or four hands. Even if an opponent tried to dodge this, the shock-waves of this attack would knock them to the side.

ds619.name: Jamming Powder
ds619.desc: Releases iron grains to cause temporary disorder in the opponent's AI.

ds620.name: Precious Flare
ds620.desc: Spits out a toy flame. Random-fires flame-shaped toy missiles.

ds621.name: Dream Missile
ds621.desc: Launches a toy missile from its mouth. Arranges its body into a cannon-like shape and fires a cluster of stars.

ds622.name: Petit Heal
ds622.desc: Uses magical power to heal wounds of itself or allies.

ds623.name: Wonder Illumina
ds623.desc: Creates a wall of shining toy blocks that flies at the enemy.

ds624.name: Mullion Punch
ds624.desc: Rotates and gives a fire punch.

ds625.name: Chrono Breaker
ds625.desc: Destroys the "time" flowing through the opponent's body.

ds627.name: Erase Claw
ds627.desc: Sends out super-oscillatory waves that destroy configuration data from both its arms, completely erasing the space surrounding the opponent.

ds628.name: Cyber Nail
ds628.desc: Slashes the enemy with its sharp claws, or sends shockwaves from its claws.

ds629.name: Dark Inferno
ds629.desc: Magically gives its or its allies' attacks the element of darkness.

ds631.name: Dark Pain
ds631.desc: Sends dark symbols made of fog at the opponent that then turn into thunderclouds and shock them.

ds632.name: Dread Fire
ds632.desc: Incinerates the enemy's spirit with flames of darkness.

ds633.name: Heavy Metal Fire
ds633.desc: Spits out heated metal from its body.

ds634.name: Heat Chain
ds634.desc: Attacks foe with a flaming metal chain.

ds635.name: Heat Chain Random Pounding
ds635.desc: Manipulates flaming chains to attack multiple opponents.

ds636.name: Royal Nuts
ds636.desc: Fires curious objects similar to eggs or nuts from the thicket on its back.

ds638.name: Flame Inferno
ds638.desc: Incinerates the opponent with superhigh-temperature hellfire (either exhaled or fired from its hands).

ds639.name: Chaos Flare
ds639.desc: Summons a massive tornado-like pillar of fire. Exhales intense, chaotic hellfire.

ds640.name: Hammer Knuckle
ds640.desc: Bashes the opponent with a double axe handle punch thrown with all of its might. Conjures a giant fist of magic that smashes the opponent from above.

ds641.name: Double Dust
ds641.desc: Bashes the opponent with a magic-charged double axe handle. Sends a shock wave through the ground at the opponent, causing an earthquake.

ds642.name: Algol's Flame
ds642.desc: Reduces opponents in the vicinity to ashes with demonic hellfire.

ds643.name: Black Death Cloud
ds643.desc: Blinds the enemy and eats at their mind before exhaling a dark gas that dissolves their data.

ds645.name: N/A
ds645.desc: Fires a powerful shot of destructive energy from its chest-cannon.

ds646.name: N/A
ds646.desc: Unleashes a giant explosion of energy from its chest.

ds647.name: N/A
ds647.desc: Encases itself with a gigantic green sphere, blasting nearby opponents and causing them to devolve.

ds648.name: N/A
ds648.desc: Extends its arms to claw the target.

ds649.name: Power of Darkness
ds649.desc: Empties all foes' stomachs and makes them need to use the lavatory.

ds651.name: N/A
ds651.desc: Extends its arms and uses its clawed hands to slash or grab enemies.

ds670.name: Sweet Scent

ds672.name: Needle Stinger

ds679.name: Crimson Claw

ds680.name: Fire Hurricane

ds682.name: Eagle Twister

ds687.name: Temptation

ds688.name: Fairy Vine

ds689.name: Flower Necklace

ds690.name: Flower Cutter

ds691.name: Sunburst Vine

ds692.name: Triple Jump

ds693.name: Green Trap
ds693.desc: Spins around releasing flowers and pollen that can paralyze enemies.

ds694.name: Sun-Crescent Kick
ds694.desc: Charges its body with solar energy, then kicks outwards, leaving a trail of yellow light and flowers behind.

ds695.name: Two-Handed Petal Cannon

ds696.name: Master Fire
ds696.desc: Breathes powerful flames from its mouth.

ds697.name: Master Claw
ds697.desc: Slashes the enemy with its huge claws.

ds698.name: Super-heated Fighting Spirit
ds698.desc: Radiates a fiery heat wave from its body.

ds699.name: Spirit Infusion

ds700.name: Cocytus Breath

ds701.name: Grace Cross Freezer
ds701.desc: Fires its weapons all at once, freezing the opponent. Freezes the opponent with a beam of blue light from its eyes.

ds702.name: Garuru Tomahawk
ds702.desc: Launches a gigantic missile called a Freeze Bomber from its chest. Fires a steady stream of missiles from the launchers on its shoulders.

ds703.name: Freeze Bomber
ds703.desc: Launches a missile out of its chest plate that freezes the target.

ds704.name: Metal Fang
ds704.desc: A stronger version of Garurumon's Freeze Fang. Cuts the enemy with its wings.

ds705.name: Blizzard Attack
ds705.desc: Charges forward through the air, trailing ice from its wings.

ds706.name: Giga Missile

ds707.name: Giga Destruction

ds708.name: Metal Scratch

ds709.name: Metal Howling
ds709.desc: Attacks the enemy with a powerful howl.

ds710.name: Over Flame
ds710.desc: Unleashes a wave of fire from its Trident Arm. Unleashes a wave of fire from its mouth.

ds711.name: Metal Slash Revision

ds712.name: Tera Destroyer
ds712.desc: A more powerful version of Giga Destroyer.

ds713.name: Giga Storm
ds713.desc: Fires energy beams from the hatches on its chest.

ds714.name: Time Unlimited

ds715.name: Dimension Destroyer

ds719.name: Blade Fin
ds719.desc: Generates a shock wave from the crest on its head.

ds720.name: Lightning Shock

ds721.name: Smoke
ds721.desc: Spreads smoke from its body to distract its foes and escape.

ds722.name: Smoke
ds722.desc: Spreads smoke from its body to distract its foes and escape.

ds723.name: Pile Shell

ds724.name: Mind Fog

ds725.name: Return to Nature

ds726.name: Camouflage Tackle
ds726.desc: Retreats into shell, camouflages self in green, spins around, then slams into the enemy.

ds727.name: Tropical Beak
ds727.desc: Repeatedly pecks with its colorful beak.

ds728.name: Ardent Flair
ds728.desc: Shoots a wave of fire at the enemy.

ds729.name: Eternal Slap
ds729.desc: Slaps away the the foe with wings.

ds731.name: Catastrophe D
ds731.desc: Self-destructs to create a massive explosion. Fires missiles from all over its body.

ds732.name: Infinity Hand
ds732.desc: Shoots an energy blast from its Mugen Hand. Crushes or stabs its enemy using its right arm.

ds733.name: Snake Bandage
ds733.desc: Coils the bandages on both of its arms around the opponent, like a snake.

ds734.name: Necrophobia
ds734.desc: Summons ghosts to drive its opponent into maddened death, or fires an energy blast from its gun Obelisk.

ds735.name: Poison S-mush

ds737.name: Destructive Mushroom Bomb

ds739.name: Apologies in Advance[N 1]
ds739.desc: Slashes the enemy with its glowing sword, draining their life force.

ds742.name: Fake Drill Spin
ds742.desc: Attacks the enemy with the spinning drill on its head.

ds743.name: Fake Bone

ds745.name: Fake Special

ds746.name: Fox Tail

ds747.name: Seed Cracker

ds748.name: Grey Sword

ds749.name: Garuru Cannon
ds749.desc: Freezes the opponent with frigid, absolute zero shots from the Garuru Cannon in its right arm.

ds751.name: All Delete

ds752.name: Double Torrent

ds754.name: Aerial Garuru Cannon
ds754.desc: A midair attack with its Garuru Cannon.

ds755.name: Dash Grey Sword
ds755.desc: Attacks with the Grey Sword while dashing.

ds756.name: Ultimate Uppercut

ds757.name: Sword of Ruin

ds758.name: Omega Sword
ds758.desc: Gathers its power and slashes with the Grey Sword.

ds759.name: Omega Howling
ds759.desc: Fires powerful sound waves from its Garuru Cannon. Fires a homing swarm of icy energy from its Garuru Cannon.

ds760.name: Omega Blast

ds762.name: Vassallo Crush

ds765.name: Sake Breath

ds766.name: [N 2]

ds767.name: Spirytus Breath

ds768.name: Ice Beast Fist

ds778.name: Shadow Sickle

ds782.name: Snow Claw

ds784.name: End Trance

ds786.name: Hyper Cannon

ds788.name: Sub Vulcan

ds789.name: Machine Gun Arm

ds812.name: Bad Message

ds816.name: Purple Smog

ds822.name: Dead Scream

ds832.name: Verm Blaze

ds851.name: Strange Mist

ds858.name: Magic Game

ds860.name: Magic Heal

ds861.name: Blink Breeze
ds861.desc: Creates a blast of wind from its staff.

ds863.name: Leaf Slider

ds864.name: Drain Buster

ds865.name: Woody Smash

ds869.name: Sonic Bite

ds870.name: Assassin Arrow

ds871.name: Little Blizzard[N 1]

ds881.name: Sonic Destroyer

ds888.name: PicoDevi Claw

ds889.name: Bat Flutter

ds891.name: Pid Speed

ds898.name: Ending Snipe

ds900.name: Drill Nose

ds901.name: Flying Cross Cutter
ds901.desc: Throws its Wood Cross like a boomerang.

ds903.name: Clean Up

ds905.name: Giant Wooden Man

ds906.name: Wires Choking
ds906.desc: Wires come from the fingers controls an opponent puppet.

ds907.name: Bigger Liar

ds908.name: Bullet Machinegun

ds911.name: Metallic Guard
ds911.desc: Covers itself in a barrier then rams the enemy.

ds912.name: Sorrow Blue

ds913.name: Fin Attack

ds915.name: Puppy Howling

ds916.name: Petit Punch

ds917.name: Happy Paw

ds918.name: Sledge Dash

ds920.name: Flashy Horn

ds922.name: Psyche Horn

ds923.name: Psyche Shot

ds929.name: Hazard Breath

ds931.name: Red Thorn

ds933.name: Red Hot Machine Gun

ds935.name: Justice Bullet

ds936.name: Russian Roulette

ds940.name: Fascination
ds940.desc: Enthralls an opponent and absorb its life-force with a pink gas.

ds941.name: Rosy Cradle
ds941.desc: Spreads a rose-scented gas and puts all the enemies to sleep.

ds942.name: Ivy Hug
ds942.desc: Stabs a vine into the ground, causing many vines to erupt from the ground to binds and damages the opponent.

ds943.name: Beauty Shock
ds943.desc: Releases lightning from one of its vines or attack with an electrified whip with thorns.

ds944.name: Thorn Shoot
ds944.desc: Fire one thorn from a rose.

ds945.name: Danger Thorn
ds945.desc: Shoot numerous rose thorns at all enemies.

ds946.name: Rose Velvet
ds946.desc: Covers the ground in thorns to restrict enemy's action.

ds948.name: Black Saber
ds948.desc: Strikes from the air with the talons on its feet. Shoots dark rings by flapping its wings.

ds949.name: Mach Shadow
ds949.desc: Rams the opponent at high speed while spinning.

ds952.name: Desert Wind
ds952.desc: Generates a small sandstorm by flapping its wings intensely.

ds955.name: Bottom Cutter
ds955.desc: Cuts the enemy with its tail.

ds956.name: Shama Hammer
ds956.desc: Runs forward and hits the foe several times with its club.

ds957.name: Shama Strike
ds957.desc: Hits balls of fire at the foe with its club.

ds958.name: Mad Twist
ds958.desc: Shoots a series of purple energy rings from its club.

ds959.name: Dancing Bone
ds959.desc: Throws a bone at the enemy.

ds960.name: Skipping Boulder
ds960.desc: Summons a large boulder and throws it.

ds963.name: Raster Shot
ds963.desc: Spits out a blast of green energy from its mouth.

ds964.name: Wild Thunder
ds964.desc: Shoots a bolt of blue lightning from its horn.

ds966.name: Mirage Dance
ds966.desc: Kicks with the hind legs while giving off light.

ds967.name: Shima Corn Thrust
ds967.desc: Stabs the enemy with the horn on its head.

ds969.name: Black Hole
ds969.desc: Gets out of its garbage can and uses it to suck opponents into the black hole within it.

ds970.name: Dirty Saucer
ds970.desc: Throws the garbage can lid at its opponents like a boomerang.

ds971.name: Hyper Smell
ds971.desc: Spreads a noxious stench coming from within its body.

ds972.name: Dirty Puddle
ds972.desc: Causes dirty water to fall on the foe.

ds973.name: Polka-dots
ds973.desc: Shoots glowing stars at the foe.

ds974.name: Unpleasant Tongue
ds974.desc: Licks the enemy in a disgusting way.

ds976.name: Guilty Claw
ds976.desc: Attacks with the claws of its Giga Hands, or uses them to create vacuum blades.

ds977.name: Giga Heat
ds977.desc: Radiates a heat wave from its body.

ds978.name: Energy Shot
ds978.desc: Fires energy beams from its hand.

ds980.name: Living Shield
ds980.desc: Uses magic to create a wall of protection.

ds981.name: Goburi Rush
ds981.desc: Dashes forward to swipe at the foe with its club repeatedly.

ds982.name: God Flame
ds982.desc: Explodes its holy spirit, instantly mowing down enemies in all directions. Shoots a stream of flames from its closed fists.

ds983.name: Summon
ds983.desc: Claps its hands, releasing Amon and Umon, who attack the enemy together.

ds985.name: Curse Crimson
ds985.desc: Fires super-heated gases from the small stacks on its back or from its mouth.

ds987.name: Guardian Bomb
ds987.desc: Gathers energy in its hands to form a huge wire-frame bomb that it throws at its opponent.

ds988.name: Anti-Digi Beam
ds988.desc: Fires a beam of energy from its right hand that ignites its opponent.

ds989.name: Gargant Press
ds989.desc: Jumps into the air and performs a moonsault.

ds990.name: N/A
ds990.desc: Falls swiftly after performing a high jump. The damage done both physically and mentally when suffering this technique is said to be unfathomable.

ds991.name: Art of Transformation
ds991.desc: Transforms Digimon that have been turned into Scumon back to their original form.

ds994.name: Supersonic Voice
ds994.desc: Produces an extremely high-frequency sound wave to destroy the opponent's configuration data.

ds995.name: Moebius Bite
ds995.desc: Bites the enemy with its tail.

ds996.name: Destruction Grenade
ds996.desc: Shoots flying missiles from its wrists that chases intruders to the ends of the earth and completely destroys them.

ds997.name: Warning Beam
ds997.desc: Burns the enemy with lasers from its eyes.

ds998.name: Homing Laser
ds998.desc: Fires homing beams from the cylinders on its shoulders.

ds999.name: Red Alert
ds999.desc: Self-destructs to create a giant explosion.

ds1000.name: Chaos Fire
ds1000.desc: Spews high-temperature flames from its mouth. Strikes the ground to cause dark fire to rise at its enemy.

ds1002.name: Death Moonsault
ds1002.desc: Performing a backwards somersault, it kicks the opponent.

ds1005.name: Darkness Gear
ds1005.desc: Buries a black gear with a built-in computer virus within the body of the opponent, driving them mad.

ds1007.name: Entangle
ds1007.desc: Spins around, hitting the enemy with its gears.

ds1009.name: Crash Device
ds1009.desc: Self-destructs to create a giant explosion. Runs into the enemy to electrocute them.

ds1010.name: Strike Fishing
ds1010.desc: Throws or stabs the enemy with its cherished harpoon, "Torrent".

ds1011.name: Hell Dive
ds1011.desc: Jumps at the opponent, either headbutting them or stabbing them with "Torrent".

ds1012.name: Infuriation
ds1012.desc: Hardens its fur to metallic hardness and shoots needle-like hairs from its body.

ds1013.name: Rúyì Bone
ds1013.desc: Attacks with its extensible bone club.

ds1015.name: Paralyze Sting
ds1015.desc: A headbutt attack in which it pierces the opponent with the stinger on its head.

ds1016.name: Starlight Explosion
ds1016.desc: Rains golden grains from its wings that purify evil, or explodes with light.

ds1018.name: Flaming Wing
ds1018.desc: Tackles the enemy from the sky with burning wings.

ds1019.name: Mach Wing
ds1019.desc: A more powerful version of Kyoushū.

ds1020.name: Life Force
ds1020.desc: Generates a wonderful energy that absorbs the enemy's life force.

ds1023.name: Iceball Toss
ds1023.desc: Throws a huge ball of ice.

ds1024.name: Dope Cancel
ds1024.desc: Magically causes enemy's raised parameters to drop.

ds1025.name: Ice Club
ds1025.desc: Attacks with its club of ice.

ds1026.name: Snow Barrier
ds1026.desc: Raises a barrier of snow and ice to counterattack.

ds1027.name: Frost Claw
ds1027.desc: Slashes the enemy with its icy claws, or stuns them with a chop of its hand, or spreads freezing air with its wings.

ds1028.name: Zero Freeze
ds1028.desc: Fires a freezing beam from its eyes or hand.

ds1029.name: Icy Shower
ds1029.desc: Releases a barrage of icicles from its wings.

ds1030.name: Cold Blood
ds1030.desc: Gives an ally's attacks the water element.

ds1031.name: Cold Breath
ds1031.desc: An attack that blows a freezing breath.

ds1032.name: Iceball Bomb
ds1032.desc: Throws a solid frozen bomb of ice, causing an icy explosion.

ds1033.name: On the Rock
ds1033.desc: Drops a lump of enormous ice on the foe.

ds1034.name: Solid State
ds1034.desc: Swings its arms wildly at an enemy, or glows with blue light as it raises its defense.

ds1035.name: Ice Strike
ds1035.desc: Punches the foe with an icy fist.

ds1036.name: Iga-style Shuriken Throw
ds1036.desc: Throws one or more large shuriken at the enemy.

ds1037.name: Iga-style Sword Draw Skill
ds1037.desc: Attacks with a sword-draw skill faster than the eye can see.

ds1038.name: Iga-style Mysterious Clone Skill
ds1038.desc: Temporarily creates up to eleven clones of itself.

ds1039.name: Dancing Leaves
ds1039.desc: Spins around and creates a tornado of leaves that surrounds the foe.

ds1040.name: Cosmo Flash
ds1040.desc: Emits a cosmic energy wave, causing a meteor shower or sending opponents to another dimension.

ds1041.name: Rock Tornado
ds1041.desc: Swings its arms wildly at an enemy.

ds1042.name: Falling Star
ds1042.desc: Drops one or more meteors on an enemy.

ds1043.name: Big Bang Blow
ds1043.desc: Hits the opponent with an explosive punch.

ds1044.name: Guard Rock
ds1044.desc: Prevents all damage from next attack done by enemy.

ds1045.name: Hang on Death
ds1045.desc: Sends those with evil hearts to the land of the dead with its cherished staff.

ds1046.name: Gentle Punch
ds1046.desc: Gathers energy in its fist and then punches.

ds1047.name: Guard Stick
ds1047.desc: Casts a spell with its staff that sends a wave of earth and rock forward.

ds1050.name: Jungle Punch
ds1050.desc: Utilises the power of the wilderness to dish out a punch with all its might. Punches the opponent while singing.

ds1052.name: Jungle Head
ds1052.desc: After a roar, it hits the enemy with a headbutt.

ds1053.name: Neutralize
ds1053.desc: Removes all status ailments from an ally.

ds1054.name: Cherry Bomb
ds1054.desc: Shoots explosive cherries from its foliage. If swallowed, the cherries cause instant death.

ds1055.name: Illusion Mist
ds1055.desc: Creates a thick fog to confuse the enemy with illusions.

ds1057.name: Ivy Attack
ds1057.desc: Whips or ensnares the foe with vines.

ds1058.name: Shell's Attack
ds1058.desc: Hides its body within its shell and uses it to do a tackle.

ds1059.name: Fermented Poop
ds1059.desc: Throws the large amounts of poop it has stored within its shell.

ds1060.name: Poop Rain
ds1060.desc: Shoots meteors of excrement from the sky.

ds1061.name: Always Odd/Snail Odd
ds1061.desc: Conceals its body inside its shell, then shoots a beam from inside it.

ds1062.name: Monkey Play
ds1062.desc: Puts up a false show to cripple the opponent's fighting spirit, and/or throws a ball of energy at them.

ds1065.name: Little Pecker
ds1065.desc: Spits explosive Chibi Kiwimon at the enemy that return to it afterwards.

ds1067.name: Berserk Sword
ds1067.desc: Swings its greatsword like a berserker, cutting everything in two with a single stroke.

ds1068.name: The Duel
ds1068.desc: Slashes with its sword to send a spinning blade of air at the enemy.

ds1069.name: Grand Smash
ds1069.desc: Blows the opponent away with its sword instead of cutting them.

ds1070.name: Checkmate Break
ds1070.desc: Uses a special formation with a group of eight Pawn Chessmon (White), surrounding them with an aura and then stabbing together at the opponent.

ds1072.name: Scissor Arms Mini
ds1072.desc: Slices foe with its electrified pincers.

ds1073.name: Assemble Work
ds1073.desc: Uses electromagnetism to gather scrap metal and throw it, or simply slices the foe with its pincers.

ds1075.name: Stun Shock
ds1075.desc: Electrocutes the enemy with the top of its head like a taser.

ds1078.name: Dino Burst
ds1078.desc: Spews out an ultra-high temperature wind.

ds1079.name: Dynamite Head
ds1079.desc: Uses its powerful leg strength to run at blistering speed by tilting its head down and taking a horizontal stance and slams into the opponent head first.

ds1080.name: Mantra Chant
ds1080.desc: Hardens its skin to the level of Chrome Digizoid, then unleashes physical attacks.

ds1081.name: Meditation Cure
ds1081.desc: Recovers from any kind of damage in an instant.

ds1082.name: Data Absorption
ds1082.desc: Absorbs the enemy's data from a distance using its hands.

ds1083.name: Treasure Axe
ds1083.desc: Transforms its hands into axe blades and spins to attack with them.

ds1084.name: Megaton Press
ds1084.desc: Leaps into the air and body-slams the enemy, crushing them under its weight.

ds1085.name: Tail Hammer
ds1085.desc: Slams its armored tail into the enemy.

ds1086.name: Armor Stampede
ds1086.desc: Charges forward and head-butts the enemy with its massive weight.

ds1087.name: Rhythmical Knock
ds1087.desc: Slams its forefeet down into the ground to cause pillars of earth to shoot up from the ground and slam into the foe.

ds1088.name: Glide Horn
ds1088.desc: Charges the opponent from the sky.

ds1089.name: Blast Laser
ds1089.desc: Fires off ring-shaped beams with a roar similar to thunder.

ds1090.name: Wind Breath
ds1090.desc: Shoots supersonic waves from its mouth.

ds1091.name: Mach Impulse
ds1091.desc: Flaps wings and shoots down two jets of hot air.

ds1092.name: Penetrator
ds1092.desc: Dives down from the sky to ram the foe with its horns.

ds1093.name: Stealth Quarrel
ds1093.desc: Shoots a wave of rapid razor-sharp feathers at the foe.

ds1094.name: Wave Laser
ds1094.desc: Emits a strange sound wave to confuse the enemy.

ds1095.name: Ocean Stream
ds1095.desc: Generates a gigantic whirlpool in the ocean, submerging the opponent.

ds1097.name: Spider Thread
ds1097.desc: Chops up the opponent with razor-sharp wires or binds them with webbing from its hands.

ds1098.name: Predation Spider
ds1098.desc: Attacks the opponent with the countless carnivorous Dokugumon hidden in its abdomen.

ds1099.name: Acid Mist
ds1099.desc: Breathes out an acidic green mist.

ds1100.name: Data Drain
ds1100.desc: Stabs the sharp portions of its limbs into the opponent and completely absorbs their data.

ds1101.name: Rolling Stone
ds1101.desc: Rolls into a ball and spins into the foe.

ds1102.name: Rigid Block
ds1102.desc: Repels attacks by curling into a ball.

ds1103.name: Vajra
ds1103.desc: Emits a wave from its mouth which converts the opponent completely into metal. The victim of this technique is unable to move while their body rusts, but they are unable to die until they have completely rusted away. Becomes immune to attacks.

ds1104.name: Iron Claws
ds1104.desc: Slashes the opponent with its claws.

ds1107.name: Meteor Dance
ds1107.desc: Manipulates the spirits of the cosmos, causing a group of meteorites to rain down on the enemy.

ds1109.name: Pyrokinesis
ds1109.desc: Gathers flames in its hands and places them on the earth, creating a cracked lava vent that grows forward and erupts under the foe.

ds1110.name: White Spell
ds1110.desc: Produces a ball of white light that shoots beams in all directions.

ds1111.name: Storming Knives
ds1111.desc: Fires a barrage of explosive bullets from its chest.

ds1112.name: Pandemonium Flame
ds1112.desc: An extremely high-temperature beam that it fires from its shoulders, Sodom and Gomorrah. Emits a thick fog of darkness in the environment which confuses the opponent.

ds1113.name: Melting Blood
ds1113.desc: Opens up the jaw-like cannons on its shoulders and spews out a thick, red, acidic mist.

ds1114.name: Mind Illusion
ds1114.desc: Locks its enemy into a dream of their perfect world.

ds1115.name: Howling Blood
ds1115.desc: Fires large spheres of black energy from Sodom and Gomorrah. Produces two spheres of black energy in its hands and thrusts upwards with them.

ds1116.name: Soul Shield
ds1116.desc: Uses a shield of darkness to absorb energy from projectiles.

ds1117.name: Crimson Mist
ds1117.desc: Generates dark, reddish mist from its body and sends it forth as a large cloud.

ds1118.name: Black Rain
ds1118.desc: Leaps into the sky and spins around, releasing a spinning column of small dark orbs from its cape.

ds1119.name: Ear Lancer
ds1119.desc: Causes its usually drooping ears to straighten and sharpen, and uses them to pierce the enemy.

ds1121.name: Danger Love
ds1121.desc: Curses the enemy with a heart-like charm.

ds1122.name: Dark Gaia Force
ds1122.desc: Takes all of the "negative emotions" within this world and concentrates them into one spot, and then fires it.

ds1123.name: Black Tornado
ds1123.desc: Unites its Dramon Killers together over its head, and pierces the opponent by charging at them while rapidly spinning.

ds1124.name: Dramon Buster
ds1124.desc: Drops straight down from above, stabbing with a Dramon Killer.

ds1125.name: War Blaster
ds1125.desc: Gathers energy in its hands and fires a series of explosive green fireballs.

ds1126.name: Black Storm Tornado
ds1126.desc: Generates huge burning tornadoes around itself.

ds1128.name: Nose Blaster
ds1128.desc: Inhales large amounts of air in the atmosphere, and releases it as a high-temperature breath all at once from its snout.

ds1130.name: Free Throw Bomb
ds1130.desc: Throws infallible bombs at the enemy.

ds1132.name: Countdown
ds1132.desc: Turns self into a living bomb that destroys itself and unleashes great explosive power.

ds1133.name: Matador Dash
ds1133.desc: Charges forward at a great speed and uses its two horns to strike up towards the enemy.

ds1134.name: Sweet Pheromone
ds1134.desc: Causes phosphorus powder containing a hallucinogenic program stored in its wings to rain down on the opponent and confuse them.

ds1135.name: Honey Wave
ds1135.desc: Emits a mysterious sound wave from the wings.

ds1136.name: Sweet Kick
ds1136.desc: Attacks with a powerful flying kick.

ds1137.name: Sweet Honey Straw
ds1137.desc: Sends balls of light to absorb the target's health.

ds1138.name: Tongue Whip
ds1138.desc: Attacks with its powerful, extensible tongue in the manner of a whip.

ds1140.name: Chaos Cannon
ds1140.desc: Fires massive blasts of energy from the twin cannons on its back.

ds1141.name: Trump Sword II
ds1141.desc: Summons large, cursed swords to skewer the enemy.

ds1142.name: Mask's Square
ds1142.desc: Hurls a large sphere of dark energy.

ds1143.name: Heaven's Judgment
ds1143.desc: Summons a huge thundercloud that rains lightning bolts on the enemy.

ds1145.name: Final Judgement
ds1145.desc: A more powerful version of Heaven's Judgement.

ds1147.name: Cherubi Mouth
ds1147.desc: Inhales the opponent into its body, either swallowing them in darkness or spitting them out.

ds1148.name: Cherubi Finger
ds1148.desc: Flicks the enemy with its finger.

ds1149.name: Dashing Cherubi Finger
ds1149.desc: Dashes forward and flicks the enemy with its finger.

ds1150.name: Cherubi Press
ds1150.desc: Slams its palm down on an opponent.

ds1151.name: Cherubi Hand
ds1151.desc: A black sphere is created in its hands that sucks in enemies.

ds1152.name: Dark Lightning
ds1152.desc: Attacks with dark power in the form of lightning.

ds1153.name: Heaven's Judgement
ds1153.desc: Calls multiple lightning bolts from the Heavens to rain down upon the enemy. These lightning bolts are white and are somberly summoned unlike Cherubimon (Vice) who calls them violently.

ds1154.name: N/A
ds1154.desc: Rams into the opponent while hopping about.

ds1155.name: Double Bobble
ds1155.desc: Fires a stream of adhesive bubbles from its mouth.

ds1156.name: Data Crusher
ds1156.desc: Destroys the opponent's data by stabbing them with the tentacles on its back.

ds1157.name: Misconnecting
ds1157.desc: Unleashes deadly energy from the tips of its tentacles, or savagely whips the opponent with its tentacles.

ds1158.name: Freeze Wave
ds1158.desc: Constricts the opponent with beams of light, generated by coiling its body into a spiral, until they stop breathing or unleashes a freezing cold wave.

ds1159.name: Toltecan Wind
ds1159.desc: Invokes the ancient wind of the gods.

ds1160.name: Dead or Alive
ds1160.desc: Coils its body around a sphere of electricity, then shoots bolts from it.

ds1162.name: Kaiser Phoenix
ds1162.desc: Performs a ramming attack with its full metal body.

ds1163.name: Mystic Break
ds1163.desc: Emits a white ray which reduces the opponent to ash.

ds1164.name: Explosion Eye
ds1164.desc: Fires a destructive beam from the eye on its head.

ds1166.name: Death Wave
ds1166.desc: Confuses the enemy with a strange radio wave.

ds1168.name: Bubble Bomb
ds1168.desc: A frothy bomb which explodes on contact.

ds1170.name: Gold Rush
ds1170.desc: Rapidly spins the drills on its snout and both of its hands, performing a simultaneous attack with its drills.

ds1171.name: Big Crack
ds1171.desc: Impacts the ground with its spinning drills, causing a fissure.

ds1172.name: Titan Drill
ds1172.desc: Rams the enemy with the drill on its nose.

ds1173.name: Hell Masquerade
ds1173.desc: Chops up the opponent in a "Dance of Hell," in which its nimble movements leave behind afterimages.

ds1175.name: Ultra Bite
ds1175.desc: Snaps at the enemy with its fangs.

ds1176.name: Distem Howling
ds1176.desc: Inflictes damage to the opponent's sense of hearing with a great howl, making them lose their fighting spirit, or throws dirt or bombs at the enemy.

ds1177.name: Brain Rupture
ds1177.desc: Launches a cracking program into the opponent's brain using the gun it carries in its left hand, extracting the data stored in its brain, or fires a purple beam that can take control of the target.

ds1179.name: Planet Destroyer
ds1179.desc: Unlocks all of its accumulated power from the gun in its right hand, and is said to be able to destroy a single planet in an instant.

ds1180.name: Jamming Thunder
ds1180.desc: Shoots electricity generated from the static of rubbing its tails together, interfering with communications in the process.

ds1181.name: Tail Dusk
ds1181.desc: Strikes the opponent with its electrified tails.

ds1182.name: Assassin's Bolt
ds1182.desc: Sends a barrage of small blades of electricity at the foe.

ds1183.name: Nitro Turbine Wave
ds1183.desc: Vertically raises its ear turbines and spins them at maximum output to generate a shock wave on the same level as a huge typhoon.

ds1185.name: Knuckle Fire
ds1185.desc: 3Drives its fiery fists into the enemy. Shoots fireballs from its hand. Dives downwards horn-first while covered in flames.

ds1186.name: Fire Rocket
ds1186.desc: Uses its entire body a as flaming rocket and pulverizes the enemy. Shoots a barrage of fireballs from its hand.

ds1188.name: Flame Shot
ds1188.desc: Covered in flames, it cuts diagonally upwards using its helmet blade.

ds1189.name: Flame Shield
ds1189.desc: Encases itself in a ball of fire.

ds1190.name: Leaf Wheel Cutter
ds1190.desc: Spins the wheels on its back at 20,000 rpm and fires them at the enemy.

ds1192.name: Blue Fire
ds1192.desc: Breathes a stream of blue fire.

ds1193.name: Black Ice
ds1193.desc: Dashes forward, leaving in its wake a trail of icicles that freeze whoever touches them.

ds1194.name: Skull Driller
ds1194.desc: Drops straight down horn-first, stunning the enemy.

ds1195.name: Gatling Arm
ds1195.desc: Fires bullets or lasers from the vulcans on both of its arms.

ds1196.name: Dumdum Upper
ds1196.desc: A powerful uppercut punch combined with Gatling Arm.

ds1197.name: White Statue
ds1197.desc: Summons a giant demon statue to attack the enemy.

ds1198.name: Black Statue
ds1198.desc: Whips the enemy with belts of energy.

ds1199.name: Phantom Turban
ds1199.desc: Manipulates the turban wound about its head into ever-changing shapes to attack the opponent.

ds1201.name: Acidic Bubbles
ds1201.desc: Spits acidic bubbles from its mouth.

ds1202.name: Lightning Blade
ds1202.desc: Fires an electric blade from the lightning-imbued blade on its head.

ds1203.name: Blue Thunder
ds1203.desc: Unleashes a powerful electric shock from the three protuberances on its back.

ds1205.name: Petit Twister
ds1205.desc: Generates a tiny tornado by spinning its ears like propellers.

ds1206.name: Double Typhoon
ds1206.desc: A powerful unison technique with Terriermon that creates a giant tornado.

ds1207.name: Blazing Ice
ds1207.desc: Spits out shots of supercooled air.

ds1209.name: Lop Punch
ds1209.desc: Slaps the enemy with one of its ears.

ds1210.name: Lop Rush
ds1210.desc: Repeatedly slaps the enemy with its ears.

ds1211.name: Spinning Slap
ds1211.desc: Windmills its ears in midair to slap repeatedly.

ds1212.name: Lop Balloon
ds1212.desc: Spreads its ears, enabling it to fall or glide slowly.

ds1213.name: Dash Twister
ds1213.desc: Spins along the ground, slapping the foe.

ds1214.name: Thermal Mane
ds1214.desc: Detonates the thermal energy within its body to its maximum, generating bursting flames.

ds1216.name: Extreme Jihad
ds1216.desc: Emits the utmost power of the Digimental in the form of an energy wave from its entire body.

ds1217.name: Plasma Shoot
ds1217.desc: Fires one or more shots of ball-shaped plasma, or fires a swarm of missiles from its armor.

ds1219.name: Shining Gold Solar Storm
ds1219.desc: Rapidly compresses space, then immediately and explosively expands it, sweeping away surrounding enemies with a golden laser beam.

ds1220.name: Miracle Glitter
ds1220.desc: Shines rays of burning light from its armor.

ds1221.name: Light Aura Barrier
ds1221.desc: Envelops itself in a barrier of light to ward off enemies.

ds1222.name: Iron Press
ds1222.desc: Crushes the opponent under its large build.

ds1223.name: Tail Lance
ds1223.desc: Stabs the enemy with its tail.

ds1224.name: Balloon Mine
ds1224.desc: Spews out a large amount of "mini Manbomon-shaped bubbles" from its mouth.

ds1225.name: Global Glove
ds1225.desc: Pummels the opponent with the gloves on both of its hands earnestly.

ds1227.name: Water Lily
ds1227.desc: Fires a watery beam from its mouth.

ds1228.name: Paralyze Tail
ds1228.desc: Pierces the enemy's body with the electrified Stun Needle on the end of its tail.

ds1230.name: Northern Cross Bomber
ds1230.desc: Spins its golden anchor in a turbulent manner to pulverize the enemy.

ds1231.name: Charm Plunder
ds1231.desc: Draws near while adorning its beautiful mermaid-like figure, and instantly pierces the enemy with its golden anchor.

ds1234.name: Ice Wolf Claw
ds1234.desc: Shoots a guided missile from its shoulder that freezes its target.

ds1236.name: Metal Wolf Claw
ds1236.desc: Charges forward through the air, trailing ice from its wings.

ds1238.name: Pinecone
ds1238.desc: Throws a hard, pinecone-shaped object at the enemy.

ds1239.name: Worm Barrier
ds1239.desc: Reduces damage taken from normal attacks.

ds1240.name: Death Crystal
ds1240.desc: Chops up its enemy's soul with discs of incorporeal energy.

ds1241.name: Killer Light
ds1241.desc: Uses a powerful flash to blind the enemy.

ds1242.name: Crystal Drop
ds1242.desc: Rams the enemy with its body.

ds1243.name: Horn Blade
ds1243.desc: Cuts through space itself with its giant antlers along with the opponent no matter how far away it is.

ds1244.name: Punisher
ds1244.desc: Unleashes a powerful kick with its hind legs.

ds1245.name: Saint Roar
ds1245.desc: Confuses the enemy with a roar.

ds1246.name: Hanging Twister
ds1246.desc: Calls forth a massive twister that tosses the opponent about.

ds1247.name: Morphon Gatling
ds1247.desc: Fires 100 shots per second, and it is impossible to escape from this gunfire.

ds1249.name: Curse of Queen
ds1249.desc: Produces a red, high-temperature beam from the ornament on its brow.

ds1250.name: Rosetta Stone
ds1250.desc: Summons a megalith with ancient inscriptions engraved in Digimoji to attack the enemy.

ds1251.name: Nile Jewelry
