ds1251.desc: Fires explosive gems from its leg armor.

ds1252.name: Sanctuary Bind
ds1252.desc: Combines powers with Pegasmon to create a ring/rope of light to ensnare the enemy.

ds1253.name: Paw of Queen
ds1253.desc: Fires jewels from its leg armor.

ds1254.name: Hot Foot
ds1254.desc: Crouches and fires a short-range beam from its eyes at the enemy's feet.

ds1255.name: Derision Crow
ds1255.desc: Causes the opponent to completely lose their fighting spirit using its derisive way with words and laughter.

ds1256.name: William Arrow
ds1256.desc: Fires an arrow from its bow.

ds1257.name: Mad Balloon Bomb
ds1257.desc: A terrifying technique that breeds powerful computer viruses in the balloons it holds, bursting them as they lightly float over the enemy's head.

ds1259.name: Boiled Bubble
ds1259.desc: Spits out a stream of extremely hot bubbles.

ds1260.name: Lava Claw
ds1260.desc: Scratches at the foe with its hot claws.

ds1261.name: Magma Drip
ds1261.desc: Causes lava to drop from the sky onto the enemy.

ds1263.name: Midnight Clutch
ds1263.desc: Approaches the opponent from behind under the cover of darkness, then swoops down on them with its talons.

ds1266.name: Desperado Blaster
ds1266.desc: Fires an energy wave from the two organic cannons that extend from its waist.

ds1267.name: Esp: "Fencing"
ds1267.desc: Attacks with the spikes extending from the shells on its arms.

ds1268.name: Wire Punch
ds1268.desc: Extends its fingers on cables that wrap around the opponent.

ds1269.name: Elemental Bolt
ds1269.desc: Combines the power of its two cannons, or joins its arms together, to fire a bolt of electricity.

ds1270.name: Animal Nail
ds1270.desc: Slices the foe with claws hidden in its paws.

ds1271.name: Bamboo Grass Punch
ds1271.desc: Punches the foe, causing an explosion of leaves.

ds1272.name: Yúnnán Province
ds1272.desc: Summons Chinese firecrackers to blow up the opponent.

ds1273.name: Palm Strike
ds1273.desc: Attacks with a hand strike using all of its power.

ds1274.name: Shiny Ring
ds1274.desc: Launches a gear that generates intense heat to scorch the enemy.

ds1275.name: Sol Calor
ds1275.desc: Releases a Sun-like burst of fire from its body in all directions.

ds1281.name: Crystal Cloud
ds1281.desc: Summons snow clouds with its staff, causing massive blizzard.

ds1282.name: Aquarius Fill
ds1282.desc: Uses magic from the water to fill the place with magical water that raises its parameters very slightly or shoots a jet of water at its enemy.

ds1284.name: Shell Needle Rain
ds1284.desc: Shoots the blades on its back up into the sky, raining down on the enemy.

ds1285.name: Guillotine Wheel
ds1285.desc: Spins by turning into a living saw and slicing with its row of spikes.

ds1286.name: Spiking Finish
ds1286.desc: Skewers the opponent with the spikes on its arms. Hits the enemy with a powerful flying kick.

ds1287.name: Moon Shooter
ds1287.desc: Fires the spikes on its arms.

ds1289.name: Assassin’s Dance
ds1289.desc: A combination of slashes with the needles on its arms.

ds1291.name: Submarine Attack
ds1291.desc: Distances itself underwater, instantly accelerates and performs a ramming attack while spinning the drill on its snout.

ds1293.name: Hydro Jet
ds1293.desc: Shoots a water stream from its backside.

ds1294.name: Halley Squall
ds1294.desc: Summons countless meteors to rain down upon the enemy from overhead.

ds1295.name: Galactica Eyes
ds1295.desc: Fires a beam or star-shaped pulses from its sunglasses, blasting or hypnotizing its opponent.

ds1296.name: Superstar Seeker
ds1296.desc: Withdraws its limbs to become a spinning star that flies into the opponent while glowing.

ds1299.name: Down Tornado
ds1299.desc: Spreads its wings, and engulfs the opponent in an intensely whirling cold wind and feathers, tearing them apart with its sharp-pointed feathers.

ds1302.name: Blazing Fire
ds1302.desc: Spews out a shot of superheated air.

ds1303.name: Aerial Petit Twister Shot
ds1303.desc: Spins in midair to sling a small twister.

ds1305.name: Terrier Punch
ds1305.desc: Slaps the opponent with one of its ears.

ds1306.name: Terrier Balloon
ds1306.desc: Spreads its ears, enabling it to fall or glide slowly.

ds1307.name: Pliers Cutter
ds1307.desc: Pinches and twists with its beak, or spins around to hit enemies multiple times with its beak.

ds1308.name: Crest Cutter
ds1308.desc: Fires blades of light from its crest.

ds1309.name: Egg Attack
ds1309.desc: Attacks with its beak while spinning, or traps the enemy in a large egg and pecks it until it breaks.

ds1310.name: Marble Marble
ds1310.desc: Shoots colorful balls of light at the opponent from its mouth.

ds1311.name: Hail Machine Gun
ds1311.desc: Fires the crystals on its back all at once.

ds1312.name: Crystal Guard
ds1312.desc: Spreads its crystals out to create an offensive shield.

ds1314.name: Nail Scratch
ds1314.desc: Slashs with the claws on its tentacles.

ds1315.name: Torpedo Attack
ds1315.desc: 3Chases and charges into the enemy like a homing torpedo. Fires a Tylomon-shaped torpedo from its mouth. Fires six torpedoes from hexagon-shaped portals that appear in front of it.

ds1316.name: Terror Plankton
ds1316.desc: Spits a stream of water filled with poisonous plankton.

ds1317.name: Tilt Anchor
ds1317.desc: Whips the enemy with its tail.

ds1318.name: Hydro Wave
ds1318.desc: Attacks the enemy by quickly spinning and using the force of water.

ds1320.name: Eraser Below
ds1320.desc: Summons a tidal wave to wash away the foe.

ds1321.name: Shock Shout
ds1321.desc: Releases an ultrasonic shout, making the opponent flinch.

ds1322.name: V-mon Head
ds1322.desc: Launches itself at the enemy for an intense headbutt.

ds1323.name: Buzzing Punch
ds1323.desc: Swings both of its arms in circles, striking the opponent.

ds1324.name: Hopping Kick
ds1324.desc: Jumps up and kicks with both legs.

ds1325.name: Headbutt Attack
ds1325.desc: Attacks the opponent with a very strong headbutt.

ds1326.name: Aerial V-mon Head
ds1326.desc: Attacks with V-mon Head while in the air.

ds1327.name: Volley Kick
ds1327.desc: Jumps and does an aerial kick attack.

ds1329.name: Victory Rush
ds1329.desc: A series of punches with boxing gloves that ends in an uppercut.

ds1330.name: V-mon Head Drop
ds1330.desc: Jumps up and uses V-mon Head to land like a meteor.

ds1331.name: V-mon Knockout
ds1331.desc: Slides rapidly forward for a knockout punch.

ds1332.name: V-shot
ds1332.desc: Fires a small energy blast from its mouth.

ds1334.name: Handstand Kick
ds1334.desc: Puts its hands on the ground to kick with both feet at once.

ds1336.name: Repeated Stomping Attack
ds1336.desc: Jumps atop the enemy and repeatedly stomps on their head.

ds1337.name: Repeated Kick
ds1337.desc: Two midair kicks followed by a third, stronger kick on the ground.

ds1339.name: Heel Kick
ds1339.desc: A kick that brings its heel down on the opponent's head.

ds1340.name: Longsword
ds1340.desc: Attacks with a sword made of Chrome Digizoid.

ds1341.name: Fenrir Sword
ds1341.desc: Slashes at and freezes the opponent with a cursed, absolute zero sword, bringing their vital functions to a halt.

ds1343.name: Laser Javelin
ds1343.desc: Summons a javelin and launches an explosion from its tip.

ds1344.name: Sanction Storm
ds1344.desc: Raises a tornado to chastise its foes.

ds1347.name: Arctic Blizzard
ds1347.desc: Momentarily brings the surrounding atmosphere to absolute zero, then smashes the frozen enemy with Mjöllnir.

ds1348.name: Viking Axe
ds1348.desc: Fires its morning stars on long chains, or slams a glowing fist down on the enemy.

ds1349.name: Viking Flail
ds1349.desc: Uses the morning star on its back to unleash a powerful blow.

ds1350.name: Berserk Howl
ds1350.desc: Howls with all of its berserker rage.

ds1351.name: Mjöllnir
ds1351.desc: Uses the morning star on its back to unleash powerful hits.

ds1352.name: Mega Gain Guard
ds1352.desc: Raises its defense with a roar and a white aura.

ds1353.name: Mjöllnir Hammer
ds1353.desc: Strikes with its icy morning stars.

ds1354.name: Big Bang Voice
ds1354.desc: Stuns the enemy with a heavy bass mike performance.

ds1355.name: Big Bang Tackle
ds1355.desc: Does a mighty tackle with the power to destroy even mountains.

ds1357.name: Club Arm
ds1357.desc: Attacks the enemy with extending arms.

ds1358.name: Aquary Pressure
ds1358.desc: Attacks with water of such extremely high pressure that it is enough to penetrate steel.

ds1359.name: Baluluna Gale
ds1359.desc: Attacks with a sharp wind carrying magical power.

ds1361.name: Sticky Net
ds1361.desc: Spits out the threads of a tough, adhesive net, completely restricting the opponent's movements.

ds1362.name: Silk Thread
ds1362.desc: Shoots out stiff threads that are as thin as a silk thread but as pointed and sharp as a needle.

ds1363.name: Random Roll
ds1363.desc: Flips into a ball and hops into the air to whip the opponent with its antennae.

ds1364.name: Silk Thread Attack
ds1364.desc: Slaps the foe with a strand of silk.

ds1365.name: Silk Thread Gather
ds1365.desc: Shoots out silk in the shape of a hand to grab objects.

ds1366.name: Worm Tail
ds1366.desc: Spins around and scratches the foe with its spinnerets.

ds1367.name: Worm Wheel
ds1367.desc: Spins into a ball and rams enemy.

ds1368.name: Worm Scratch
ds1368.desc: Jumps in the air and spins into a ball to attack.

ds1369.name: Worm Hang
ds1369.desc: Sticks to a surface, allowing it to scale it. Attaches itself to an enemy to headbutt it repeatedly.

ds1370.name: Thread Punch
ds1370.desc: "Punches" with a blob of silk extended from its mouth.

ds1371.name: Spin Sting
ds1371.desc: Drills the enemy with its spinnerets.

ds1372.name: Thread Clump Drop
ds1372.desc: Encases a midair opponent in webbing, making them fall to the ground.

ds1373.name: Spiked Smash
ds1373.desc: Sprays webbing along the ground and forms it into spikes that stab upward at the enemy.

ds1374.name: Worm Drill Crash
ds1374.desc: Dives down at the enemy, drilling them with a spike of webbing protruded from its mouth.

ds1375.name: Dynamic Thread Uppercut
ds1375.desc: "Uppercuts" the opponent with a blob of silk extended from its mouth.

ds1376.name: Sticky Net Revision
ds1376.desc: A variation of Sticky Net modified with the smell of nattō.

ds1377.name: Misty Illusion
ds1377.desc: Displays an illusion which generates a dark mist around the opponent, destroying their spirit.

ds1378.name: Black Hail
ds1378.desc: Summons huge blocks of black crystals that rains on its enemies.

ds1380.name: X-Laser
ds1380.desc: Fires an energy wave emitted from the "X" pattern on its chest. Fires an energy beam from its mouth.

ds1382.name: Hearty Shatter
ds1382.desc: Flies up and rams the enemy from the sky with its shoulder. Shoots a large fireball from its mouth.

ds1383.name: Combination
ds1383.desc: A combo consisting of a punch, two kicks, and an elbow drop.

ds1384.name: Spinning Lariat
ds1384.desc: Spins around, hitting the enemy with both arms.

ds1385.name: Single-stroke Bisection
ds1385.desc: Fires a shock wave by crossing its two bokutō. Merges its two bokutō into a single longer, glowing blade, and attacks with it.

ds1386.name: Puppetry Technique
ds1386.desc: Manipulates the opponent like a puppet with a bewitching look.

ds1387.name: Crimson Blaze
ds1387.desc: Fires from its wings swirling flames comparable to solar prominences.

ds1390.name: [N 3]
ds1390.desc: Shoots a barrage of fireballs upwards from its wings.

ds1391.name: [N 4]
ds1391.desc: Fires countless glowing needles from its body.

ds1392.name: Rainbow Shower
ds1392.desc: Radiates a beam from its laser wings that burns the opponent to cinders.

ds1394.name: Rodeo Gallop
ds1394.desc: Unleashes a powerful blow with its hind legs.

ds1395.name: Silver Blaze
ds1395.desc: Fires a holy beam from its brow.

ds1396.name: Shooting Star
ds1396.desc: Creates the void of space inside of both its wings, sending down shooting stars.

ds1398.name: Needle Rain
ds1398.desc: Shoots needle-like hair strands from its mane.

ds1399.name: Necromist
ds1399.desc: Emits a fear-gas that steals the will of hostile Digimon, and slowly desiccates their flesh. If someone suffers this attack, there are only two options—whether to be lured completely to the world of death, or to serve Pharaohmon as an immortal, even in death.

ds1400.name: The Living Image of the Night

ds1401.name: Crazy Sonic
ds1401.desc: Emits a high-frequency noise at the enemy, rupturing their sensory organs.

ds1403.name: Tequila Knuckle
ds1403.desc: Drives punches that only hit the opponent's face with its leather-strapped fists, intoxicating them with its destructive power.

ds1404.name: Blood Dance: Maracas Version
ds1404.desc: Strikes the opponent while getting into a rhythm with the maracas on its Mexican hat.

ds1406.name: Pororo Breeze
ds1406.desc: Flaps its wings to raise a cloud of sand, then seizes the opportunity to flee when the opponent flinches.

ds1407.name: Sonic Ear
ds1407.desc: Accelerates the blades on both of its ears to the speed of sound and then slashes the enemy.

ds1408.name: Dimension Hole
ds1408.desc: Summons a being from another dimension to increase an ally's defense.

ds1409.name: Smiley Warhead
ds1409.desc: Unleashes an intense headbutt without breaking its smile.

ds1411.name: Beak Pierce
ds1411.desc: Nosedives from high in the sky and pierces the enemy with the sharp tip of its beak, penetrating even armor, regardless of its thickness, and destroying their Digicore with unparalleled accuracy.

ds1412.name: Mysterious Light Ray
ds1412.desc: Shoots a beam from the mouth.

ds1413.name: Hell's Bomb
ds1413.desc: Drops multiple bombs over a wide area.

ds1414.name: Side Winder
ds1414.desc: Shoots a large barrage of missiles from its wings.

ds1415.name: Heartner Beam
ds1415.desc: Releases a soft light that causes a loss of fighting spirit and soothes the hearts of its enemies.

ds1417.name: Blue Thunder
ds1417.desc: Looses intense thunderbolts from the sky, with divine fury.

ds1418.name: Wind of Threads and Flower of Electricity
ds1418.desc: Strikes its enemy with lightning from the sky.

ds1420.name: Golden Triangle
ds1420.desc: Fires a triangular beam from its whole body that completely disassembles the enemy's data.

ds1421.name: Rapid Fire
ds1421.desc: Rapid-fires homing missiles from its arms and the revolver on its back.

ds1423.name: Atomic Burst
ds1423.desc: Cloaks itself in a barrier made of light emitted from the "Ain Soph Aur" jewels embedded in its armor, then charges into the opponent.

ds1425.name: Spinning Cutter
ds1425.desc: Rapidly spins its body using its prided speed, and tears up the opponent with the cutters on both of its arms.

ds1427.name: Judgement Arrow
ds1427.desc: Fires an arrow made of the super-metal Chrome Digizoid.

ds1429.name: Poison Pierce
ds1429.desc: Stings an enemy with extreme poison from its tail.

ds1430.name: Blackout
ds1430.desc: Blinds the opponent's by disseminating a slightly poisonous mist.

ds1431.name: Prism Rainbow
ds1431.desc: Spews out a seven-colored beam from its trumpet-like mouth. This technique has the effect of purifying all feelings of conflict such as the enemy's belligerence and hatred.

ds1433.name: Jamming Hertz
ds1433.desc: Emits radio waves that derange the opponent from the radome on its back, leaving them in a state of complete confusion.

ds1435.name: Spirit Boomerang
ds1435.desc: A cursed weapon that contains the spirits of the dead. It makes sport of the enemy with its ever-changing trajectory.

ds1437.name: Seven Heavens
ds1437.desc: Fires seven super-heated spheres of light at the opponent.

ds1438.name: Testament
ds1438.desc: Sacrifices its mortal life to trigger a Big Bang.

ds1440.name: Ascension Hallow
ds1440.desc: Calls down powerful bolts of lightning.

ds1441.name: Divine Breaker
ds1441.desc: Sends forth a formidable ball of crackling lightning from its fist.

ds1444.name: Final Heal
ds1444.desc: Fully heals itself and its allies.

ds1445.name: Holy Sunshine
ds1445.desc: Submerges the battlefield in holy light.

ds1446.name: Heat Storm
ds1446.desc: Attacks the opponent with a hot wind that rages in the desert.

ds1447.name: Tusk Driver
ds1447.desc: Strikes the opponent with its two gigantic tusks.

ds1448.name: Flare Buster
ds1448.desc: Emits a red hot blaze from both hands or sets itself on fire and rams the opponent.

ds1449.name: Indent Screw
ds1449.desc: Strikes the opponent with stretched-out arms while rotating.

ds1450.name: Psychic Wave
ds1450.desc: Emits a psychic wave from all its body.

ds1451.name: Harmonious Spirit
ds1451.desc: Shoots exploding clay disks at the enemy.

ds1452.name: Violent Spirit
ds1452.desc: Shoots red/orange beams out of its eyes.

ds1453.name: Fortune Spirit
ds1453.desc: Summons a bird statue that emits a song.

ds1454.name: Wool Grenade
ds1454.desc: Forcibly puts enemy Digimon to sleep during any battle with giant balls of wool launched from the "Wool Ball Booster".

ds1457.name: Kusanagi
ds1457.desc: Throws the big shuriken on its back at the opponent from high in the air.

ds1458.name: Autumn Leaf Wind
ds1458.desc: Spins the shurikens at the tips of its extendable limbs to attack the enemy.

ds1459.name: Cranium Hill-drop
ds1459.desc: Holds onto the opponent as they both plunge headfirst into the ground.

ds1460.name: Bungee Jump
ds1460.desc: Shurimon sticks its feet into a wall and does a bungee jump.

ds1461.name: Leaf Concealment
ds1461.desc: Transforms its body into a hurricane of sharp leaves, disappearing and reappearing like a ninja.

ds1462.name: Tendril Jump
ds1462.desc: Flips through the air, extends its limbs, and slices at the foe with the shurikens on its feet.

ds1463.name: Top Gun
ds1463.desc: Fires off energy shots while extending both of its arms ahead of itself.

ds1464.name: Dual Sonic
ds1464.desc: Glides at super-speed from the sky above to crash a shock wave into the opponent.

ds1465.name: Airfield
ds1465.desc: Creates a tornado and sends it against the opponent.

ds1467.name: Mystic Bell
ds1467.desc: Generates special ultrasonic waves from the bell hanging from its neck to confound the opponent.

ds1470.name: Dimension Scissor
ds1470.desc: Cuts through all of the surrounding space with its scissors. Fires energy in the shape of its pincers.

ds1471.name: Grand Death Screw
ds1471.desc: Gathers its power and drills right through the enemy with its scissors.

ds1472.name: Zone Black Hole
ds1472.desc: Creates a gigantic orb of darkness and strikes the opponent with it.

ds1473.name: Catastrophe
ds1473.desc: Attacks the enemy with its claws and scissors, causing a fiery explosion in the process. Fires a barrage of explosive beams from its wings.

ds1474.name: Double Bubble
ds1474.desc: Spits out a lot of adhesive bubbles.

ds1475.name: Wind Seeker
ds1475.desc: Manipulates the wind, generating a vacuum blade.

ds1476.name: Silent Symphony
ds1476.desc: Fires destructive supersonic waves from its mouth.

ds1477.name: Feather Slash
ds1477.desc: Throws the feather on its head like a boomerang.

ds1478.name: Beak Pecker
ds1478.desc: Pecks at the enemy with its beak.

ds1479.name: Loop the Hawk
ds1479.desc: Flips into the air and slices at the enemy with its talons.

ds1480.name: Atomic Ray
ds1480.desc: Combines neutron energy and nuclear energy from the regulatory turbines on its shoulders to form a beam that annihilates enemies.

ds1481.name: Copy Paste
ds1481.desc: Attacks with the batons it carries on its back.

ds1482.name: Tempest Wing
ds1482.desc: Spins its body to generate a gigantic tornado.

ds1483.name: Udjat Gaze
ds1483.desc: Fires a cursed beam from its eyes that hypnotizes the opponent.

ds1485.name: Positron Laser
ds1485.desc: Fires an energy beam from the cannon on its back.

ds1486.name: Mega Death
ds1486.desc: Fires dark matter from its mouth or cannon that annihilates everything within a wide radius.

ds1487.name: Splendor Blade
ds1487.desc: Uses its glowing claws to attack.

ds1488.name: Eternal Zeal
ds1488.desc: Spreads its wings and generates a massive, fiery explosion.

ds1489.name: Double Positron Laser
ds1489.desc: Combines its Positron Laser with Imperialdramon Fighter Mode's to deal immense damage.

ds1490.name: Giga Death
ds1490.desc: Fires the Positron Laser from the face on its chest to emit a destructive energy wave. Fires a large ball of black electricity from the cannon in its chest.

ds1491.name: Super Positron Laser
ds1491.desc: A charged and more powerful version of Positron Laser.

ds1492.name: Ion Blaster
ds1492.desc: Releases an emitter from its chest that charges a bolt of energy that explodes.

ds1493.name: Imperial Claw
ds1493.desc: Slashes with the claws on one wrist.

ds1494.name: Imperial Crusher
ds1494.desc: Dashes forward, stabbing with the electrified claws of one wrist, sometimes followed by a powerful kick.

ds1496.name: Dragon Kick
ds1496.desc: Flips, bringing its heel down on the enemy.

ds1497.name: Dragon Knee
ds1497.desc: Shoots forward through the air with one knee outstretched.

ds1498.name: Light Barrier
ds1498.desc: Creates a shield of energy from the cannon on its arm that it can also use to encase opponents.

ds1499.name: Transcendent Positron Laser
ds1499.desc: Firmly plants its feet on the ground, before charging energy on its cannon and then shooting a more powerful Positron Laser.

ds1500.name: Hell's Grenade
ds1500.desc: Fires shells of a terrible, destructive energy from the muzzle inside of its mouth.

ds1501.name: Cocoon Attack
ds1501.desc: Charges the opponent while in its cocoon form.

ds1502.name: Cocoon Guard
ds1502.desc: Raises its defense by retracting its legs and neck into its body.

ds1503.name: Virus Skater
ds1503.desc: Breathes a stream of dark, electrified gas from its mouth.

ds1504.name: Cherry Blossom Blizzard
ds1504.desc: Violently sweeps the back of its head, then emits a blinding, stinging light from the faces on its hands that knocks out the opponent while they're fascinated by the beauty of that storm of petals.

ds1505.name: Lion Dance
ds1505.desc: Makes a circle with its head, sharply tapering the petals on its head where the force accumulated due to the centrifugal force, then piercing them into the opponent like shuriken.

ds1506.name: Jumping Blow
ds1506.desc: An intense blow unleashed from its golden right arm.

ds1508.name: Ballistic Feathers
ds1508.desc: Flaps its jet black wings, driving its feathers into the opponent with a shock wave.

ds1509.name: Enlightenment
ds1509.desc: Reads the opponent's spirit to anticipate their attacks.

ds1510.name: Irataka Swords
ds1510.desc: Attacks or blocks with its swords.

ds1512.name: Crazy Giggle
ds1512.desc: Fires a shot of exceptionally powerful bullet of light from its mouth.

ds1513.name: Crazy Turn
ds1513.desc: Attacks by extending its arms and spinning around.

ds1515.name: Dark Crusher
ds1515.desc: Hits an enemy with both hands.

ds1517.name: Teppou
ds1517.desc: An intense barraging harite unleashed from its six arms.

ds1519.name: Glare Eye
ds1519.desc: Produces froth from its eye. Fires a ball of light from its eye.

ds1521.name: Asipatravana
ds1521.desc: Spins like a tornado with its body as the axis, cutting anything surrounding it with the Bǎo Fǔ on its hands.

ds1522.name: Treasure Axe
ds1522.desc: Transforms its hands into razor-sharp axes to attack.

ds1523.name: Ammit
ds1523.desc: Summons a demonic beast from hell to devour the Digicores of evil Digimon, or fires waves of destructive light from its hands.

ds1524.name: Pyramid Power
ds1524.desc: Imprisons its enemy in a pyramid made from beams of light, or uses pyramid power to jump up and kick the enemy.

ds1525.name: Soul Absorption
ds1525.desc: Disassembles and absorbs the enemy's data.

ds1526.name: Erase Sickle
ds1526.desc: Attacks with the sickles on its arms, erasing the enemies configuration data.

ds1527.name: Prison Fist
ds1527.desc: 3Destroys the opponent's data at the program level. Stabs the opponent with the spines on its arm and absorbs their energy. Uses its hand to summon a vortex of dark energy.

ds1528.name: Snatch Whip
ds1528.desc: Robs the opponent of their configuration data and turns it into its own.

ds1529.name: Dot Matrix
ds1529.desc: Disassembles the opponent's data into a particle state and absorbs it.

ds1530.name: Freeze Tentacles
ds1530.desc: Freezes the opponent's data with its tentacle-shaped hands, causing their vital functions to be brought to a halt.

ds1531.name: Exile Spear
ds1531.desc: Twists the tentacles of one hand into a spear and stabs the opponent.

ds1532.name: Ultimate Flare
ds1532.desc: Fires a huge fire blast from its mouth.

ds1534.name: Darkness Claw
ds1534.desc: Raises its sharp claws overhead and then cuts the opponent to pieces.

ds1535.name: Heartbreak Shot
ds1535.desc: Locks on the enemy's heart and takes it down with one shot.

ds1538.name: Behemoth
ds1538.desc: Summons Behemoth and drives into the enemy.

ds1539.name: Pao Yù
ds1539.desc: Traps opponents in crystal spheres and deletes them.

ds1540.name: Death Slinger
ds1540.desc: Fires a destructive wave from the Blaster on its right arm.

ds1542.name: High Impact
ds1542.desc: Attacks with Berenjena from the air, or calls down lightning on the enemy.

ds1543.name: Bloody Skewer
ds1543.desc: Pierces the enemy with beams of dark matter from its Berenjena.

ds1544.name: Behemoth × Death Slinger
ds1544.desc: Rapid-fires its Blaster while riding Behemoth, before shooting a beam from it.

ds1545.name: Exhaust Flame
ds1545.desc: Breathes a stream of flame from its mouth while roaring.

ds1546.name: Plasma Blade
ds1546.desc: Develops plasma on its arm blades and slices the enemy, sometimes by spinning with arms outstretched.

ds1547.name: Black Exhaust Flame
ds1547.desc: Breathes a stream of flame from its mouth.

ds1548.name: Howling
ds1548.desc: Frightens an enemy with a fierce howl.

ds1549.name: Dragon Slash
ds1549.desc: Slashes upward with the claws on both hands.

ds1551.name: Dark Blade
ds1551.desc: Attacks with the electrified claws of one hand.

ds1552.name: Atomic Blaster
ds1552.desc: Fires from both gunports on its chest, destroying the enemy on the atomic level.

ds1553.name: Hammer Edge
ds1553.desc: Punches the enemy with the Pendulum Blade of one arm.

ds1554.name: Double Edge
ds1554.desc: Slices the enemy with the Pendulum Blades on its arms.

ds1555.name: Giant Missile
ds1555.desc: Fires the giant missiles on its shoulders.

ds1556.name: Burst Shot
ds1556.desc: Fires all of the heavy artillery on its body at once.

ds1557.name: Śwabhojana
ds1557.desc: Generates a massive earthquake and shock wave by striking the ground with Bǎo Chuí

ds1558.name: Treasure Mallet
ds1558.desc: Transforms its entire body into a gigantic hammer to smash the foe.

ds1559.name: Howl of the Heavens
ds1559.desc: Unleashes a wave of force from its mouth.

ds1560.name: Hellfire
ds1560.desc: An emission of scorching-hot flames from its mouth.

ds1561.name: Inferno Gate
ds1561.desc: Opens the "gates of Hell" that are engraved in the earth, thrusting the opponent down into the jet-black Dark Area.

ds1563.name: Judecca Prison
ds1563.desc: Fires a dark corrosive wave from Gorgon. Charges forward with an electrified Balmung.

ds1564.name: Demon's Disaster
ds1564.desc: 3A brutal barrage of thrusts with Balmung. Repeatedly fires blasts of electricity from Balmung. Fires a beam from the tip of its lance.

ds1565.name: Waking Dead
ds1565.desc: Casts a huge sphere of energy around itself using Gorgon.

ds1566.name: Spiral Wailer
ds1566.desc: Attacks with its lance Balmung as lightning spirals about the blade.

ds1567.name: Duke Charge
ds1567.desc: Charges its enemy with its glowing Balmung.

ds1568.name: Falling Lance
ds1568.desc: Drops down from the sky, stabbing with Balmung.

ds1569.name: Shield Destructor
ds1569.desc: Charges up and blasts the enemy with energy from Gorgon.

ds1570.name: Chaos Shot
ds1570.desc: Gathers dark energy with Gorgon and fires it with Balmung.

ds1571.name: Cruel Balmung
ds1571.desc: A strong blow using Balmung that shocks the enemy.

ds1576.name: Grey Noise
ds1576.desc: A howl that seals the opponent's abilities.

ds1577.name: Black Beam
ds1577.desc: Fires a black beam that pierces the opponent's Digicore.

ds1578.name: Demonic Gates, Hidden Armor
ds1578.desc: Chants an incantation while painting a barrier in the air with its gigantic brush, confining the opponent in a labyrinth.

ds1579.name: Exorcism Scrolls
ds1579.desc: Wreathes its talismans around the opponent's body, then detonates them.

ds1580.name: Kimontonkou Glamour
ds1580.desc: Changes the enemy's perception of the magical labyrinth, such as by making another Digimon invisible to them.

ds1581.name: Final Elysion
ds1581.desc: Fires a beam which purifies everything from the holy shield Aegis in its left hand.

ds1582.name: Royal Saber
ds1582.desc: Dispatches a strong blow from the holy lance Gram. Fires a beam or lightning bolt from Gram.

ds1583.name: Dragon Driver
ds1583.desc: Takes Grani into a nosedive, driving through its foe with its lance.

ds1584.name: Yuggoth / Yuggoth Blaster
ds1584.desc: Grani fires the digital bio-weapon Yuggoth.

ds1585.name: Gram Slash
ds1585.desc: Lacerates the enemy with the tip of Gram. Stabs downwards from the air with Gram.

ds1586.name: Royal Slash
ds1586.desc: Slashes with Gram while running towards the enemy.

ds1587.name: Sky Gram Slash
ds1587.desc: The aerial version of Gram Slash.

ds1588.name: Shield Attack
ds1588.desc: Charges up its Aegis and fires a beam or burst of energy from it.

ds1589.name: Screw Saber
ds1589.desc: 3Spins with Gram outstretched, rising into the air like a tornado. Thrusts upwards into the air with an electrified Gram. Summons tornadoes that radiate outwards.

ds1590.name: Lightning Charge
ds1590.desc: Fires a lightning bolt from Gram. Surrounds itself with a giant sphere of electricity.

ds1591.name: Saber Shot
ds1591.desc: Gathers holy energy with Aegis and fires it with Gram.

ds1593.name: Invincible Sword
ds1593.desc: Uses the sacred sword "Blutgang" to cut the enemy to pieces, or slashes with it to fire a shockwave.

ds1594.name: Quo Vadis
ds1594.desc: Disintegrates the enemy with energy from its spear Gungnir and consigns them to oblivion in another dimension.

ds1595.name: Blutgang
ds1595.desc: A mighty stroke with the sword "Blutgang."

ds1597.name: Dash Blutgang
ds1597.desc: Charges forward and stabs the enemy with "Blutgang."

ds1598.name: Grand Cross
ds1598.desc: Fires ten superheated orbs in a cruciform syzygy.

ds1599.name: Divine Feat
ds1599.desc: Fires a beam of holy energy.

ds1600.name: Vedhaka
ds1600.desc: Disappears into a swirl of light in the sky from which it fires 108 shining Bǎo Shǐ, or breathes flames from its mouth.

ds1601.name: Treasure Arrow
ds1601.desc: Fires the Bǎo Shǐ it creates from its hairs.

ds1602.name: Raurava
ds1602.desc: Imprisons its opponent in a Bǎo Yù and crushes it, completely erasing them.

ds1604.name: Trinity Burst
ds1604.desc: A joint attack with Taomon and Rapidmon in which they transform into streams of light that combine into one and pierce the enemy.

ds1605.name: Assault Balancer
ds1605.desc: Impales the enemy with its Assault Balancer and throws them.

ds1606.name: Megiddo Flame
ds1606.desc: Breathes flame that reduces everything to ash.

ds1607.name: Hell Howling
ds1607.desc: Releases a powerful shock wave from howling.

ds1608.name: Megido Bite
ds1608.desc: Bites its opponents with its jaws ruthlessly.

ds1609.name: Black Sabbath
ds1609.desc: Uses a dark incantation to pray for a festival of death, those who hear this spell will soon die, or fires a dark shock wave from its hand.

ds1610.name: Death Cloud
ds1610.desc: Generates a cloud of darkness which causes everything to decay.

ds1611.name: Vimohana
ds1611.desc: Strikes the ground with its Bǎo Bàng generating a shock wave over the surrounding area.

ds1612.name: Treasure Rod
ds1612.desc: Separates its tail into three nunchaku-like sections and strikes the foe with it.

ds1613.name: Beat Knuckle
ds1613.desc: Assaults the opponent with earth-shattering force using its powerful claws.

ds1614.name: Crack Bite
ds1614.desc: Fragments the data of the area it bites, which may cause them to collapse into malfunction.

ds1615.name: Eden's Javelin
ds1615.desc: Pierces with a javelin glowing with holy light, purifying evil hearts.

ds1616.name: Sefirot Crystal
ds1616.desc: Summons ten crystals in the shape of the Sefirot and releases pink light from the crystals. Alternatively, forms several smaller crystals that directly attack the enemy.

ds1619.name: Eden's Air
ds1619.desc: Creates multiple halos that emit rainbow-colored light, restoring its own energy and that of its allies.

ds1620.name: Vahnijvala
ds1620.desc: Bellows out a sound wave that puts those who hear it to sleep.

ds1621.name: Treasure Bow
ds1621.desc: Fires many arrows of light from a crossbow.

ds1622.name: Strike Fang
ds1622.desc: Incandescently burns the metal plates on each part of it, and it is said that its whole body becomes a mass of flames and rams into the opponent.

ds1623.name: Strike Claw
ds1623.desc: Incandescently burns the metal plates on its claws and cuts the opponent with them.

ds1624.name: Fox Seal Paper
ds1624.desc: Wreathes its talismans around the opponent's body, then detonates them.

ds1625.name: Buddhist Brush Brandish
ds1625.desc: Chants an incantation while painting the Sanskrit character "Hūṃ" in the air with its gigantic brush, then hurls it at the opponent, causing it to explode.

ds1626.name: Oṃ
ds1626.desc: Creates a large hemispherical shield atop a yin-yang sign that Taomon can move at will. It can also be used to electrocute an enemy caught in it.

ds1627.name: Rajas
ds1627.desc: Creates a seal and throws it like a shuriken.

ds1628.name: One Stroke
ds1628.desc: Hits the enemy with a brush stroke.

ds1629.name: One Flash
ds1629.desc: Attacks with a shining brush stroke.

ds1630.name: Fox Seal Paper
ds1630.desc: Wreathes its talismans around the opponent's body, then detonates them.

ds1631.name: Pika Sparking
ds1631.desc: A striking technique using the "Tokaku Tessou" on both of its arms, it is a combo-attack technique unleashed with a great leap and rabbit-like agility.

ds1632.name: Ninja-speed Punch
ds1632.desc: A quick and stealthy Ch'uan Fa which capitalizes on its great leaping power.

ds1633.name: Treasure Sword
ds1633.desc: Crosses its twin Bǎo Jiàn and fires an X-shaped energy beam at the opponent.

ds1634.name: Rodha
ds1634.desc: Uses its forefeet and upper body to strike the ground with its twin Bǎo Jiàn, generating fissures that extend up to 50 m before it. Rocks are also hurled out from the shock waves as they erupt from underground, inflicting damage on those nearby.

ds1635.name: Súkara
ds1635.desc: Bores through the opponent with a red Bǎo Lún.

ds1636.name: Treasure Wheel
ds1636.desc: Spews a wheel of light from its mouth. Its effect differs depending on its color.

ds1637.name: Tummo
ds1637.desc: Releases a high-frequency wave that is an effective charm against evil.

ds1638.name: Blazing Spheres
ds1638.desc: Manifests fireballs from its tail and manipulates them at will.

ds1639.name: Evil Flame Dragon
ds1639.desc: Manifests a dragon of blazing red flames from its tail.

ds1640.name: Time Destroyer
ds1640.desc: 3Fires a spiral of energy that consigns opponents to oblivion across space and time. Creates a tear in space-time to swallow the opponents. Summons meteors and drops them on the enemies.

ds1641.name: Chrono Paradox[N 3]
ds1641.desc: Opens a rift in space-time. Fires two destructive atomic rays from its mouths that freeze opponents in space-time.

ds1642.name: Absorbent Bang
ds1642.desc: Fires a claw-shaped energy beam from its eye, attempting to draw the target into the warped space inside its body.

ds1646.name: Killing Stone
ds1646.desc: Transforms into a stone and releases a poisonous gas.

ds1647.name: Homing Missile
ds1647.desc: Shoots homing missiles from the revolver on its back.

ds1648.name: Transformation
ds1648.desc: Transforms into things close to its body size.

ds1649.name: Fox Leaf Arrowheads
ds1649.desc: Fires a barrage of sharpened leaves at the opponent.

ds1650.name: Fox Switch Deception
ds1650.desc: 34Copies the opponent's appearance. Switches places with the enemy in a whirl of leaves. Teleports to the enemy and kicks them before disappearing.Uses a glowing hand to summon two phantom clones of itself to attack the enemy.

ds1651.name: Tohachi Game
ds1651.desc: Ignites its hands and feet in blue fire and attacks the enemy with them. Hits the enemy with a powerful hand strike.

ds1652.name: Palm Strike
ds1652.desc: Attacks with a strong hand strike.

ds1656.name: Fox Combo Kick
ds1656.desc: Spins about before unleashing several high kicks in rapid succession.

ds1658.name: Giant Missile[N 1]
ds1658.desc: Fires gigantic megaton-class missiles from the gun turrets on its shoulders.

ds1659.name: Saint Foot
ds1659.desc: Butt-bounces the enemy while in midair.

ds1660.name: Saint Upper
ds1660.desc: Activates its thrusters in midair to do an uppercut.

ds1661.name: Saint Tackle
ds1661.desc: Rams with its shoulder while dashing with its thrusters.

ds1662.name: Saint Punch
ds1662.desc: Punches, sending a wave of fiery explosions from its fist.

ds1663.name: Saint Jet
ds1663.desc: Uses its thrusters to slow its descent.

ds1664.name: Mega Twister
ds1664.desc: Charges the opponent, then lifts them up and spins rapidly before tossing them.

ds1665.name: Izuna
ds1665.desc: Summons 4 mystical fox spirits that are imbued with the powers of fire, water, wind and thunder that obey and fight for Sakuyamon.

ds1666.name: Diamond Realm Mandala
ds1666.desc: Strikes the ground with its "Kongou Shakujou", spreading a purifying barrier (in the form of a mandala, golden ring, spherical barrier, cherry blossoms, ball of lightning, or some combination thereof) that exorcises evil spirits.

ds1667.name: Fox Pipe
ds1667.desc: Sends a single fox spirit at the enemy.

ds1669.name: Sliding Flash Attack
ds1669.desc: Attacks by sliding along the ground while standing.

ds1670.name: Thunder Dragon Leg
ds1670.desc: Drops down like lightning from the sky and attacks with a kick.

ds1671.name: Fox Flame Leg
ds1671.desc: Attacks with a flaming kick from the sky.

ds1672.name: Purifying Flame Fox Dance
ds1672.desc: Summons blue flames to surround and burn the opponent.

ds1673.name: Krishńa
ds1673.desc: Impales the opponent by thrashing its body and then powerfully vomiting up a Bǎo Kuí or A poisonous roar that dissolves anything it hits.

ds1674.name: Treasure Lance
ds1674.desc: Produces a spear made of light, from its mouth, and skillfully wields it with its tail.

ds1675.name: Sun's Courage
ds1675.desc: Fires countless holy arrows of sunlight.

ds1676.name: Sekkantou
ds1676.desc: Temporarily prevents the intrusion of evil Viruses, as a kind of Firewall.

ds1678.name: Púyaváha
ds1678.desc: Unleashes an intense lightning strike from its Bǎo Chǔ.

ds1680.name: Skull Whirlwind
ds1680.desc: Spins in the center of a fiery tornado amid which flaming skulls fly.

ds1681.name: Serpent Flame Purgatory
ds1681.desc: Causes flames to erupt at the opponent's feet.

ds1682.name: Skull Dance
ds1682.desc: Grabs the opponent with the Guilty Chain and decapitates them with the Judgment Sickle, or unleashes a rush of slashing attacks with the Judgment Sickle.

ds1683.name: Whirlwind Turbine Kick
ds1683.desc: Rotates its whole body for the ultimate barrage of roundhouse kicks.

ds1685.name: Raiden Blade
ds1685.desc: Unleashes intense energy from its plasma blade.

ds1687.name: Dragon Spine
ds1687.desc: Whips an enemy with its tail.

ds1689.name: Rock Breaker / Rock 'n' Roll Breaker
ds1689.desc: Attacks with sturdy foreclaws capable of breaking rock.

ds1690.name: Fire Rock Breaker
ds1690.desc: A burning version of Rock Breaker.

ds1691.name: Fighting Spirit Gather
ds1691.desc: Concentrates and powers up the damage done by its next attack.

ds1692.name: Crimson
ds1692.desc: Attacks foe with an armor-slicing katana.

ds1693.name: Neck Stretcher
ds1693.desc: Launches from a handstand into an upward kick with both feet.

ds1694.name: Thrust
ds1694.desc: Gathers energy and charges the enemy with its body.

ds1695.name: Fire Mitt
ds1695.desc: Envelops its arm in a Fireball attack and punches the opponent.

ds1696.name: Guil Shot
ds1696.desc: Emits a blast wave from its mouth.

ds1697.name: White Wings
ds1697.desc: Sprouts white wings and flies into the enemy.

ds1698.name: Giant Throw
ds1698.desc: Tosses the enemy with both hands.

ds1699.name: Black Requiem
ds1699.desc: The mouth on its lower torso opens up and spits out dark energy, or a solemn voice from nowhere sings a requiem whose hearers will soon die.

ds1700.name: Hop Hip
ds1700.desc: Bounces like a Super Ball and strikes with its rear.

ds1701.name: Positron Laser Lance
ds1701.desc: Extends the heat sink wings of the Positron Laser and delivers a powerful blow.

ds1702.name: Omega Blade
ds1702.desc: Slashes or stabs a foe with the Omega Blade, resetting and clearing their configuration data.

ds1705.name: Night of Fire
ds1705.desc: Attacks the opponent with flames of darkness.

ds1706.name: Summon
ds1706.desc: 3Summons elementals of flame and ice that can be combined into a ball. Shoots a sphere of darkness at the enemy. Summons many shards of ice and shoots them at the enemy.

ds1707.name: Dash Night of Fire
ds1707.desc: Shoots flames of darkness while running.

ds1708.name: Air Night of Fire
ds1708.desc: Shoots flames of darkness while jumping through the air.

ds1709.name: Dadadada Kick
ds1709.desc: Strikes with small continuous midair kicks.

ds1710.name: Dark Song
ds1710.desc: A scream that lures the enemy to death. Releases a cloud of darkness that stuns the enemy.

ds1711.name: Pillar of Fire
ds1711.desc: Uses Summon to create a wall of flames.

ds1712.name: Night of Blizzard
ds1712.desc: Summons a dark blizzard. Attacks with shards of ice.

ds1713.name: Punch
ds1713.desc: Punches at the enemy, creating a short-range fireball.

ds1714.name: Fire
ds1714.desc: Summons a homing fireball with each hand.

ds1715.name: Fire Shot
ds1715.desc: Lobs homing fireballs into the air.

ds1716.name: Magic Circle
ds1716.desc: A spell that teleports the enemy to Impmon before dealing them repeated damage.

ds1717.name: Reverse Round Kick
ds1717.desc: An upside-down roundhouse kick in midair.

ds1718.name: Adhomukha
ds1718.desc: Blows into its trumpet shell to generate destructive ultrasonic waves or blast enemies with the attacks the shell has absorbed.

ds1719.name: Treasure Shell
ds1719.desc: Beats the enemy with its trumpet shell.

ds1720.name: Justice Kick
ds1720.desc: A flying kick with destructive force that is said to reach 45 tons.

ds1721.name: Trinity Arm
ds1721.desc: Transforms its right arm into the Accel Arm, Critical Arm, or Blitz Arm.

ds1722.name: Blitz Arm
ds1722.desc: Fires spheres of electricity from its Blitz Arm.

ds1723.name: Fiery-heated Bubbles
ds1723.desc: Spits bubbles heated by its high body temperature.

ds1724.name: Poppin' Tear
ds1724.desc: Discharges acidic bubbles from its eyes.

ds1725.name: Krimíśa
ds1725.desc: Splits itself into six bodies and positions them in a hexagram barrier, sealing the opponent inside, then smashing them with the Bǎo Chǔ, deleting them completely.

ds1726.name: Six Clones
ds1726.desc: Creates six clones of itself that tackle the opponent.

ds1727.name: Reverse Izuna
ds1727.desc: Attacks the opponent with the kuda-gitsune carried on its waist.

ds1728.name: Womb Realm Mandala
ds1728.desc: Spreads a purifying barrier with its Shakujou that exorcises evil spirits.

ds1729.name: Fox Flame Dragon
ds1729.desc: Creates a burning dragon out of blue flames from its tails and incinerates the enemy.

ds1730.name: Demon Fireball
ds1730.desc: Causes onibi to manifest from its tails, and manipulates them according to its will to either attack individually or surround the foe and explode in an inferno.

ds1733.name: Amatsu-kitsune
ds1733.desc: Gathers its blue fireballs into a large ball of energy that falls on an enemy unleashes a ring of light.

ds1734.name: Fox Flame Dragon
ds1734.desc: Creates a burning dragon out of blue flames from its tails and incinerates the enemy.

ds1735.name: Retriever-bark
ds1735.desc: Creates a hyper-oscillation with a powerful bark.

ds1736.name: Cure Liqueur
ds1736.desc: Restores and optimizes the data of weakened Digimon.

ds1737.name: Burning Salamander
ds1737.desc: Unleashes a blazing dragon from its flame-clad fist.

ds1738.name: Salamander Break
ds1738.desc: Unleashes a whirlwind kick of flames.

ds1739.name: Fire Darts
ds1739.desc: Throws small bits of fire from its gauntlet at its target.

ds1740.name: Crimson Knuckle
ds1740.desc: A powerful two-step punch. Spins upward as a tornado of fire.

ds1741.name: Burning Slicer
ds1741.desc: A follow up attack from Crimson Knuckle. A chopping attack.

ds1742.name: Blaze Shoot
ds1742.desc: It does a downwards-sloping kick from the air.

ds1743.name: Salamander Kick
ds1743.desc: Dashes forward and launches a kick covered in dragon-shaped flame.

ds1744.name: Gatling Burst
ds1744.desc: Grabs the opponent and punches repeatedly with one hand.

ds1745.name: Million Gatling Burst
ds1745.desc: A stronger version of Gatling Burst.

ds1746.name: Blaze Gust
ds1746.desc: It does a downwards-sloping two-step kick from the air.

ds1747.name: Vortex Strike
ds1747.desc: A follow up attack from Crimson Knuckle. It unleashes a powerful flaming kick.

ds1748.name: Fire Dash
ds1748.desc: A high-speed dash, leaving flames in its wake.

ds1750.name: Elbow Drop
ds1750.desc: Drops from the air to hit an opponent with one elbow.

ds1751.name: Shining Burn Slash
ds1751.desc: A joint attack between Agnimon and Wolfmon. The opponent is surrounded by a flame dragon, and is sliced by holy light.

ds1752.name: Crossfire
ds1752.desc: A joint attack between Agnimon and Shutumon. Agnimon charges into a tornado created by Shutumon, and attacks with a burning fist.

ds1753.name: Brahmashira
ds1753.desc: Uses holy flames to manufacture giant ball of flame like the core of the sun, then detonates it.

ds1754.name: Brahmastra
ds1754.desc: Rapid-fires of high-temperature shots from its "Rudriya Darpaṇa".

ds1755.name: Calamity Thunder
ds1755.desc: A calamitous thunder which brings about super-disasters.

ds1756.name: Tera Blaster
ds1756.desc: A super-electrical attack with a thousand times the power of Giga Blaster.

ds1757.name: Absolute Zero
ds1757.desc: Completely stops electron movement in the entire body of the enemy with super-cold air and a ray of light.

ds1758.name: Sharpness Claymore
ds1758.desc: Cuts the enemy into pieces with its greatswords.

ds1759.name: Omega Burst
ds1759.desc: Induces a super-detonation over the surrounding kilometers with an intense flash.

ds1760.name: Gaia Tornado
ds1760.desc: Gathers the spirit of the land to create a tornado that swallows up the opponent and blows them away.

ds1762.name: Rainbow Symphony
ds1762.desc: Fires a super-fused laser that shines with the seven colors.

ds1763.name: Great Snowplow
ds1763.desc: Charges forward and slams into the enemy with its huge horns.

ds1764.name: Freezing Blizzard
ds1764.desc: Uses its cannons to create an absolute zero super-blizzard.

ds1765.name: Great Maelstrom
ds1765.desc: Generates a gigantic maelstrom which swallows everything in the water.

ds1766.name: Crystal Billow
ds1766.desc: Crystallizes water into super-hard substances, then fires them off like a machine gun.

ds1767.name: Necro Eclipse
ds1767.desc: An ultimate annihilation technique that envelops the enemy in the darkness of death.

ds1768.name: Dark Blast
ds1768.desc: A laser beam fired with a roar.

ds1769.name: Epeius Gimmick
ds1769.desc: Attacks by simultaneously operating every gimmick throughout its body.

ds1770.name: Surprise Cannon
ds1770.desc: Shoots super-massive shells from the huge cannons in its mouth and chest.

ds1771.name: Supernova
ds1771.desc: Generates antimatter in its body to cause a super-detonation like a tiny Big Bang.

ds1772.name: Atomic Bomber
ds1772.desc: Detonates the volcano on its back and performs a super-strong lariat with the propulsion.

ds1773.name: Big Bang Fire
ds1773.desc: Leans forward and fires an explosive stream of lava from its volcano.

ds1774.name: Laplace's Demon
ds1774.desc: With ultimate wisdom, it calculates the coordinates to the spirit world and imprisons the opponent for eternity in a separate universe.

ds1775.name: Elder Sign
ds1775.desc: Summons the ultimate evil god from that universe.

ds1776.name: Machine Gun Dance
ds1776.desc: Unleashes continuous kicks from unexpected directions with its extensible limbs.

ds1777.name: Blockade Seed
ds1777.desc: Fires an enormous seed from the opening in its chest, wrapping the opponent in ivy.

ds1778.name: Justice Massacre
ds1778.desc: Strikes with the Gatling guns on both its arms and the machine guns on its stomach in the name of justice.

ds1779.name: Surprise Attack
ds1779.desc: Disappears from sight and attacks the opponent from behind.

ds1780.name: Helter Skelter
ds1780.desc: Beguiles the opponent with the bewitching charms of its belly dance.

ds1781.name: Vampire Dance
ds1781.desc: Gets close to the opponent while dancing, then sucks out all the blood in their body.

ds1783.name: Bear-cub Punch
ds1783.desc: Punches at the foe with all its might.

ds1784.name: Bear Roll
ds1784.desc: Curls up and rolls into the enemy at high speed.

ds1785.name: Deu: "Knife Claw"
ds1785.desc: Pierces the enemy with its sharp claws.

ds1786.name: Fusionize
ds1786.desc: Turns the enemy into its flesh and blood after defeating them.

ds1787.name: Deu: Two Hander
ds1787.desc: Uses Trinität to form a giant wolf of light and swings the sword at subluminal speed from overhead.

ds1788.name: Deu: Light Attack
ds1788.desc: Assaults the opponent with Roland 2, first with several homing missiles, then a laser beam.

ds1789.name: Deu: Bright Blade
ds1789.desc: Uses Trinität to reflect the opponent's attack.

ds1790.name: Cold Gag
ds1790.desc: Utilises its dubious gaze and cryptic gags to stop opponents in their tracks, as if they have been frozen.

ds1791.name: Straight Man Punch
ds1791.desc: Mentally drains the opponent with a punch with only the power of a straight man's interjections.

ds1792.name: Dark Pupil
ds1792.desc: Fires black beams from its round eyes. Throws poisonous black poop at the enemy.

ds1793.name: Poison Mucus
ds1793.desc: Sprays a sticky, smelly liquid from its mouth that causes the enemy insufferable pain.

ds1794.name: Seven Hells[N 1]
ds1794.desc: Fires seven super-heated spheres of darkness.

ds1795.name: Zeppelin Explosion
ds1795.desc: Fires cannonballs from its topside cannons at the enemy.

ds1796.name: Helium Bomb
ds1796.desc: Fires and detonates bullets of helium gas.

ds1798.name: Jumping Thor Hammer
ds1798.desc: Uses Thor Hammer while in mid-air.

ds1800.name: Punishment Shock
ds1800.desc: Grabs the opponent and attacks it with a continuous barrage of lightning before finishing with a headbutt.

ds1801.name: Gigaton Upper
ds1801.desc: It does an uppercut that sends the opponent flying into the air.

ds1802.name: Gigaton Press
ds1802.desc: A downwards kick from the air.

ds1803.name: Lightning Bomber
ds1803.desc: Gathers lightning on the horn on its head and dives towards the enemy hitting them head first.

ds1804.name: Plasma Double Tomahawk
ds1804.desc: A joint attack between Blitzmon and Blizzarmon. Blitzmon grabs Blizzarmon's tomahawks Eji and Oji and wraps them in electricity, attacking by riding a blizzard created by Blizzarmon.

ds1805.name: Avalanche Step
ds1805.desc: Wields its two tomahawks, "Éji" and "Ōji", to chop up the opponent like it was dancing.

ds1806.name: Glacier Torpedo
ds1806.desc: Restricts the opponent's movement with the extensible hair on its head, then stabs them with the bladed edges until they stop.

ds1807.name: Avalanche Throw
ds1807.desc: Throws its Éji and Ōji like boomerangs.

ds1810.name: Wild Escape Dash
ds1810.desc: Runs away at tremendous speed when it feels it can't win.

ds1811.name: Ultimate Thunder
ds1811.desc: Collects and then fires all of its electrical energy from both its arms.

ds1812.name: Field Destroyer
ds1812.desc: Fires an extremely high-speed positron laser from its head-turret.

ds1813.name: Anti-Ground Ultimate Thunder
ds1813.desc: Fires Ultimate Thunder downwards from the air.

ds1814.name: Gigantic Impact
ds1814.desc: It does a powerful tackle on the opponent to send it flying.

ds1815.name: Death Clash
ds1815.desc: Stabs the opponent with its trident.

ds1817.name: Delicious Patty
ds1817.desc: Places the opponent inside a large, delicious patty and kneads them.

ds1818.name: Green Pickles
ds1818.desc: Throws a pickle-shaped disk at the opponent like a frisbee.

ds1819.name: Spicy Onion
ds1819.desc: Causes the enemy to lose their fighting spirit with onion slices full of pepper.

ds1820.name: Ita: Black Course
ds1820.desc: Spews out corrosive ink from its mouth.

ds1821.name: Titanic Charge
ds1821.desc: Hardens its mantle, spins like a drill, and then smashes into the enemy.

ds1822.name: Deep Forest
ds1822.desc: Tears the enemy apart with its sharp claws, causing their data to disintegrate.

ds1823.name: Rodeo Bullet
ds1823.desc: Fires homing shots from the three gun barrels equipped to its right arm.

ds1824.name: Dyna Cannon
ds1824.desc: Fires beams from the three cannons on its back.

ds1825.name: Grenade Storm
ds1825.desc: Fires grenades from the gun on its front.

ds1826.name: Icicicicle~
ds1826.desc: Takes the shape of an icicle and pounces at the opponent, or transforms into a patch of ice spikes that can stick to surfaces.

ds1827.name: Snow Bomber
ds1827.desc: Blindly fires supercooled snowballs out of Romeo.

ds1828.name: Icicle Punch
ds1828.desc: Attacks with its hard, ice-covered fist.

ds1829.name: Icicle Fall
ds1829.desc: Its body transforms into an icicle shape and falls down from the sky.

ds1830.name: V Jump Attack
ds1830.desc: Wearing its skis, it does a V-shaped jump and assaults the opponent.

ds1831.name: Clinking Hammer
ds1831.desc: Freezes the opponent's feet with its breath, then hits them with an icy uppercut.

ds1833.name: Hyper Infinity Cannon
ds1833.desc: Unleashes two insanely powerful beams of energy from its cannons, using power straight from the Dark Area.

ds1834.name: Chaos Crusher
ds1834.desc: Attacks with the claws and blades of both hands.

ds1835.name: Deu: Destroyed Hook
ds1835.desc: Shoots an organic missile from its right hand, which injects a lethal virus on its victim.

ds1836.name: Angel Ring
ds1836.desc: Generates a ring of light from the protuberance on its calvaria and throws it at the opponent.

ds1837.name: Strawberry Death
ds1837.desc: Dips the Kochikochi-kun in its left hand in red syrup, then strikes the opponent. Freezes the opponent with a blow from its Kochikochi-kun.

ds1838.name: Blue Hawaii Death
ds1838.desc: Dips the Kakikaki-kun in its right hand in blue syrup, then strikes the opponent.

ds1839.name: Sesame Milk Death
ds1839.desc: A powerful attack it unleashes on Gomamon (X-Antibody)'s behalf.

ds1841.name: Fra: "Baptism of Love"
ds1841.desc: A magnificent sword technique using its slender sword, La Pucelle.

ds1842.name: Three-Turret Platform
ds1842.desc: Fires the turrets on its arms.

ds1843.name: Juggernaut Blast
ds1843.desc: Fires an energy beam from its chest cannon.

ds1844.name: Long-Range Buster Cannon
ds1844.desc: Fires the cannon on its back.

ds1845.name: Lizard Dance
ds1845.desc: Uses dance-like movements to cut the opponent with the blades on its arms and Akinakes.

ds1846.name: Akinakes
ds1846.desc: Attacks the foe with a heavy swing from its largest sword, Akinakes.

ds1848.name: Final Excalibur
ds1848.desc: Pierces the enemy with a blade of energy that manifests on its arm.

ds1849.name: Zero Heavens
ds1849.desc: Fires ultra-high-temperature lasers from the shields on its shoulders in every direction.

ds1850.name: Devotion Field
ds1850.desc: Emanates a holy aura from its whole body, granting power to Angel-species Digimon in its surroundings.

ds1851.name: Deu: Ghost Evening
ds1851.desc: 3Makes the eyes on its body glow to hypnotize the opponent. Fires laser beams from all the eyes and mouths on its armor. Powers up its swords and charges while swinging them around.

ds1852.name: Deu: Conquest
ds1852.desc: Absorbs an enemy's power through its Blut Evolution swords. Forms the image of a red moon with its swords and then rushes at the enemy, blades crossed in front of it.

ds1853.name: Deu: Memory Disturbance
ds1853.desc: Uses dark energy to sift through the memories of someone it has grabbed, causing them pain in the process.

ds1854.name: Deu: Blood Strike
ds1854.desc: A rising spinning attack with its demonic "Blut Evolution" swords.

ds1855.name: Ghost Move
ds1855.desc: Uses dark powers to vanish and reappear somewhere else.

ds1856.name: Death Gaze
ds1856.desc: Fires beams from all the eyes on its armor.

ds1857.name: Deu: Conquest Storm
ds1857.desc: Spins, radiating many rings of red energy in the shape of a tornado.

ds1858.name: Chaos Field
ds1858.desc: A joint attack with Wolfmon. Darkness and light become one, creating a space of 'chaos' that is impossible to escape from.

ds1859.name: Nega Cave
ds1859.desc: A joint attack with Gigasmon. Gigasmon causes a crack in the ground, from which Duskmon causes darkness to rise.

ds1860.name: Dragon's Roar
ds1860.desc: Fires energy shots with attributes equal to those of the Warrior Ten from the palms of both its hands.

ds1861.name: Breath of Wyvern
ds1861.desc: Transforms the energy throughout its body into a gigantic wyvern aura.

ds1862.name: Dragon Collider
ds1862.desc: Releases all its energy in the form of phantom dragons that converge on the target in a vortex that reaches the temperature of a star's core in an instant, causing a huge explosion.

ds1865.name: Ita: Tornado Leg(s)
ds1865.desc: Performs a handstand and unleashes a whirlwind kick.

ds1866.name: Ita: Petal Breeze
ds1866.desc: Produces streams of wind from its fingers and flings them at the enemy.

ds1867.name: Ita: Rosy Thunderstorm
ds1867.desc: A barrage of kicks ending with a back-flip kick.

ds1868.name: Ita: Flowery Gust
ds1868.desc: Performs two roundhouse kicks in rapid succession.

ds1869.name: Ita: Astatine Wasp
ds1869.desc: Stomps on the opponent twice while in mid-air.

ds1870.name: Ita: Moon Assault
ds1870.desc: After Astato Vespa, it unleashes a flip kick.

ds1871.name: Two-Step Jump
ds1871.desc: Shoots up into the air after jumping.

ds1872.name: Ita: Virgin Bomb
ds1872.desc: Hits the enemy with its bottom. After being hit, the opponent will fall into confusion.

ds1873.name: Ita: Fairy Dance
ds1873.desc: Unleashes a two-step kick on the opponent, then attacks with a somersault kick.

ds1874.name: Ita: Pretty Hip
ds1874.desc: Hits the enemy with its bottom; immobilizing the enemy for a while.

ds1877.name: Fire Cloud
ds1877.desc: Changes its surroundings into a firestorm.

ds1878.name: Magic Ignition
ds1878.desc: Shoots a blue fireball from its staff.

ds1879.name: Baby Salamander
ds1879.desc: Fires off an aura of flames. Flips through the air covered in fire.

ds1883.name: Marut Cyclone
ds1883.desc: Blows the enemy away with powerful winds, or spins to slice the enemy repeatedly with its Critical Arms.

ds1884.name: Critical Arm
ds1884.desc: Slashes the enemy with the blowtorch-like blades of its arms.

ds1885.name: Phantom Pain
ds1885.desc: Curses the opponent with a breath of darkness that rots their body and data. Can also take the form of dark power released from a magic circle.

ds1886.name: Nazar Nail
ds1886.desc: Uses its golden claw on its right hand to corrode anything they touch.

ds1887.name: Evil Sigh
ds1887.desc: Blows a evil breath upon the enemy.

ds1888.name: Darkness Love
ds1888.desc: Released a lustful heart-shaped aura to disrupt the enemy's mind.

ds1889.name: Empress Emblaze
ds1889.desc: Uses a magic circle to summon an eldritch, hand-shaped monstrosity which attacks the opponent.

ds1890.name: Wheel Grinder
ds1890.desc: Spins and then throws spiked wheels, or extrudes spinning spikes from one of its front wheels and fires them at the end of a cable.

ds1891.name: Steam Bomb
ds1891.desc: Uses bombs of the steam blowing from its smokestack.

ds1892.name: Spiral Masquerade
ds1892.desc: Chops up the opponent with the four sash-blades that extend from its armor.

ds1893.name: Urgent Fear
ds1893.desc: Instantly comes into point-blank range, shooting the opponent in the chest with shock waves from the Pile Bunker on its right arm.

ds1894.name: Eternal Sleep
ds1894.desc: Blasts the enemy with a powerful spear attack.

ds1895.name: Final Meteor
ds1895.desc: Launches a wave of golden energy from its chest.

ds1896.name: Flash Spear
ds1896.desc: Stabs the enemy with its spear.

ds1897.name: Dark Slice
ds1897.desc: A rapid triple thrust with its spear.

ds1900.name: Dark Rocket
ds1900.desc: Kicks off the ground with its spear while dashing to kick the opponent.

ds1901.name: Dark Coffin
ds1901.desc: Transforms into a dark aura that wraps around the enemy.

ds1902.name: Intensive Final Meteor
ds1902.desc: A more powerful, charged-up version of Endlich Meteor.

ds1903.name: Aerial Intensive Final Meteor
ds1903.desc: An aerial version of Intensiv Endlich Meteor.

ds1906.name: Divine Atonement
ds1906.desc: The Seven Great Demon Lords' crests appear on its wings, then fires seven super-powered beams at the opponent.

ds1907.name: Purgatorial Flame
ds1907.desc: Projects a huge flame of darkness from its mouth and sometimes from the Gehenna sphere.

ds1908.name: Dimension Slasher
ds1908.desc: Attacks with sharp claws that can pierce dimensional walls.

ds1909.name: Satan's Wrath
ds1909.desc: Uses the orb, Gehenna, to emit a ray of destruction.

ds1910.name: Machine Gun Destroy
ds1910.desc: 3Simultaneously fires all its artillery weapons at all locked targets, then pulverizes its main target at high speed. Empties each of its artillery weapons in turn, discards them, then fires twin beams from its chest armor before entering its Detached state. While airborne, fires a barrage from its Strike Phantom at the target.

ds1911.name: Starlight Velocity
ds1911.desc: In its Detached state, charges through the enemy at superluminal speeds. Anything that touches the bands of light in its wake is erased.

ds1912.name: Magna Blade
ds1912.desc: In its Detached state, slashes repeatedly with the light sword hidden in its arm.

ds1913.name: Magna Cannon
ds1913.desc: Fires energy bullets from its Sniper Phantom.

ds1914.name: Aero Magna Blade
ds1914.desc: In its Detached state, performs Magna Blade in mid-air.

ds1915.name: Corona Sanctions
ds1915.desc: Attacks with a magnificent aerial assault while clad in flames.

ds1916.name: Endless Surge
ds1916.desc: A shock wave fired from its hands. A combo of punches followed by a pillar of fire.

ds1917.name: Generous Mirror
ds1917.desc: It reflects an attack with its Irony no Tate, or uses the Irony no Tate to fire a blast of light.

ds1918.name: Offset Reflector
ds1918.desc: It catches an attack in one mirror and fires it back from the other mirror with its characteristics reversed.

ds1920.name: Laser Translation
ds1920.desc: Scans the enemy in order to copy their appearance and powers, which it further enhances.

ds1922.name: Cat Claw
ds1922.desc: Scratches the enemy with its foreclaws or with a flying kick.

ds1923.name: Core Dart
ds1923.desc: Surrounds its crystal ball with fire and throws it at its enemies.

ds1924.name: Blast Fire
ds1924.desc: Envelops its sword with a single flame and then delivers a slash attack with increased power.

ds1925.name: Gehenna Flame
ds1925.desc: Spits hellfire from its mouth to inflict death and eternal suffering. Conjures a gigantic sphere of flame many times its own size.

ds1926.name: Necro Interrogation
ds1926.desc: Throw a deadly sphere to inflict great damage.

ds1927.name: Play Possum
ds1927.desc: Dodges the situation by fake sleeping when it gets in a pinch.

ds1929.name: Huh?
ds1929.desc: Swells up with gas and explodes, spreading poison gas and reappearing elsewhere.

ds1930.name: Yippee!
ds1930.desc: It slips on a banana peel, tossing the peel at an enemy.

ds1931.desc: Belches a green bubble of gas that floats toward the enemy.

ds1932.name: Gas!
ds1932.desc: Fills its pants with farts and then flies around like a popped balloon shooting gas everywhere.

ds1934.name: Deep Sorrow
ds1934.desc: Creates a storm of despair with its wings.

ds1935.name: Stun Claw
ds1935.desc: Releases an electric blast from its hands.

ds1936.name: Cosmic Ray
ds1936.desc: Fires a dazzling laser beam from its mouth.

ds1937.name: Tempest
ds1937.desc: Flaps its wings, creating a tempest.

ds1938.name: Heaven's Ripper
ds1938.desc: Charges at the opponent with staggering momentum, cutting them to pieces with the blades covering its body.

ds1939.name: Holy Sword
ds1939.desc: Slashes the opponent with a cross-shaped energy blast.

ds1940.name: Ruin Laser
ds1940.desc: Launches an attack from the back of its arms.

ds1941.name: Tooth-spear
ds1941.desc: Slashes using the tip of its tail.

ds1942.name: Light Nail
ds1942.desc: Slices up its enemies with claws on both arms that radiate with light.

ds1943.name: Light Leg
ds1943.desc: Hits its enemies swiftly like a ray of light.

ds1944.name: Accel Arm
ds1944.desc: Grips and crushes the enemy with its power-type arm.

ds1945.name: Eight Thunder Gods
ds1945.desc: Points ZERO-ARMS: Orochi's sword of light at the heavens, which rain incessant lightning bolts. Summons a spiraling thundercloud from which eight dragons of lightning emerge to attack the enemy.

ds1946.name: Heavenly Wings Beheading
ds1946.desc: Slashes through everything in the world with the blade of light extending from ZERO-ARMS: Orochi.

ds1947.name: ZERO-ARMS: Orochi
ds1947.desc: Fires from ZERO-ARMS: Orochi two spheres of energy, red and blue, that merge and cause a big explosion.

ds1948.name: Thunderstorm
ds1948.desc: Flaps wings clad in electricity, generating a storm of lightning.

ds1949.name: Spark Wing
ds1949.desc: Fires out countless electrically-charged feathers like rain.

ds1950.name: Vegetable Bubbles
ds1950.desc: Blows bubbles from its mouth to make the opponent slippery and files away, leaving only its scent behind while hindering their movements.

ds1953.name: Emergency Brake Spark
ds1953.desc: Suddenly brakes right in front of the enemy, sending hot sparks flying.

ds1954.name: Shining V Force
ds1954.desc: Fires a ray of energy from the massive V on its chest.

ds1955.name: Ulforce Saber
ds1955.desc: Generates a beam-sword weapon from the V Bracelet on its right wrist.

ds1956.name: Dragon Impulse X
ds1956.desc: Surrounds itself in an aura of energy shaped like a dragon, then rams against its target, unleashing both Ulforce Sabers, then slashes its target in an X-shaped pattern.

ds1957.name: Tense-great Shield
ds1957.desc: Generates an energy shield from the V Bracelet on its left wrist. This shield is powered up by the "Ulforce", allowing it to rewrite its data faster than direct deletion attacks can keep up with.

ds1958.name: Mud Pump
ds1958.desc: 3Dispatches soldiers from within. Blasts water from its arms. Fires a stream of projectiles like miniature Valvemon.

ds1959.name: Octagon Attack
ds1959.desc: Attacks the enemy with its arms.

ds1960.name: Valve Extreme
ds1960.desc: Fires a powerful beam of condensed energy.

ds1961.name: Force Rain
ds1961.desc: Fires a barrage of arcing beams.

ds1962.name: Zone Deleter
ds1962.desc: Flaps its wings to blow the opponent and all the space around them into another dimension. Draws a circle around the opponent with the tip of its wing, creating a sphere of darkness that deletes everything caught within it.

ds1963.name: Master of Darkness
ds1963.desc: Converts the opponent's nature to darkness, allowing it to manipulate them. Fires a beam from its central eye.

ds1964.name: Corona Blaster
ds1964.desc: Fires lasers that rival a solar heat ray from the Rudriya Darpaṇa. Jumps into the air, cloaked in flames, performing a double uppercut.

ds1965.name: Flame Storm
ds1965.desc: Sets its whole body aflame, then releases a high-temperature tornado by flapping its wings. Fires a barrage of bolts of flame from the Rudriya Darpaṇa.

ds1966.name: Crimson Fanger
ds1966.desc: Charges the enemy down with the Rudriya Darpaṇa.

ds1967.name: Atomic Corona Blaster
ds1967.desc: Fires a prolonged barrage of lasers from the Rudriya Darpaṇa.

ds1968.name: Salamander Glide
ds1968.desc: Glides through the air, hitting anything in its path.

ds1969.name: Drag Fanger
ds1969.desc: Assaults the enemy as a dragon of flames.

ds1970.name: Fire Below
ds1970.desc: While airborne, fires the Rudriya Darpaṇa downwards at an angle.

ds1971.name: Wildfire
ds1971.desc: Unleashes a massive tornado of flame around itself.

ds1972.name: Pandora Dialogue
ds1972.desc: Repeatedly preserves the opponent's attacks within space and time, then plays them back at high speed.

ds1973.name: Eternal Nirvana
ds1973.desc: Imprisons the opponent within the Space-time Stones for an eternity.

ds1974.name: Deu: "Light Victor"
ds1974.desc: Slashes with the Licht Schwert swords.

ds1978.name: Deu: "Two Victors"
ds1978.desc: Unleashes light-ball from a Licht Schwert cross-slash.

ds1979.name: Deu: "Beam"
ds1979.desc: Release optical lasers from both eyes.

ds1980.name: Deu: "Light Bullet"
ds1980.desc: Fires laser shots from arm cannon.

ds1981.name: Deu: "Threat Ray"
ds1981.desc: Wolfmon grabs his opponent, and quickly connects his Light Swords together, performing a double bladed uppercut-slash.

ds1982.name: Deu: "Light Suit"
ds1982.desc: Wolfmon dashes forward and is consumed by a mass of light energy, which takes the shape of a biting wolf's head.

ds1983.name: Deu: "Ascension"
ds1983.desc: Wolfmon connects his Light Swords and leaps into the air while quickly spinning, rising fast and creating a whirwind around him.

ds1984.name: Deu: "Aerial Slaying"
ds1984.desc: Unleashes a quick blow using its Licht Schwert while in mid-air.

ds1985.name: Deu: "Aerial Light Bullet"
ds1985.desc: Fires Licht Kugel from the air.

ds1986.name: Deu: "Aerial Intensive Light Bullet"
ds1986.desc: Fires Intensiv Licht Kugel from the air.

ds1989.name: Paint Splash
ds1989.desc: Spits out ink from its mouth.

ds1990.name: Electric Bind
ds1990.desc: Binds the opponent with its elongated tentacles and unleashes an intense electric shock.

ds1991.name: Digicabolic Steroid
ds1991.desc: Shoots a jet of slime from the mouth on its abdomen.

ds1992.name: Leaf Cyclone
ds1992.desc: Rotates the leaves around its head and fires them.

ds1993.name: Thousand Spike
ds1993.desc: Makes innumerable roots lurking in the ground pop up onto the surface all at once, skewering enemies in the area.

ds1994.name: Demon's Shout
ds1994.desc: Drives the enemy insane with a curse-filled shout. Controls the action of other Digimon.

ds1995.name: Volcanic Driver
ds1995.desc: Uses the eruptive power of the volcanoes on its shoulders to slam the enemy into the ground head-first.

ds1996.name: Diamond Fist
ds1996.desc: The strongest fist that can pierce even Chrondigizoit.

ds1997.name: N/A
ds1997.desc: Sprinkles a mysterious powder over its opponent that puts them in a happy mood.

ds1998.name: Ragnarök Cannon
ds1998.desc: Blasts a massive energy beam from its chest cannon at its foe.

ds1999.name: Gimlet Gun
ds1999.desc: Pierces the opponent with its tail.

ds2000.name: Spaser
ds2000.desc: Fires an enormous laser from its head.

ds2001.name: Shuttle Scissors
ds2001.desc: Seizes the enemy with its right arm and severs them.

ds2002.name: Satellite Buster
ds2002.desc: Picks off distant enemies with the gun barrels on its shoulders.

ds2003.name: Kirlian Brand
ds2003.desc: Causes a corona discharge brought upon by a 45000-volt electric attack.

ds2004.name: Rising Sun
ds2004.desc: Fires ultra-high temperature spheres from the gun barrels on both of its shoulders.

ds2006.name: Deu: Black Theorem
ds2006.desc: Disables all of the laws of physics in the surrounding region and brings down the opponent.

ds2007.name: Deu: Red Cross
ds2007.desc: Fires an attack from the eyes of the lion on its head.

ds2008.name: Deu: Electro-ball
ds2008.desc: Fires electricity spheres or streams of electricity from its shoulders.

ds2010.name: Rain Stream
ds2010.desc: Concentrates heavy rain over a foe to crush them.

ds2011.name: Jealousy Rain
ds2011.desc: Dissolves all foes with acid rain.

ds2012.name: Regulus Cutter
ds2012.desc: Slashes with its sword to sling a blade of energy.

ds2013.name: Beast King Wave
ds2013.desc: Fires a blast of energy from its open palm.

ds2014.name: Condenser Storm
ds2014.desc: Dynamically wields its horn and liberates all of the electricity accumulated within its body all at once, catching the opponent in a lightning storm.

ds2015.name: Thunder Laser
ds2015.desc: Fires all the electricity accumulated in its horn like a laser.

ds2016.name: Backdraft
ds2016.desc: Gathers oxygen in the air and triggers a violent explosion.

ds2017.name: Heat Breath
ds2017.desc: Spews out scorching-hot flames from its mouth.

ds2018.name: Rumble Blend Number (1-10)
ds2018.desc: Uses attacks with the same attribute as the Warrior Ten.

ds2019.name: Gilgamesh Slicer
ds2019.desc: Cuts the opponent and the atmosphere around it to pieces with the claws on its hands and feet.

ds2020.name: Wind of Pain
ds2020.desc: Flies up into the air and hurls the feathers of its hair and wings as pointed arrows.

ds2021.name: Gilgamesh Upper
ds2021.desc: Hits the foe with a powerful hook.

ds2022.name: Speed Star
ds2022.desc: Charges at ultra-high speed and cuts its opponent to pieces with its Wing Blades.

ds2023.name: Solar Laser
ds2023.desc: Absorbs light energy through its mouth then, at the critical point, spews a laser beam.

ds2024.name: Deu: Blade Windmill
ds2024.desc: Spins into the air, slashing the opponent with all the blades on its body.

ds2025.name: Deu: Militant Attack
ds2025.desc: Glides and uses its Wing Blades and tail to attack.

ds2026.name: Deu: Light Torpedo
ds2026.desc: Charges the opponent while enveloped in light.

ds2027.name: Deu: Blade Whirlwind
ds2027.desc: Spins its body and attacks with its Wing Blades from the air.

ds2028.name: Earthquake
ds2028.desc: Strikes and raises up the ground with intense force after a huge jump.

ds2029.name: Hurricane Bomber
ds2029.desc: Stretches out its arms and then unleashes a double lariat by rapidly spinning.

ds2030.name: Wheel Rush
ds2030.desc: Performs a spinning slash with the rapiers in its hands.

ds2031.name: Sword Dancer
ds2031.desc: Minces the enemy with its long arms as if it were dancing.

ds2032.name: Destroyed Crash
ds2032.desc: Crashes into the opponent with its spiked wheel, or turns the wheel into a spiked ball and fires it at the enemy in segments.

ds2033.name: Limited Express Attack
ds2033.desc: Charges over the enemy at red-hot speed.

ds2034.name: Snake Eye Break
ds2034.desc: Summons one or more of its flexible Grotte Hammers from the ground or its armor and hits the enemy with them. The attack can be used to petrify and smash enemies.

ds2035.name: Jack in the Box
ds2035.desc: Jumps out of the ground and attacks with its Grotte Hammer.

ds2036.name: Bodystrike Reversal

ds2842.name: Absolute Zero Hell Ice Crusher
ds2842.desc: Turns the crank on its head, vomiting a continuous stream of ice shavings that freezes the enemy.

ds2843.name: Arrow of Whispered
ds2843.desc: Hurls a blue blast from its palm.

ds2844.name: Lamenting Sun
ds2844.desc: Generates an enormous dark sun and casts it at the target.

ds2845.name: Sword Masquerade
ds2845.desc: Slashes all enemies with its sword, sometimes confusing them.

ds2846.name: Rainbow Hand
ds2846.desc: Unleashes light from its hand that can put its opponent to sleep.

ds2847.name: Malkut Crystal
ds2847.desc: Damages an opponent with crystals, draining their energy to heal itself.

ds2848.name: Mach Flicker
ds2848.desc: Unleashes a flurry of punches from its flexible arms.

ds2849.name: Flog Shot
ds2849.desc: Chops the opponent with its Tail Anchor.

ds2850.name: Spin Caliber
ds2850.desc: Bisects with a swing of a super-sized Tail Anchor.

ds2851.name: Spiral Shredder
ds2851.desc: Spins rapidly to cut the opponent with its Tail Anchor.

ds2852.name: Prism Garrett
ds2852.desc: Creates spirit-like copies of itself that all slash the opponent at once.

ds2853.name: Eraser Flog Shot
ds2853.desc: DigiXrosed with a giant eraser, then used the eraser replacing its Tail Anchor to erase a monster brought to life by Ekakimon.

ds2854.name: Plasma Crack
ds2854.desc: Unleashes bolts of lightning from the claws on its back, with power comparable to Susanoomon's Yakusa-no-Ikadzuchi.

ds2855.name: Rocket Bunker
ds2855.desc: Unleashes a punch with its extensible arm.

ds2856.name: Gum Roll
ds2856.desc: Wraps the enemy in packing tape.

ds2857.name: Transdelivery
ds2857.desc: Packs the enemy in a cardboard box and hurls it away.

ds2858.name: Belly Balli Dance
ds2858.desc: Bewitches the enemy wth its belly dance.

ds2859.name: Sonic Dancing
ds2859.desc: Dances and emits sound waves from its speaker.

ds2860.name: Cat Speaker
ds2860.desc: Emits a high tone from the speaker in its belly and shatters the opponent.

ds2861.name: Death the Cannon Spiral
ds2861.desc: Fires energy bullets from both its guns that spiral towards the enemy and converge on impact.

ds2865.name: Hard-Swung Homerun
ds2865.desc: Swings the Roketto Dīng​pá with its acceleration at full-throttle, blowing the opponent into the distance.

ds2866.name: Strike, Strike, Strike, Mince
ds2866.desc: Showers the opponent in a high-speed barrage using the Roketto Dīng​pá, crushing them appallingly flat.

ds2867.name: Roast of the Pig
ds2867.desc: Embraces the opponent with its body, which has burst into flames from the fury of its hunger, roasting them well-done.

ds2868.name: God of Death Snatcher
ds2868.desc: Extends its right arm, deleting anything it touches.

ds2869.name: Balefire-Eyes
ds2869.desc: Releases its fathomless power from the red eyes in its chest, transforming all of its surroundings into nothingness.

ds2870.name: Eternal Darkmare
ds2870.desc: Instantly destroys the opponent's data by flapping its jet-black wings.

ds2872.name: Hell's Mantis Dance
ds2872.desc: Spins, swinging its Mantis Arms as it whirls towards the enemy.

ds2873.name: Burning Boogie
ds2873.desc: Fires streams of fire and boiling red liquid from its armor.

ds2874.name: Tuwarmon Missile Storm
ds2874.desc: Fires the spikes from its shoulders as missiles.

ds2875.name: Tyrant Collbrande
ds2875.desc: Transforms its anger into a flaming sword and attacks with it.

ds2876.name: Burning the Dragon
ds2876.desc: Stabs a dragon's vein within the land to modify the terrain and attack enemies.

ds2877.name: Dragon Breastonic Fire
ds2877.desc: Fires streams of flame from symbols on its chest.

ds2878.name: Dragon Breath Tonic Fire
ds2878.desc: Fires streams of flame from the symbols on its chest.

ds2879.name: Artist Sketch
ds2879.desc: Licks a picture, making its subject a reality.

ds2880.name: Colorful Change
ds2880.desc: Changes the color of its attacks, also changing their element in the process.

ds2881.name: Mini Mini Ekakimon
ds2881.desc: Summons small copies of itself to attack the enemy.

ds2882.name: Lightning Shoot
ds2882.desc: Places a ball of light on the ground and shoots it at the enemy.

ds2883.name: Lightning Overhead
ds2883.desc: Lifts the ball high up in the air and shoots it.

ds2884.name: Greatest Sonic Wave
ds2884.desc: Beats its stomach drum and emits a shockwave from its mouth.

ds2885.name: Gold Bowling
