ds2885.desc: Attacks by throwing its collected pool of money.

ds2886.name: Gold Press
ds2886.desc: Uses its entire body to press down on the opponent.

ds2888.name: Mega God of Death Snatcher
ds2888.desc: A more powerful version of DarknessBagramon's God of Death Snatcher.

ds2889.name: Super Powered Rumbling Breaker
ds2889.desc: Fires cataclysmic blasts of energy from its guns.

ds2890.name: Final Strike Roll
ds2890.desc: Performs a forward rolling slash with Olympia Kai drawn and filled with power.

ds2891.name: Night Stalker
ds2891.desc: Extends the Medullia, which pursues the opponent anywhere to swallow them whole.

ds2892.name: Love Poison
ds2892.desc: Uses its glamour to exploit the vitality of the opponents that inhale the toxic mist sprayed from the Medullia's mouth.

ds2893.name: Hebi Punch
ds2893.desc: Strikes the opponent with the Medullia.

ds2895.name: Madness Merry-go-round DX
ds2895.desc: Performs a spinning slash, too quick to catch with the eyes, with the Olympia Kai and Medullia, creating a tornado that instantly tears the opponents it touches limb from limb.

ds2896.name: Strength of Silk and Strike of Thunder Gun

ds2898.name: Nightmare Raid
ds2898.desc: Fires the Evilvil at multiple enemies.

ds2899.name: Bloody Stream Glade
ds2899.desc: Freely extends both of its arms, reliably captures its opponent, and wrenches them apart after forcing them to divulge all their information.

ds2902.name: Flame Hellscythe
ds2902.desc: Slashes the enemy with the Flame Hellscythe covered in infernal flames.

ds2903.name: Demon's Crystal
ds2903.desc: A summoning technique which keeps tormenting the enemy until they die.

ds2904.name: Viking Vuffet
ds2904.desc: Swings its axes down vertically over and over, chopping the opponent to bits.

ds2905.name: Age of Discovery
ds2905.desc: Jörmungandr, from its left shoulder, takes the opponent away to Jötunheimr.

ds2906.name: Dream Comes True
ds2906.desc: Surtr, from its right shoulder, asks for the opponent's wishes and pretends to grant them without actually doing so.

ds2907.name: Dual Tomahawk Boomerang
ds2907.desc: Hurls its Dual Tomahawk axes effortlessly.

ds2908.name: Hell & Thunder
ds2908.desc: Attacks with its sword of lightning and Barbamon-based sword of darkness.

ds2909.name: Heaven & Break
ds2909.desc: Attacks with its holy lance and the spikes on its grappling hand.

ds2910.name: Ice & Fire
ds2910.desc: Attacks with its swords of ice and fire.

ds2912.name: Data to Data
ds2912.desc: Heals itself and increases its strength.

ds2913.name: Omega Death Blade
ds2913.desc: A furious barrage of sword attacks that electrocutes the enemy and may cause their immediate death.

ds2914.name: Infinite Sword Rain
ds2914.desc: Rains swords on all its enemies.

ds2915.name: Heavy Metal Vulcan
ds2915.desc: Fires streams of flaming bullets from its chest.

ds2916.name: Victorize Banking
ds2916.desc: Unleashes flaming V shapes from the V-shaped crest on its head.

ds2917.name: Hard Rock Spirit
ds2917.desc: Channels its burning passion into fire blasts from its palms, which can be flung over a distance or used to strike at close range.

ds2918.name: Beat Slash
ds2918.desc: Turns its feet into blades and drills into the opponent with them. Turns its feet into blades and kicks at the opponent, creating a cutting shockwave.

ds2919.name: Omega the Fusion
ds2919.desc: Channels the Omega inForce into an aura resembling Omegamon, then tackles or shoots it at the opponent.

ds2920.name: Sound Finish
ds2920.desc: Emits ultrasonic waves to immobilize the enemy.

ds2921.name: Giga Scream
ds2921.desc: Sings at full volume and sends out a shock wave.

ds2922.name: Bead-drown
ds2922.desc: Instantly gathers trace elements and converts them to liquid around the opponent's head.

ds2923.name: Poisonous Force
ds2923.desc: Paralyze the enemy force's chain of command

ds2925.name: Shocking Hug-hug Sneaker
ds2925.desc: Repeatedly strikes the opponent with the sneakers on both of its arms.

ds2926.name: Pointy Head
ds2926.desc: Loses control of itself and charges the opponent.

ds2927.name: Anja Serenade
ds2927.desc: Revives itself over and over with the "Anja Serenade" in its heart.

ds2928.name: Speed Nightmare
ds2928.desc: Stabs with the hallucinogens from it's poisonous spear.

ds2929.name: Nightmare Pandemic
ds2929.desc: Uses the poisonous nails from its gloved hands to paralyze the foe. The more fingers used, the worse the effect.

ds2930.name: Fairy Powder
ds2930.desc: Using its fairy dust, it temporarily turns the opponent into a baby Digimon.

ds2931.name: Petermon Syndrome
ds2931.desc: A combo attack with Petermon that forces the foe to follow the duo to Never-Ever Land.

ds2932.name: Mantis Dance
ds2932.desc: Transforms the Mantis Arm while whirling violently like it was dancing, chopping up the opponent in a certain-kill sword performance until there's nothing left.

ds2933.name: Smokin' Boogie
ds2933.desc: Shoots out rainbow-colored fumes and shells in all directions from the Punpun Armor, inflicting damage on the opponent while keeping itself hidden.

ds2934.name: Mantis Arm
ds2934.desc: Throws the Mantis Arm at the opponent.

ds2935.name: Ninja Art: Fūjin's Waves
ds2935.desc: Releases a powerful wave of wind with a move of his arms.

ds2936.name: Digi Ninja Art: Hermit Restoration
ds2936.desc: Using talismans, it undoes a seal.

ds2937.name: Digi Ninja Art: Body Replacement Technique
ds2937.desc: Instantly switches places with a Tuwarmon-shaped dummy.

ds2938.name: Digi Ninja Art: Spider Bind
ds2938.desc: Creates a spiderweb to capture its target.

ds2939.name: Digi Ninja Art: Furoshiki Wrapping
ds2939.desc: Traps the opponent in wrapping cloth.

ds2940.name: Digi Ninja Art: Body Dodging Technique
ds2940.desc: Moves at speeds high enough to look as if it was teleporting.

ds2941.name: Healing Therapy
ds2941.desc: Makes the opponent's fighting spirit vanish just by caressing their head. Hotan heals Venusmon and its allies, then increases their attack's powers.

ds2942.name: LOVE YOU
ds2942.desc: Blows a kiss that makes the opponents who receive it fall over from the shock.

ds2943.name: Peace Fantasia
ds2943.desc: Has Olive prick the opponent in the head, making it have peaceful intentions no matter what kind of ferocious personality it has. Throws Olive at the enemy.

ds2944.name: Bomber Art
ds2944.desc: Radiates flames to use for welding.

ds2945.name: Pinpoint Weapon Works
ds2945.desc: Uses its "Bomber Art" and manufactures then and there an appropriate weapon to fit the situation.

ds2946.name: Appropriate Works
ds2946.desc: Manufactures weapons by performing "Pinpoint Weapon Works" one after another, then equips them to each of its arms in order to fully unleash all of its power.

ds2947.name: Wing Spiral Shredder
ds2947.desc: Rotates at high speed to shred the opponent to pieces with its Tail Anchor..

ds2948.name: Fire Vortex Men
ds2948.desc: Spins with its shinai while leaving a fire trail from it, then strikes at the enemy's head.

ds2950.name: Deu: White Spiral
ds2950.desc: Pierces any enemy with the Sturm Stinger.

ds2951.name: Deu: Black Nail
ds2951.desc: Tears the enemy to pieces with the Zasshu Shield.

ds2952.name: Snipe Headshot
ds2952.desc: Shoots an arrow through the opponent's head.

ds2954.name: Bow Cutter
ds2954.desc: Slashes with the bow on its side as if it were a blade.

ds2955.name: Foot Shot
ds2955.desc: A trick-shot that fires arrows from its feet.

ds2956.name: Turbulence Arrow
ds2956.desc: Fires a random flurry of arrows from its arm without missing a single shot.

ds2957.name: The World Shot
ds2957.desc: Concentrates energy in Indra, then uses its body as a bow, firing Indra through a hole that opens in its abdomen.

ds2958.name: Plasma Railgun
ds2958.desc: Restrains the enemy with the Plasma Railgun on its right hand.

ds2959.name: Trident Fang
ds2959.desc: Chops up the enemy with a single blow from its claws.

ds2960.name: Hyper Launcher
ds2960.desc: Fires a long-range, high-power energy shot.

ds2962.name: Final Strikes
ds2962.desc: Charges while enveloped in light, stabs the oppponent with its claws, and releases energy at point-black range to atomize them.

ds2963.name: Destroy Smasher
ds2963.desc: Spins around very rapidly, firing from the gun on its tail in all directions.

ds2964.name: Coin Toss
ds2964.desc: Tosses a fellow Zenimon at the enemy.

ds2965.name: Snipe Sting
ds2965.desc: Precisely attacks the opponents vitals with its sword.

ds2966.name: Twinkle Shoot
ds2966.desc: Throws its sword, which seeks out the opponent until it lands a blow.

ds2967.name: Midnight Fantasia
ds2967.desc: Manipulates young, sleeping digimon nearby by whistling.

ds2969.name: Raptor Grapple
ds2969.desc: Grabs the foe and lifts them high in the air, then dives down and flings them to the ground.

ds2970.name: Kouyouhoujou: Whirlpool Formation
ds2970.desc: Raises a waterspout by freely spinning its astonishing super-heavyweight class Kouyouhoujou staff.

ds2971.name: Kouyouhoujou: Waterfall Formation
ds2971.desc: Strikes the ground with its staff to shatter it and release a raging current.

ds2972.name: Dù Zichūn Sutra
ds2972.desc: Brings the hearts of wild Digimon back to their senses by making them listen to endless words of gratitude.

ds2973.name: Butterfly Dream Sutra
ds2973.desc: Manifests the ordeals that it has suffered and showers them on the opponent.

ds2974.name: Endless Barraging Heart Sutra
ds2974.desc: Displays an illusion that its scattered rosary beads are endlessly attacking the opponent from all directions in order to crush their spirit.

ds2976.name: Free Death Fall
ds2976.desc: Continuously displays illusions of being knocked to the ground 10,000 times.

ds2977.name: Kill Me
ds2977.desc: Manipulates the surrounding Digimon to assault the enemy who is being haunted.

ds2978.name: Enlightened Pilgrim Palm
ds2978.desc: Enlightens those who challenge it to battle that conflict is meaningless by having them endlessly fight against an illusion on top of its palm, so in the end both their mind and body are exhausted.

ds2979.name: Light of the Spider's Thread
ds2979.desc: Purifies and remedies evil by illuminating the opponent with a halo that cannot be shut out even if they close their eyes.

ds2980.name: Mantra of Neglect
ds2980.desc: Crushes hostility with a thundering voice, knocking the opponent away beyond the horizon.

ds2981.name: Dynamite Soul
ds2981.desc: Rekindles the weakened hearts of dispirited Digimon by shouting passionate phrases at them.

ds2982.name: Astro Bomber
ds2982.desc: Turns into a flaming star that creates a huge crater when it falls to earth.

ds2983.name: Meteor Rock Spirit
ds2983.desc: Shoutmon EX6 fires Shooting Starmon at the enemy with a straight punch.

ds2984.name: Brave Beat Rock Double Xros
ds2984.desc: Fuses OmegaShoutmon's red flames and ZekeGreymon's blue flames, clothes its body with hellfire that purifies all corruption, and assaults the opponents like a meteor, vaporizing them.

ds2985.name: Electric Buster Xros
ds2985.desc: Fires spheres of electricity from the Electric Buster Xros on its right arm.

ds2986.name: Trident JusFang
ds2986.desc: A powerful blow from the claws of the Trident JusFang on its left arm. Slashes with the blades on its right arm.

ds2987.name: Hyper Rock Magnum
ds2987.desc: Fires homing bullets of flame from the Trident JusFang.

ds2988.name: Sol Calibur
ds2988.desc: Slashes with the blade on its right wrist.

ds2989.name: Demolition Horn
ds2989.desc: Unleashes a devastating punch with the drill on its left wrist.

ds2997.name: Helio Slasher
ds2997.desc: Soars towards the opponent and cuts them to pieces while burning them to cinders with a single brandish.

ds2998.name: Space Chakram
ds2998.desc: Launches a ring-shaped vacuum blade to cut the opponent to pieces.

ds2999.name: Xros Shooting Rocker
ds2999.desc: Sets its McField-brand mic on fire, then swings it down on an enemy, causing an explosion in the face of Xros Heart's logo.

ds3000.name: Xros Burning Rocker
ds3000.desc: Uses its passionate soul that longs for peace in the middle of the battlefield to light its McField-brand mic in hellfire, then grandly swings it down.

ds3001.name: Double Flare Buster
ds3001.desc: Shoots all of its energy from the Zanahoria in its left hand.

ds3002.name: Seven Victorize
ds3002.desc: Concentrates its entire aura in its chest and fires it from its "V".

ds3003.name: All Omega the Fusion
ds3003.desc: Covers itself in an Omegamon-shaped aura then charges in.

ds3004.name: Seven Victorize Maximum
ds3004.desc: Concentrates its entire aura in its chest and fires it from its "V", along with six other "V"s.

ds3005.name: Final Xros Blade
ds3005.desc: Slashes its McField-brand mic, which has been transformed into a greatsword by concentrating energy, downward from overhead. This technique only harms Digimon with evil hearts, and resets the data of such Digimon and reduces them to Digitamas.

ds3006.name: Giga Heartbreak Attack
ds3006.desc: Attacks with an electrified heart of pink energy.

ds3007.name: Oni Fire Bullet
ds3007.desc: Shoots a fireball from its mouth.

ds3008.name: Silver Horn Rush
ds3008.desc: Capitalizes on its large build by lowering its back and charging to crush the opponent.

ds3009.name: Gold Silver Thunderclap Attack
ds3009.desc: Exposes the opponent to high voltage when Kinkakumon is aboard in a further addition to the Ginkaku Tokkan.

ds3010.name: Reverse Attack Fire Bullet
ds3010.desc: Fires off the Kiendan while stepping back from an opponent that has challenged it in close combat.

ds3011.name: Fire-Electric Oni Explosive Wave
ds3011.desc: Unleashes a combined attack using Kinkakumon's electricity and Ginkakumon's hellfire.

ds3012.name: Secret Technique: Waking Shadow
ds3012.desc: Deftly handles the Nyoikinkobou and makes sport of the enemy with its acrobatic movements, unleashing an attack of afterimages that makes it look like the opponent is under attack by a horde of Gokuwmon.

ds3013.name: Lightning-speed Attack
ds3013.desc: Pierces the Nyoikinkobou into the ground and extends it to a thundercloud in the sky, then accumulates the thunder energy within itself, and rams the opponent like a bolt of thunder.

ds3014.name: Super-electrified Lightning Cannon
ds3014.desc: Amplifies and fires the energy within the Nyoikinkobou.

ds3015.name: Somersault Cloud
ds3015.desc: Gathers clouds and flies through the sky at high speeds.

ds3018.name: High Gravity Pressure
ds3018.desc: Wraps its hands about the opponent and compresses them.

ds3019.name: Gravity Bang
ds3019.desc: Concentrates the Digital World's gravity either on itself or in the form of an object of solid energy, then detonates all that energy.

ds3020.name: Gigas Spiral
ds3020.desc: Charges the enemy with the Drill Lance.

ds3021.name: Hell Incinerate
ds3021.desc: Incinerates the enemy with a giant tornado of flames.

ds3022.name: Death Destroyer
ds3022.desc: Fires dark shots from the two cannons on its back.

ds3023.name: Ran-gum Break
ds3023.desc: Randomly flails its Shippodzuchi in all directions.

ds3024.name: Jacked Hammer
ds3024.desc: Swings down its super-sized Shippodzuchi while jumping or performing a forward handspring.

ds3025.name: Fire Vortex
ds3025.desc: Strikes a single blow with its Shippodzuchi while performing continuous somersaults at speeds that generate flames.

ds3027.name: Film Buster
ds3027.desc: Turns the power of its enemy's attacks into particles.

ds3028.name: Formation of Photoelectric Execution
ds3028.desc: Synchronizes surrounding Monitamon with itself, allowing it to use them as extensions of itself.

ds3030.name: Hellish Fire Shot
ds3030.desc: Shoots a fireball from the tip of its Denji-maru.

ds3031.name: Explosive Water Dragon
ds3031.desc: Shoots a small waterspout from its Denji-maru.

ds3032.name: Storming Wind Wheel
ds3032.desc: Twirls its Denji-maru to create a tornado.

ds3033.name: Thunderous Lightning Flash
ds3033.desc: Fires a lightning bolt from its Denji-maru.

ds3035.name: Final Traveler
ds3035.desc: Detonates the Fernandina grenade it wears in a suicide attack.

ds3036.name: Galápagos Field
ds3036.desc: Spins the weapons in its hands to generate either a wave that slices the enemy or a sound wave that immobilizes them.

ds3037.name: Timoniniser
ds3037.desc: Fires bullets embedded in its Gunsword that can cause a variety of different effects.

ds3038.name: Ouroboros Gate
ds3038.desc: Draws a circular trail at high speed and summons the "Jashin Ouroboros" from it to sink the opponent into hell.

ds3039.name: Spicy Hard Love
ds3039.desc: Fires a "Random Laser" barrage all over and sweeps away enemies with its "Medullia".

ds3040.name: Sexy Dynamites
ds3040.desc: Slams its bottom into the enemy, causing an explosion of hearts that makes the enemy swoon.

ds3041.name: Oni Explosive Funeral
ds3041.desc: Swings the Shichisei Kanabou from overhead and pulverizes the whole ground.

ds3042.name: Anger-mind Anger-Oni Angry-Moxibustion(Thump-Thump-Thump)
ds3042.desc: Discharges a high-tension current from its whole body as an all-purpose technique that excels in offense and defense.

ds3043.name: Lightning Oni Kick
ds3043.desc: Attacks with a lightning-speed, surprise kick that conceals an electric shock to paralyze the opponent.

ds3044.name: Wise Sword
ds3044.desc: Hurls a wave of blue energy from the Wise Sword.

ds3045.name: Strength in Solidarity
ds3045.desc: All Kozenimon attack the enemy together.

ds3046.name: ¥UE-N
ds3046.desc: All Kozenimon create a shock wave by crying out.

ds3049.name: Striking With Fists
ds3049.desc: Both Gankoomon and Hinukamuy unleash a barrage of punches.

ds3050.name: Earthquake! Lightning! Fire! Father!
ds3050.desc: Summons an earthquake, lightning bolts and an eruption of fire, then Hinukamuy deals a hammer-like punch.

ds3051.name: Flipping the Chabudai
ds3051.desc: Grabs the ground and upends it like a chabudai as hard as Chrome Digizoid.

ds3052.name: Lightening Feel
ds3052.desc: Makes the immediate future bright for anyone with a pure heart in its vicinity.

ds3053.name: Lumina Flash
ds3053.desc: Dazzles the enemy with the lumens it has accumulated in the ring on its head.

ds3055.name: Infinity Prism Garrett
ds3055.desc: Turns its drills into burning energy which bore through the enemy.

ds3056.name: Heavy the Shot
ds3056.desc: Shoots a beam from the gun on its torso.

ds3057.name: Dorulu Checkmate
ds3057.desc: Shoots a tornado with beams in it by spinning its tail-drill.

ds3058.name: Sexy the Cannon
ds3058.desc: Shoots a beam from the fused Medullia/Berenjena SDX after enlarging it.

ds3060.name: Oxygen Sorrow Blue
ds3060.desc: Fires an oxygen-powered blast of wave energy.

ds3062.name: Beniazuma Straight
ds3062.desc: Uses its right fist to deliver a strike packed with all of its power.

ds3063.name: Beniazuma Uppercut
ds3063.desc: Uses its left fist, packed with piping hot steam, to strike the enemy and send them flying together with the rising heat.

ds3065.name: Gypt Particle Cannon
ds3065.desc: Emits the Gypt Particles generated within its large wicked sphere to the entire surroundings, and if anyone touches them even slightly, they will spread throughout their entire body and completely erase them without leaving any data behind.

ds3066.name: Ruin Blast
ds3066.desc: Pours Gypt Particles inside a seized enemy's body through its tentacles, and causes them to explode from within.

ds3067.name: Copy
ds3067.desc: Quickly creates copies of itself or Digimon it has absorbed.

ds3068.name: Divine Pierce
ds3068.desc: Pierces the opponent with the Cross Barbée. Fires a yellow beam of energy from the tip of the Cross Barbée.

ds3069.name: Protect Wave
ds3069.desc: Generates a protective wave by stabbing the Cross Barbée's butt end into the ground.

ds3070.name: Grand Sister Cruz
ds3070.desc: Performs a coordinated attack with Sistermon Noir.

ds3072.name: Mickey Bullet
ds3072.desc: Rapidly fires bullets from both Anthony guns at random directions.

ds3073.name: Bless Fire
ds3073.desc: Rapidly fires bullets from both Anthony guns in a straight line.

ds3075.name: Fif Slash
ds3075.desc: Cuts the opponent to pieces with its sturdy claws.

ds3076.name: Teen Ram
ds3076.desc: Rotates its tail like a drill and thrusts it into the opponent.

ds3077.name: Lunatic Slash
ds3077.desc: Hunts the enemy down with its scythe, which can hurl energy blades.

ds3078.name: Gaia Magicar
ds3078.desc: Activates a magic circle beneath the enemy that fires a beam upwards, erasing them completely.

ds3079.name: Lightning Pile
ds3079.desc: Forms a pile out of lightning and impales the enemy with it from overhead, driving them into the ground.

ds3080.name: Bolt Break Knockdown
ds3080.desc: Rushes in and attacks with fists shrouded in lightning from its horn.

ds3081.name: Charging Strike
ds3081.desc: Uses its leg strength for a high speed charge that stabs the opponent's head with its horn.

ds3082.name: Penetra-laser
ds3082.desc: Fires a beam from the fingertips of its Mechanization Powered Arm.

ds3083.name: Powered Ignition
ds3083.desc: Gathers energy in the palm of the Mechanization Powered Arm while it's attached, then releases it in a single charge.

ds3084.name: Bramble Bite
ds3084.desc: Changes the thorns at the end of its Buster into an evil spirit that bites the enemy.

ds3085.name: Plant Zone Cradle
ds3085.desc: Fires thorns from all over its body in all directions.

ds3086.name: Attract Echo
ds3086.desc: Plays a song with its Syrinx that makes listeners lose their sense of self and see only Aegiomon.

ds3087.name: Iron Trust
ds3087.desc: A backwards kick with its prided goat legs.

ds3088.name: Stun Beat Blow
ds3088.desc: Beats up its opponent while releasing eletricity from its arms that numbs them and dulls their movements.

ds3089.name: Destruction Trigger
ds3089.desc: Stomps on the opponent, then fires an explosive bullet from its legs at point-blank range.

ds3090.name: Misery Bullet Rain
ds3090.desc: A barrage of energy bullets from its fingers followed by a barrage of live ammunition from its entire body.

ds3091.name: Cook of the Hell
ds3091.desc: Wraps up the opponent in both of its hands, transforming their configuration data into drinking snacks, and then eating them.

ds3092.name: Party of the Heaven
ds3092.desc: Refines alcohol mixed with deadly poisons that cause sleep or paralysis within its body, then pours it over the opponent to incapacitate them.

ds3093.name: Reverse of the Dead
ds3093.desc: Fires the data it has consumed from its abdominal mouth as a destructive beam when it becomes too intoxicated and the patterns on its body turn pale.

ds3094.name: Fly Bullet
ds3094.desc: Homes in on the enemy's vitals with the "Fly Bullet" fired from the Rizoma de Loto.

ds3095.name: Hurricane Screw Shot
ds3095.desc: Wildly fires the guns hidden in the heels of its boots with a keen Senpukyaku.

ds3097.name: Inferno Divide
ds3097.desc: Bites the opponent using the jaws on its hands and fires flaming bullets at point-blank range.

ds3098.name: Cerberus Erase
ds3098.desc: Slices the opponent up using the claws on its legs.

ds3099.name: Lat: "Hunger"
ds3099.desc: Freely manipulates plants to absorb all of the opponent's energy.

ds3100.name: Fruits Flechette
ds3100.desc: Scatters the highly poisonous, unripe fruit from the "Karpos Hulē" over a wide range, transforming its surroundings into a land of death with poison upon impact.

ds3101.name: Island Freefall
ds3101.desc: Slams its huge body against the opponent, inflicting damage from the intense shock wave and vibrations around the area where it falls.

ds3102.name: Burning Blood Shell[N 1]
ds3102.desc: Fires a magma bodily fluid from its mouth as an enormous flame shot.

ds3103.name: Phales
ds3103.desc: Attacks the enemy with vines, poisoning them and draining their health.

ds3105.name: Bind Red Trigger
ds3105.desc: Stabs the opponent with the tiny machine guns on the ends of the magazines extending from its hips, immediately destroying them from within.

ds3106.name: Happy Bullet Showering
ds3106.desc: Soars into the air and showers the opponent with live ammunition and plasma shots from the guns of its legs and fingers.

ds3107.name: Soul Core Attack
ds3107.desc: Slices through both the armor and body of the enemy in a single slash of the Zanjintou, with enough force to strike their Digicore.

ds3108.name: Traceless Phantom Blade
ds3108.desc: Torments the enemy with hallucinations after being pierced with the Zanjintou, plaguing their spirit with endless suffering until they die.

ds3109.name: Dark Army Pact
ds3109.desc: Summons phantom warriors with the skulls on both its arms, creating an immortal army which tramples all enemies.

ds3110.name: Haggard Cluster
ds3110.desc: Unleashes the fangs on its chest to release a darkness, that absorbs all substances and vaporizes everything.

ds3111.name: Chaos Rights
ds3111.desc: Chews the enemy with the mouths all over its body.

ds3112.name: Hell's Gate
ds3112.desc: Causes a gigantic mouth to appear from the darkness and swallows villains whole, and disassembles those who have been swallowed into scraps of fragmented data.

ds3113.name: Terror's Cluster
ds3113.desc: Extends forth the battery on its back and fires its large-scale electromagnetic cannon.

ds3114.name: Rust Breath
ds3114.desc: Spews deep scarlet flames that induce a rusting effect on whatever they touch.

ds3115.name: Rust Claw
ds3115.desc: Attacks enemies with its sharp nails.

ds3116.name: No.1<<Polyphony>>
ds3116.desc: Sings a song in a high soprano, whose notes suffuse the listener's heart and numb their free will, leaving them at Sirenmon's mercy.

ds3117.name: No.2<<Aria>>
ds3117.desc: Sings a solemn song in a low bass, which becomes a deep bass frequency wave that flattens the enemy through their semicircular canals, so that they are unable to even stand.

ds3118.name: No.3<<Canon>>
ds3118.desc: Attacks the enemy using its singing voice as note-shaped shots, which are said to have the marvellous trait of ricocheting to always strike their targets, even separate enemies.

ds3119.name: Divine Pierce (Awake)
ds3119.desc: A more powerful version of Divine Pierce.

ds3120.name: Protect Wave (Awake)
ds3120.desc: A more powerful version of Protect Wave.

ds3122.name: Mickey Bullet (Awake)
ds3122.desc: A more powerful version of Mickey Bullet.

ds3123.name: Bless Fire (Awake)
ds3123.desc: A more powerful version of Bless Fire.

ds3124.name: Mabolt
ds3124.desc: Constructs an array of tiny thunder clouds, summoned by exchanging blows with the opponent using the hammers in both of its hands, which automatically looses thunderbolts at those it judges as evil or those who hinder its arbitration.

ds3125.name: Punish Judge
ds3125.desc: Engraves a seal on the bodies of the opponents strucks by its hammer, bestowing a reprieve to their punishments unless it decides to carry out the sentence, at which point they're smote with the thunder of an immense electric current.

ds3126.name: Wide Plasment
ds3126.desc: Converts its body into extremely high-voltage plasma, inflicting divine punishment all around itself so that all those who are touched by it are completely disintegrated.

ds3127.name: Triangler
ds3127.desc: Chops up the enemy with its three scythes.

ds3128.name: Plasmadness
ds3128.desc: Showers the enemy with electric shocks gathered in its hands.

ds3129.name: Death Dinner
ds3129.desc: Mounts and preys on the opponent.

ds3130.name: Lightning Shower
ds3130.desc: Strikes the enemy by causing countless daggers to rain down upon them from above.

ds3131.name: Thunder Slash
ds3131.desc: Combines its daggers with lightning to create a whip-like trail, which it uses to slice enemies apart.

ds3132.name: Circlet Defense
ds3132.desc: Expands its impregnable defensive walls to counter the opponent's attacks by deflecting them, while adding electric sparks to the deflected attacks.

ds3133.name: Manliness-Wrath Dust
ds3133.desc: Reflects the beam fired from the Kanshakudama in its abdomen off of falling stones, resulting in an attack with a large area of effect.

ds3134.name: Sky-wave Reversal
ds3134.desc: Grips the enemy in its right hand and hammer-throws them into the distance

ds3135.name: World-Excavating Claw Drill
ds3135.desc: Impales the enemy with the gigantic excavator on its left hand, which is capable of pulverising even Chrome Digizoid alloy.

ds3136.name: Absolute Territory
ds3136.desc: Tears the enemy to pieces as well as the space around them with its yo-yos.

ds3137.name: Twin Petal
ds3137.desc: Unleashes a flashkick with its gorgeous legs.

ds3138.name: Nightmare Assemble
ds3138.desc: Pierces the enemy with its yo-yos and absorbs them.

ds3139.name: Thousand Blasting
ds3139.desc: Hammers out its brotherly Black Hickeys from the Ougon Batto.

ds3140.name: Strike of the Man's Spirit
ds3140.desc: Extends the prison chains sported on its entire body as it charges towards the enemy.

ds3141.name: Golden Rush
ds3141.desc: Uses its favourite clubs Ougon Batto, to beat enemies to a pulp.

ds3143.name: Bloody Finish
ds3143.desc: Skewers enemies with the drills on both arms.

ds3144.name: Explosive Thunderstorm
ds3144.desc: Releases bug-shaped mines that self-destruct when they hit enemies.

ds3145.name: Redbutt
ds3145.desc: Headbutts an enemy hard enough to shatter their face.

ds3146.name: Fif Cross
ds3146.desc: Slashes with the sharp nails on both hands.

ds3147.name: Burn Flame
ds3147.desc: A fire attack that intercepts the enemy with pinpoint accuracy

ds3148.name: Dragless-spiker
ds3148.desc: Kicks the enemy with the blades on its legs.

ds3149.name: Teen Blade
ds3149.desc: Spins its bladed tail like a whirlwind, cutting the foe.

ds3150.name: Resist Raid
ds3150.desc: Skewers through the enemy from a flying kick posture with the blades on its feet.

ds3151.name: Meteor Flame
ds3151.desc: Rapid-fires fire shots from its mouth like a machine gun, burning the enemy to cinders.

ds3152.name: Trident Saber
ds3152.desc: Assaults the enemy with the three red blades equipped to its tail and arms, relentlessly cleaving them apart whether they're swathed in Chrome Digizoid or not.

ds3153.name: Deu: "Violence Enthusiast"
ds3153.desc: Fires a volley in all directions.

ds3154.name: Deu: "Burst Cross"
ds3154.desc: Pins the enemy to the ground with its feet and shoots them at point-blank range.

ds3155.name: Deu: "The Blitz"
ds3155.desc: Picks off the enemy's vitals with the six-chambered revolvers on both of its hands.

ds3156.name: Furrow-sword Judgment
ds3156.desc: Slices the enemy to pieces with the blades on its arms while moving at high speed.

ds3157.name: Deu: "Sword Ghost"
ds3157.desc: Uses an omnidirectional counter technique alongside "Atho", "René", and "Por" that meets every enemy attack with their nine blades.

ds3158.name: OS Generics
ds3158.desc: Temporarily rewrites its own data to perform actions that transcend the laws of nature. Zigzags in the air, leaving behind afterimages, then slashes the enemy in the shape of an X with the blades on its arms.

ds3159.name: Fra: "One For All"
ds3159.desc: Fires a beam of energy from a triangular shield formed by "Atho", "René", and "Por".

ds3160.name: Love Basket
ds3160.desc: Summons thunderclouds to enhance Jupitermon's power.

ds3161.name: Needle Hive
ds3161.desc: Repeatedly stabs the enemy with the katars equipped to both its arms.

ds3162.name: Grace Lance
ds3162.desc: Auto-attacks surrounding enemies with its sentient lances.

ds3163.name: Welcome Lost
ds3163.desc: Continuously stabs the opponent with the lances on both its arms, destroying their life-force.

ds3164.name: Lingrudge
ds3164.desc: Crushes the enemies it captures with the chains covering its whole body after they spit out words of confession.

ds3165.name: Liar Banishment
ds3165.desc: Causes a hologram of Jupitermon to appear, instantly vaporizing enemies that lay their eyes upon it.

ds3166.name: Grc: "Lightning Divide"
ds3166.desc: Slashes the enemy with a single swing of the Keraunós it wields with both hands.

ds3167.name: Lightning Be
ds3167.desc: Looses thunderbolts to where it points.

ds3168.name: Esp: "God Thunder"
ds3168.desc: Drops the Keraunós from high in the sky to cast its final judgment upon defeated sinners.

ds3169.name: Holy Desire
ds3169.desc: Destroys evildoers with arrows of light fired from its right arm.

ds3170.name: Dark Despair
ds3170.desc: Crushes and deletes captured opponents with its left hand, including their Digicores.

ds3171.name: Chaos Degrade
ds3171.desc: Fuses the energy of light and darkness from its arms to produce a gate to another dimension, consigning the enemy to oblivion.

ds3172.name: X Scratch
ds3172.desc: Swipes at the opponent with both paws' claws, forming an X shape.

ds3173.name: Trichobezoar
ds3173.desc: Spits out a data-destroying hairball from its mouth.

ds3174.name: Shut Claw
ds3174.desc: Scratches the opponent with its sharp claws.

ds3175.name: Berserk Thinking
ds3175.desc: Slashes with both arms' Cursed Claws, forming an X shape.

ds3176.name: Felt Made
ds3176.desc: Creates copies of itself with the lures it sends flying from its body.

ds3177.name: Cursed Claw
ds3177.desc: Slashes the opponent with the sharp claws projecting out of its armor.

ds3178.name: Garuru Sword
ds3178.desc: With the Garuru Sword on the right arm, perform a multi-hit attack.

ds3179.name: Grey Cannon
ds3179.desc: With the Grey Cannon on the left arm, perform a multi-hit attack.

ds3180.name: Volcanic Flare
ds3180.desc: Spews scorching-hot flames from its mouth.

ds3181.name: Glide Blaze
ds3181.desc: Rams the enemy while sending out scorching flames hotter than even magma from its whole body.

ds3182.name: Petit Flame
ds3182.desc: Spews out a small, high-temperature flame from its mouth.

ds3183.name: Plasma Stake
ds3183.desc: Reinforces its heavyweight grappling with electricity, striking with the "Plasma Stakes" on both arms, which send electric current flowing into even the sturdiest of structures and destroying them from within.

ds3184.name: Thunder Vernier
ds3184.desc: Rotates the "Thunder Verniers" on its back to face forward, from which it fires electricity, or uses them while faced backwards to propel it forward.

ds3185.name: Elec Guard
ds3185.desc: Releases plasma particles into its surroundings and uses them to erect a barrier around it.

ds3187.name: Great Beast-Wolf Rotation
ds3187.desc: Spins its entire body and attacks the opponent while turning into a blade.

ds3188.name: Fury: Ice Moon Fang
ds3188.desc: Molds the Kijū Engetsutou into countless forms using ice, and then hurls it at the opponent.

ds3189.name: Grasslash
ds3189.desc: Slices the enemy with the blades on both arms.

ds3190.name: Blindead
ds3190.desc: Fires a beam attack from its chest, which deals massive damage and carves a '20' mark into the enemy if it lands a direct hit.

ds3191.name: Deu: "Twenty-Sparkling"
ds3191.desc: Focuses its fighting spirit into the blades on both arms and slices the enemy with them.

ds3192.name: Deu: "Throne Knife"
ds3192.desc: Spins its body to slice multiple enemies in one fell swoop.

ds3193.name: Merudainā
ds3193.desc: Fires a laser-shaped heat ray from its mouth.

ds3194.name: Wild Blast
ds3194.desc: Scatters mineral dust by flapping its wings and causes an explosion.

ds3195.name: Great Flame
ds3195.desc: Takes a deep breath and spits out the largest fireball it can make.

ds3196.name: Earth-stamp
ds3196.desc: Uses its forearms to lunge at and slam onto the opponent.

ds3197.name: Wall Rake
ds3197.desc: Uses the Wall Rake it wields on both arms to attack and defend.

ds3198.name: Modestly Stun
ds3198.desc: Restrains the enemy with its two appendages, paralyzing them with the stinger on its tail.

ds3199.name: End of the World
ds3199.desc: Fires a jet-black wave from its mouth that destroys all data.

ds3200.name: Magna Visibility
ds3200.desc: An omnidirectional attack where it launches the two orbs embedded in its wings to attack the enemies around it.

ds3201.name: Summon Apocalypse
ds3201.desc: Its falling feathers transform into countless Digimon and attack, bringing terror and despair to not only this attack's targets, but also all who witness it.

ds3202.name: Ita: "Palaces' Waltz"
ds3202.desc: Uses magic to make copies of the "Spiedini" swords its carries on its waist and sends them flying from every direction.

ds3203.name: Quarzione
ds3203.desc: Fires bullets from its two "Ala di Pollo" guns that lodge themselves inside the enemy's body, attacking and annihilating them from within.

ds3204.name: Road T(w)o Decade
ds3204.desc: Thrusts straight into the enemy's chest while shouting "Twentiestttt!!".

ds3205.name: Fra: "Twentieth"
ds3205.desc: Curls its body into a ball and spins towards the enemy, slicing them with its tail blade.

ds3208.name: Form Taranis
ds3208.desc: Shreds the opponent with its claws and the tip of its tail, injecting impaled opponents with corrosive data.

ds3209.name: Purhorus
ds3209.desc: Fires laser bullets from the gemstones on its claw armor and chest armor.

ds3210.name: Darkness Zone
ds3210.desc: Slams its claw armor together and fires a barrage of thorns from their gemstones.

ds3211.name: Knowledge Stream
ds3211.desc: Freely combines the five elements from the magic circles on both of its arms and releases enormous energy.

ds3212.name: Sefer Raziel
ds3212.desc: Brings about any kind of miracle to exterminate the adversary.

ds3215.name: White Clover Horizontal Slash
ds3215.desc: Cuts down the enemy without making a sound by using its cherished sword Shirotsume-Ichimonji.

ds3216.name: White Murder
ds3216.desc: Rapidly throws the two knives it hides within its sleeves.

ds3217.name: Piercing Wasp
ds3217.desc: Stabs the enemies at close range using the knives planted on its feet after letting their guard down.

ds3221.name: Eclipse Finger
ds3221.desc: Focuses the amplified energy within its body in the palms of its hands, and melts the enemy by touching them.

ds3222.name: Lat: Calydon Bow
ds3222.desc: Fires the eight "Meleagros" blades it wears on its back to pursue the enemy until they are destroyed.

ds3223.name: Infinity Dream
ds3223.desc: Flaps its wings to stir up a gust that spreads its scales. While this attack is capable of inflicting poison or paralysis on the enemy, its main function is actually to ease the pain and suffering of its wounded allies.

ds3224.name: Esp: Fly Bullet - Second
ds3224.desc: Fires "Fly Bullet" from the Rizoma de Loto across the battlefield endlessly in all directions and attacks with its unpredictable trajectory.

ds3225.name: Esp: Zero Distance
ds3225.desc: Finishes the enemy off with a zero-distance shooting attack that the enemy cannot see.

ds3226.name: Baby Hail
ds3226.desc: Spits countless icicles from its mouth.

ds3227.name: Ice Mash
ds3227.desc: Attacks continuously with the claws on both hands.

ds3228.name: Crimson Storm
ds3228.desc: Unleashes a blaze from its flaming wings.

ds3229.name: Blast Smash
ds3229.desc: Detaches its wings, shrouding itself in a barrier of flame as it charges towards the enemy.

ds3230.name: Knock
ds3230.desc: Pokes at the opponent with the brim of its hat.

ds3231.name: Hjaðningar Waltz
ds3231.desc: Spins its Kyūkyoku Senjūken Dáinsleif Dáinsleif at the speed of light, reducing targets within a 3 km radius to ash. Those whose have witness this technique turn into data dust without even realizing that they were "attacked".

ds3233.name: Grand Gríðr
ds3233.desc: Removes the blades on both of its arms and throws them as tomahawks.

ds3234.name: Frozen Claw
ds3234.desc: Tears the enemy to pieces with the ice claws equipped to both of its arms, and then freezes their wounds.

ds3235.name: Callous Dimension
ds3235.desc: Generates a snowsquall which causes everything around it to be frozen in ice, including the enemy.

ds3236.name: Rewind Abyss 13
ds3236.desc: The vilest, most wicked curse, invoked when it opens its hidden thirteenth eye, that causes a Digimon to forcibly degenerate at the end of the countdown.

ds3237.name: Spooky Zapper
ds3237.desc: Rotates its body like a spinning top, and tears the enemy to pieces with its enormous claws and hidden arms.

ds3238.name: Fatal Gaze
ds3238.desc: Absorbs the data of enemies that gaze at the twelve eyes all over its body.

ds3239.name: Baby Blaze
ds3239.desc: Spews out flames from its mouth, to be carried by the wind and cover a wider range when attacking.

ds3240.name: Smash Horn
ds3240.desc: Charges at the enemy with its ultra-high temperature horns.

ds3241.name: Lightning Stinger
ds3241.desc: Skewers the enemy and injecting energy into them that destroys their data.

ds3242.name: Crimson Slash
ds3242.desc: Whirls in a continuous slashing attack with both claws.

ds3243.name: Lord of Fraternity
ds3243.desc: Expands its sash-blades, which have amassed the power of Knightmon, and tears the opponent apart in a dance-like manner.

ds3244.name: Fra: Nobility of Red
ds3244.desc: Locks the enemies' movements with rose petals generated from the Rose's Pile Bunker and precisely impales their Digicore with its Rose's Fencer.

ds3245.name: Kyūkyoku Sentotsuken Gran Rozerio
ds3245.desc: Unleashes a shock wave that blows away any and all who stand on the battlefield from its strongest Pile Bunker, Gran Rozerio, formed by combining its shield and sword.

ds3246.name: Lat: Haunted Hair
ds3246.desc: Freely stretches its hair and sets Ulula and Serpens loose.

ds3247.name: Crazy-go-round
ds3247.desc: Generates a large tornado of blue flames after performing a powerful horizontal spinning slash.

ds3248.name: Lat: Sacred Cannon
ds3248.desc: Fires an energy cannon from the crystal on its shield.

ds3249.name: Fear-Tingling Katana
ds3249.desc: With the Grey Sword transformed into the katana on the left arm, performs a multi-hit and long-range attack.

ds3250.name: Refined-Lapides Cannon
ds3250.desc: With the Garuru Cannon on the right arm, fires cold air at absolute zero in the form of a laser.

ds3251.name: Ice Age
ds3251.desc: Freezes the enemy with its breath.

ds3252.name: Meteor Hail
ds3252.desc: Charges from the sky as if it were a giant block of ice.

ds3253.name: Surtr Brander
ds3253.desc: Fires arrows of light enveloped in hellfire, burning all to cinders from its Ultimate-Battle-Crossbow Einherjar.

ds3254.name: Niflheimr Arrest
ds3254.desc: Absolute zero cold air generated by the sacred "Niflheimr" shields equipped on each pair of its arms that freezes the surface of the ground and causes all vital functions to be brought to a complete halt.

ds3255.name: Vermilion Vortex
ds3255.desc: Causes red, drill-shaped spears to protrude from all over its body, annihilating multiple enemies in one go.

ds3256.name: Giga Crimson Dive
ds3256.desc: Charges forth while spinning at high speed, attacking with its quills.

ds3257.name: Dai Bacchi Gū
ds3257.desc: Enlarges the badge on its chest and hurls it.

ds3258.name: Frisbicker
ds3258.desc: Throws the shields on its arms.

ds3259.name: Assault Claw
ds3259.desc: Charges at high speed and attacks with its claws.

ds3260.name: Crimson Breath
ds3260.desc: An upgraded version of its original Fire Breath. Spews deep crimson flames that are the same color as its body.

ds3261.name: Crash Rolling
ds3261.desc: Curls its entire body up and rush forward at tremendous speed, then slices up any enemy that approaches with the ridge on its back.

ds3262.name: Pacifier
ds3262.desc: Takes in a deep breath and shoots the inhaled air out together with its pacifier in order to intimidate the opponent.

ds3263.name: Prickly Rolling
ds3263.desc: Curls itself into a ball and does a jump-tackle while spinning.

ds3264.name: Ballet Gun
ds3264.desc: Fires its sleeve like a cannon, using the large flower petals that dance around it as reflectors. Uses the shots from its sleeve with its reflectors to form a net that imprisons the opponent.

ds3265.name: Dut: Change
ds3265.desc: Sheds scales that latch onto the opponent, making them lose consciousness and become Rafflesimon's servants.

ds3266.name: Direct Smasher
ds3266.desc: Bisects the enemy in a single stroke by cleaving its sword down from a high altitude.

ds3267.name: Ignition Prominence
ds3267.desc: Spews extremely high temperature flames from its shield, turning its surroundings into a sea of fire.

ds3268.name: Duel Edge-Flowsion
ds3268.desc: Impales the enemy with its sword wreathed in its shield's flames, completely incinerating and erasing the enemy.

ds3269.name: Lightning Buster
ds3269.desc: Generates electricity at high output from its head and uses it to strike the enemy.

ds3271.name: Tai Chi Revolution
ds3271.desc: Fires a spinning yin-yang attack that slices up all who come close.

ds3272.name: Fox-Butterfly Illusion
ds3272.desc: Changes the texture of its surroundings, inviting the enemy into a world of illusions.

ds3273.name: All Forms of the Plum Blossom Warrioress
ds3273.desc: Turns all of the objects around it into countless shikigami, enveloping the enemy in a storm of flowers and annihilating them.

ds3274.name: Uka-no-Mitama
ds3274.desc: Fuses its four kuda-gitsune into a single gigantic fox spirit and summons it.

ds3276.name: Kenzan Dive
ds3276.desc: Curls its body up into a ball and charges forth.

ds3277.name: Iron-Fist Judgment
ds3277.desc: Pummels the opponent with an iron fist by shooting out its Tactical Arms.

ds3278.name: Deu: "Sword Wing"
ds3278.desc: Fires off the swords and continuously slashes at the opponent with its two great-swords.

ds3279.name: Ultimate-Battle-Blade Seibaken (Holy Conqueror Sword)
ds3279.desc: Pulls out its Ultimate-Battle-Blade Seibaken from the Digicore in its chest, then destroys the fighting spirit of any opponent it cuts.

ds3280.name: Clanging
ds3280.desc: Strikes at the opponent with the sharp corners of its shield.

ds3281.name: BB Burner
ds3281.desc: Releases the flames stored in its mouth in one shot.

ds3282.name: Grand Holy Arrow
ds3282.desc: Transfers power from surrounding elements and releases it as a lightning arrow.

ds3283.name: Seventh Jewelrize
ds3283.desc: Transforms the enemy's Digicore that it scoops out with its right hand into a jewel using the Crown of Greed.

ds3284.name: Seventh Penetrate
ds3284.desc: Uses the power of the Crown of Sloth to emit a crimson energy wave from each of its claws at maximum power

ds3285.name: Darkness Prison
ds3285.desc: Expands the dark globe in its abdomen, eternally trapping the consciousness of anyone who comes into contact with it in darkness.

ds3286.name: Shocking Hug You
ds3286.desc: Hugs evil Digimon that it has given up on, sending an electric shock through their body and reducing them to ashes.

ds3287.name: Extreme Tailer
ds3287.desc: Compresses the Vaccine energy charged up in its wings and fires it from its tail.

ds3288.name: Cruel Tornado
ds3288.desc: Crushes the opponent with a tornado created by its Vortex-spear.

ds3289.name: Deadly Break Lost
ds3289.desc: Splits the opponent apart with a cross-slash with its Cyclone Deathscythe.

ds3290.name: Flame Snatch
ds3290.desc: Grabs an enemy with its flaming left claw and burns it.

ds3291.name: Inferno Burst
ds3291.desc: Transforms into a blazing demon god enveloped in its Flame Inferno.

ds3292.name: Seventh Graviton
ds3292.desc: Fires supergravity lasers from its shoulders and part of its abdomen, erasing all of its surroundings and reducing it to ash.

ds3293.name: Pendragon Sparkle
ds3293.desc: Impales the enemy with its fully unleashed "Kyūkyoku Senryūsou Ambrosius", and looses large thunderbolts from its Dragonic Plasma.

ds3294.name: Thunder Sword Bureiragaha
ds3294.desc: Twelve swords appear from the lightning that falls from its Dragonic Plasma, which it fires at the enemy.

ds3295.name: Ultimate-Battle-Dragonlance-Ambrosius
ds3295.desc: A sentient, high-energy lance. The amount of energy it releases varies depending on how strong the opponent is.

ds3296.name: Ultimate-Battle-Technique-Tengyouken
ds3296.desc: A flawless, pulverizing uppercut that condenses all of its energy in its right hand, ignoring all defenses.

ds3297.name: Tetsu Geta Harite
ds3297.desc: Deals heavy blows with its Tetsu Geta.

ds3298.name: Lat: Deadly Tail
ds3298.desc: Skewers the enemy with its tentacle-shaped tails all at once.

ds3299.name: Lat: Three-pronged Snout
ds3299.desc: Crunches the enemy with its three split jaws.

ds3300.name: Seventh Lightning
ds3300.desc: It unleashes extremely powerful lightning from its three horns once the envy energy contained within it reaches its peak and the Crown of Envy shines, which is said to sink continents into the ocean.

ds3301.name: Seventh Fascinate
ds3301.desc: Draws out power from the Crown of Lust to control others over a vast range.

ds3302.name: Fi-rost Typhoon
ds3302.desc: A Unison Technique where it inhales air at the exact same time as Terriermon and expels it as a mixture of hot and cold air.

ds3303.name: Esp: Seventh Divine Cross
ds3303.desc: Arranges ten super-heated spheres of light in a cruciform syzygy and fires light of annihilation.

ds3305.name: Merry Merry Destruction
ds3305.desc: Unleashes a vast amount of magical power from its umbrella.

ds3306.name: X-radicate
ds3306.desc: Burns anything without leaving a trace.

ds3307.name: Pandemic Destroyer
ds3307.desc: Fires viral energy in its Blast Mode.

ds3308.name: Energy Blitz
ds3308.desc: Flies at critical velocity, and pierces the enemy in its Blitz Mode.

ds3309.name: Laser Cannon
ds3309.desc: Annihilates things in a straight line with a powerful beam that it accumulates in the laser gun on its tail. The light that is emitted the moment this technique is invoked can be seen even from places 10 km away, and those who have witnessed it directly at close range are blinded by its overwhelming radiance.

ds3310.name: Laser Saber
ds3310.desc: Sets the laser on its tail to being a sword, then charges and slashes with it at high speed.

ds3311.name: Lovely Splash
ds3311.desc: Repels the enemy by pouring a large amount of Lovely Gel over them. This technique becomes more powerful as the support for Monzaemon increases.

ds3312.name: Trick or Treat Wallace
ds3312.desc: Manifests giant pumpkin-shaped bombs in the air to blow up everything around it.

ds3314.name: Atlantic Dam
ds3314.desc: Pours a huge amount of pumpkin soup into the enemy's body, making them explode. Uses pumpkin soup to put out flames.

ds3315.name: Poop Rush
ds3315.desc: Throws a barrage of poop together with its tiny Numemon all at once.

ds3316.name: Holy Material
ds3316.desc: Spins the Eden's Lance, generates a large number of magic circles around it and fires holy light, reducing evil enemies to ashes.

ds3317.name: Eden's Lance
ds3317.desc: A weapon formed by combining the armor on its shoulders.

ds3319.name: Destiny Death Destruction (Death 3)
ds3319.desc: Transforms its six arms into gigantic spears, and fires beams that erase everything they touch.

ds3320.name: Flare Rock Spirit
ds3320.desc: Its passion turns into crystal claws which drastically increases its power.

ds3321.name: Heavy Heat Vulcan
ds3321.desc: Rapid-fires tiny fireballs; each shot is Mega Flame-class.

ds3322.name: Zeal Magnum
ds3322.desc: Charges its hands with scorching-hot energy shots that never cool down, and then fires them.

ds3323.name: WEEK END
ds3323.desc: Swings down its guitar like an axe

ds3324.name: Vampire Theory
ds3324.desc: Wraps the enemy in its cape and turns them into a bat.

ds3325.name: Bloody Drain
ds3325.desc: Pierces the enemy with the claws on its cape and absorbs their data.

ds3326.name: Meteorizer
ds3326.desc: Exterminates evil enemies by charging from the skies at lightspeed.

ds3327.name: Secret Wall
ds3327.desc: A barrier that wards off evil in its surroundings.

ds3328.name: Golden Square
ds3328.desc: Fires purifying beams from the crystals on its wings and forelegs.

ds3329.name: Rapid Blaster
ds3329.desc: Rapid-fires the Armed Arms on its back at long-range, which has a low attenuation rate.

ds3330.name: Laser Gatling Arm
ds3330.desc: Rapid-fires the Armed Arms on both of its arms at close-to-mid-range.

ds3331.name: Billion Bullet
ds3331.desc: Detaches all of the Armed Arms, cornering the enemy by operating them remotely, and shooting them up with a billion bullets.

ds3332.name: Gyro Smash
ds3332.desc: Dishes out a powerful punch while spinning the blades on its arm.

ds3333.name: Qualialise Blast
ds3333.desc: Spins its blades at extremely high speed, creating tornadoes that strike the opponent.

ds3334.name: Spiral Vanish
ds3334.desc: Shoots out and fuses its spines to form a gigantic drill, which it uses with the emotion energy it has stored to impale the opponent.

ds3335.name: Lat: Spines Qualialise Blast
ds3335.desc: A stronger version of Qualialise Blast with one arm using the power of Rasenmon: Fury Mode.

ds3336.name: Desperate Vortex
ds3336.desc: Extends its large, spiral-shaped tails and skewers the opponent over and over again.

ds3337.name: Predator's Bite
ds3337.desc: Pounces on the opponent, devouring their Digicore directly.

ds3338.name: Spiral Hell
ds3338.desc: Indiscriminately attacks by rapidly spinning the blades on its wrists, tearing apart everything in their surroundings while generating tornadoes.

ds3339.name: Sunrise Buster
ds3339.desc: Charges its energy to the maximum, and fires it from the Trident Revolver.

ds3340.name: Slash Thrust
ds3340.desc: A slash technique that has extraordinary sharpness.

ds3341.name: Barbarian-killing Ball
ds3341.desc: Turns into a ball of light and attacks evil.

ds3342.name: Summon Frost
ds3342.desc: Spreads cold air over a wide range, instantly transforming anyone that draws near into statues of ice.

ds3343.name: Absolute Blast
ds3343.desc: Unleashes an absolute zero wave from the dragon jaws on its left shoulder which shatters everything.

ds3344.name: Hecto Edge Blizzard
ds3344.desc: Causes countless ice swords to fall down like a blizzard.

ds3345.name: Summon Chaser
ds3345.desc: Summons flame and ice elementals to chase the opponent persistently.

ds3348.name: Sonic Vulcan
ds3348.desc: Fires high-speed machine guns from its shoulders.

ds3349.name: Deu: Knife Spiral
ds3349.desc: Charges while spinning at high speed.

ds3350.name: N.S.B.M
ds3350.desc: Intercepts the enemy with a laser fired from its tail, even if they get behind it.

ds3351.name: Sacred Fist Destroyer
ds3351.desc: Unleashes a subluminal combo-attack that succeeds Gankoomon's secret technique

ds3352.name: Knights' Intruder
ds3352.desc: Becomes a vessel for the fourteenth Ultimate-Battle-Blade that should not exist, by concentrating the energy of the Royal Knights, turning into an offensive judgment sword that instantly erases the opponent no matter how strong they are.

ds3353.name: Justice X Kick
ds3353.desc: Performs a jump kick with its Accel Leg which is said to reach 100 tons in destructive force.

ds3354.name: Justice X Punch
ds3354.desc: A punch unleashed from its Blitz Arm.

ds3355.name: Justice X Blade
ds3355.desc: Cuts the enemy with its Critical Arm.

ds3356.name: Deu: "Grieve"
ds3356.desc: Destroys the enemy's body from within using its chain.

ds3357.name: Deu: "End Break"
ds3357.desc: Crushes the enemy's Digicore directly with its Zerdrücken.

ds3358.name: Gaze Eraser
ds3358.desc: Fires cursed beams from all of the eyes on its tentacles.

ds3359.name: Gala-lightness
ds3359.desc: Seizes the enemy with its tentacles and swallows them whole with its central mouth.

ds3360.name: White Liner
ds3360.desc: Fires a white beam from its central mouth.

ds3361.name: Strash Salamander
ds3361.desc: Uses the spear on its tail as a weapon and skewers the enemy with it.

ds3362.name: Red Reamer
ds3362.desc: Burns the enemy with high-intensity red lasers emitted from the tips of its claws.

ds3363.name: Gaia Brave
ds3363.desc: Converts the flames of courage contained within it into an ultra-high temperature energy shot and then releases it.

ds3364.name: Agumon's Courage
ds3364.desc: Increases the power of its, and its allies', attacks.

ds3365.name: Brute Knuckle
ds3365.desc: Curls up the tentacles on its arms into balls and punches with them.

ds3366.name: Volt Line
ds3366.desc: Sends an electric shock through the enemy.

ds3367.name: Mount Stone
ds3367.desc: Hurls the rocks on its arms.

ds3368.name: Glide Rocks
ds3368.desc: Strikes the enemy with its rock-covered tail at tremendous speed.

ds3369.name: Psychic Chain
ds3369.desc: Constricts the enemy with psychokinetic chains, and drives them away.

ds3370.name: Cloud Vision
ds3370.desc: Spews out clouds that cause hallucinations.

ds3372.name: Lightning Heel
ds3372.desc: Lands an axe kick into the opponent's skull with lightning.

ds3373.name: Buden Blast
ds3373.desc: Fires oversized energy shots from its held-out palms.

ds3374.name: Storm of Blows
ds3374.desc: Dishes out a series of kicking and punching techniques without giving the opponent a chance to strike back.

ds3375.name: Electrical Fist
ds3375.desc: Sends the enemy flying with a blow from its electricity-laced fist.

ds3376.name: Thunder Dread
ds3376.desc: Unleashes an electric attack by discharging the electrical energy stored in its horn.

ds3377.name: Core Electrical Fist
ds3377.desc: A stronger version of Electrical Fist, powered up by the energy of Bulkmon's Digicore.

ds3378.name: Dark Wing
ds3378.desc: Flaps its tattered wings, causing dark bullets to rain down.

ds3379.name: Static Electricity
ds3379.desc: Emits static electricity from the tip of its horn.

ds3381.name: Mias-spew
ds3381.desc: Crushes the opponent with its two arms, which materialize as a result of its overflowing negative data.

ds3382.name: Dryad Stinger
ds3382.desc: Skewers the enemy with its sharp stake-like tusks.

ds3383.name: Blasted Disaster
ds3383.desc: Spews a black miasma consisting of countless tiny insects that thrive on the opponent's data, causing them to completely wither up.

ds3384.name: Mirror Guard
ds3384.desc: Spreads its panel-shaped wings to protect itself or the target.

ds3385.name: Mirror Dust
ds3385.desc: Detaches its panel-shaped wings and sends them flying at the enemy.

ds3386.name: Bolt Rip
ds3386.desc: Mixes its scales with electric shocks gathered in its palms and fires them at the enemy.

ds3387.name: Beat Press
ds3387.desc: Crushes the enemy with its gigantic hands.

ds3388.name: Hexa-thunder
ds3388.desc: Unleashes an electric attack from its antennae.

ds3389.name: Cutting Edge
ds3389.desc: Throws the panel-shaped energy in its hands to slash the enemy.

ds3390.name: Aurora Stream
ds3390.desc: Fires a beam from its chest.

ds3391.name: Cruelty Rain
ds3391.desc: Enlarges the panels that it protects itself with, causing them to rain down over the enemy, crushing them.

ds3392.name: Insec Mind
ds3392.desc: A telepathic ability that manifests using its antennae as a medium.

ds3393.name: Defibrilla-shock
ds3393.desc: Touches the opponent with its palms, which act as positive and negative electrodes, delivering an electric shock.

ds3394.name: Wicked Thought Eye
ds3394.desc: Cursed beams fired from all of its eyes.

ds3395.name: Deceptive Illusion
ds3395.desc: Transforms the data it has accumulated into objects and uses them both offensively and defensively.

ds3396.name: Shadow Bind
ds3396.desc: Enters the enemy's shadow and controls its movements.

ds3397.name: Full Metal Machine Gun
ds3397.desc: Causes a downpour of iron to rain down from the Cowl Parts on its arms.

ds3398.name: Cool Edge
ds3398.desc: Purges the Cowl Parts and unleashes an instant attack.

ds3399.name: Moon Tense
ds3399.desc: Fires laser beams in all directions.

ds3401.name: Gabumon's Friendship
ds3401.desc: Increases the critical hit rate of its, and its allies', attacks.

ds3402.name: Full Throttle Edge
ds3402.desc: Tears the enemy to pieces with the blades protruding from various parts.

ds3403.name: Madness Fire
ds3403.desc: Indiscriminately shoots with the four gun muzzles mounted to the sides of its front wheel.

ds3404.name: Trinity Gospel
ds3404.desc: Fires energy shots from the three mouths on its head and arms.

ds3405.name: Acid Injection
ds3405.desc: Skewers the enemy with its three tails and injects a strong acid into their body.

ds3406.name: Poseidon Vortex
ds3406.desc: Generates a large whirlpool by rapidly spinning its whole body.

ds3407.name: Aqua Viper
ds3407.desc: Vaporizes its surroundings with a massive amount of energy released from the tip of its horn.

ds3408.name: Positron Blaster
ds3408.desc: Concentrates energy into the "Alterous" and fires subluminal bombardments.

ds3409.name: Alter Blade
ds3409.desc: Converts the energy it has accumulated into a positron blade.

ds3410.name: Dead Shot
ds3410.desc: The weapon on its left arm which also loaded from the Digimon it has sealed. Its power has dropped dramatically due to the data being compressed.

ds3411.name: Hinder Miasma
ds3411.desc: Deprives the enemy of their freedom with the mist released from its cage.

ds3412.name: Roaring Flame Wheels
ds3412.desc: Fires its blazing wheels along with a gust of wind.

ds3413.name: Ash and Thunderclap Eye
ds3413.desc: Strikes down the enemy with lightning that never misses, unleashed from its eye.

ds3414.name: Resounding Scent Water Moon
ds3414.desc: Heals injuries received in battle with the element of water.

ds3415.name: Intense/Scales Therapy
ds3415.desc: Fluttering scales shaken off of its wings that have the effect of soothing the mind and body, or conversely, paralyzing the body, and are used for different purposes depending on the opponent.

ds3416.name: Paralyze Lick
ds3416.desc: Uses its tongue, which secretes a numbing venom, to lick.

ds3417.name: Downer Eye
ds3417.desc: Makes the enemy Digimon prey on themselves with the curse of its "Downer Eye".

ds3418.name: Annihilention
ds3418.desc: Fires red-hot beams from its eyes.

ds3419.name: Rudiment
ds3419.desc: Condenses the energy within its body, and breathes it out of its mouth in the form of a wave.

ds3420.name: Scissors Sword
ds3420.desc: Splits any enemy in two with the sword on its right arm.

ds3421.name: Beetle Cannon
ds3421.desc: Shoots at the enemy with a volley fire using the weapon on its left arm.

ds3422.name: Grit Nail
ds3422.desc: Transforms its forelimbs to being claw-shaped and scratches with them.

ds3423.name: Sand Blast
ds3423.desc: Shaves off the enemy's body with sand that it spits out aggressively.

ds3424.name: Suckerfish Darts
ds3424.desc: Fires organic missiles from its abdomen to slow down its prey.

ds3425.name: Flying Finish
ds3425.desc: Unleashes a high-speed slash attack with its sharp fins to finish off its prey.

ds3426.name: Petally Carnage
ds3426.desc: Disperses a large amount of explosive pollen from the petals around its neck.

ds3427.name: Tropical Venom
ds3427.desc: A gas spewed out of its mouth which causes those who inhale it to melt into mush from within.

ds3428.name: Kaus-slugger
ds3428.desc: Emits sharp blades from the Sagittarius that head towards the enemy as they form an arc.

ds3429.name: Alnas Shot
ds3429.desc: A double laser cannon that accurately picks off the enemy's vitals.

ds3430.name: Palsy Sweet
ds3430.desc: Spews a numbing gas out of its mouth, depriving invading enemies of their freedom.

ds3431.name: Wavy Oktavist
ds3431.desc: Emits a super-low-pitched cry that crushes even rocks at a loud volume, and engulfs several tens of meters around it in a whirlpool of destruction.

ds3432.name: Cruel Invite
ds3432.desc: Drags its target underwater by impaling them with its caudal fin, which is sharpened like a fish hook.

ds3433.name: Calamity Vise
ds3433.desc: Rapidly oscillates as it gnaws through its prey, puncturing their body, killing them.

ds3434.name: Rapid Seed
ds3434.desc: Spits out countless seed-like bullets from its mouth.

ds3436.name: Elec Rush
ds3436.desc: Rams into the enemy with all its might at lightning speed.

ds3437.name: Petit Impulse
ds3437.desc: Discharges electricity generated within its body from its hair.

ds3438.name: Vanquish Missile
ds3438.desc: Fires a large quantity of missiles from its left arm.

ds3439.name: Maximum Demolisher
ds3439.desc: Pulverizes the enemy's body as it minces them with the heavy machinery on its right arm.

ds3440.name: Briona Strike
ds3440.desc: Pierces the enemy with the sword in its right hand, accompanied by a flash of lightning.

ds3441.name: Reactor Discharge
ds3441.desc: Blows away everything around it, including seawater, with plasma discharged from its pincer.

ds3442.name: Lightning Rush
ds3442.desc: Charges the enemy at super speed from their blind spot.

ds3443.name: Heartbeat Impulse
ds3443.desc: Shoots energy blades from its tail that slice enemies apart.

ds3444.name: Refuge Mist
ds3444.desc: Spreads a poisonous, lachrymatory mist from its coral when attacked by intruders.

ds3445.name: Coral Pressure
ds3445.desc: Releases high-pressure water from the ends of its arms.

ds3446.name: Little Plasma
ds3446.desc: Fires weak energy shots from its palms.

ds3447.name: Jack Raid
ds3447.desc: Turns invisible moments before charging and crashing into the enemy, striking them from behind while they are in a state of confusion.

ds3448.name: Giant Grater
ds3448.desc: Grinds the enemy with the crystals on its arms.

ds3449.name: Curse Reflection
ds3449.desc: Fires the light energy it has accumulated from the tips of its crystals.

ds3450.name: Brunt Claw
ds3450.desc: The sharp claws on its forelimbs that it uses to fight back against intruders as they draw near.

ds3451.name: Colony Torpedo
ds3451.desc: Small fish-shaped biological weapons fired from its back. Despite having a slow underwater speed, their nature is similar to that of mines in that they trigger a huge explosion on contact.

ds3452.name: Barrage Sweeper
ds3452.desc: Shoots at long range, firing a barrage with the autocannon deployed from its left shoulder.

ds3453.name: Resting Burner
ds3453.desc: A mid-range attack where it expels ultra-high temperature flames from the lion armor on its chest.

ds3454.name: Sonic Excavator
ds3454.desc: A very-close range technique where it impales the enemy by launching its Pile Bunker while charging with its fighting spirit at its maximum.

ds3455.name: Parabolic Junk
ds3455.desc: Hits the sack at the bottom of its cannon with its tail, and shoots junk parts out of it to drive away invading enemies.

ds3456.name: Scrap Teeth
ds3456.desc: Bites into the enemy with its prided foreteeth.

ds3457.name: Dual Sword Stance Lightning
ds3457.desc: Cuts down the enemy with the lightning swords it holds by dual wielding them.

ds3458.name: Chivalry Tenacity
ds3458.desc: Erects a barrier of lightning and forces the enemy into a one-on-one battle.

ds3459.name: Divine Electricity-summoned Lightning
ds3459.desc: Condenses the electrical energy in its surroundings and fires an ultra-high density shot of lightning.

ds3460.name: Eclipse None
ds3460.desc: Makes the energy that it shoots from both of its hands stick to the enemy, corroding them, and gnawing away at their whole body.

ds3461.name: Bingerard
ds3461.desc: Transforms its right arm into a spear and pierces with it.

ds3462.name: Death Charge
ds3462.desc: Transforms its left arm into a gun barrel and fires energy shots.

ds3463.name: Grc: Windswept
ds3463.desc: Confuses the enemy with afterimages caused by its high-speed movement.

ds3464.name: Grc: Asteroid
ds3464.desc: A kicking technique that it dishes out using its swift speed.

ds3465.name: Grc: Ruthless Spear
ds3465.desc: Throws its divine spear and ensures that it pierces the enemy's Digicore.

ds3466.name: Assault Hatchet
ds3466.desc: Strikes the enemy with an all-purpose hatchet that cuts down even large trees in an instant.

ds3467.name: Tied-up Ivy
ds3467.desc: Restrains the enemy with the tentacles growing from the back of its head.

ds3468.name: Shotgun Moss
ds3468.desc: Counterattacks enemies that attack from a distance by shooting poisonous grass needles that grow from its head like hair to restrict their movements.

ds3469.name: Double Lariat
ds3469.desc: Mows down enemies in its surroundings by spinning both of its large arms.

ds3470.name: Petit Tornado
ds3470.desc: A small tornado generated by the propeller rotation of both its ears.

ds3471.name: Hop Dump
ds3471.desc: Jumps high into the sky and then crushes the enemy with its large build.

ds3472.name: Sorblow
ds3472.desc: Punches the enemy with the flames it amasses in its hands.

ds3473.name: Sorshot
ds3473.desc: Hurls the flames in its hands.

ds3474.name: Boxmeow
ds3474.desc: Hits the enemy with the corner of its delivery bag that it swings down.

ds3475.name: Multiple Seed
ds3475.desc: Shoots countless seeds from the petals on its left shoulder like a machine gun.

ds3476.name: Sprout Rush
ds3476.desc: Pierces the enemy with the flower spear it holds in its right hand.

ds3477.name: Esp: Great of the Sun
ds3477.desc: Fires an extremely wide beam with the huge sword of light that appears from within its flower spear only when it has bloomed.

ds3478.name: Ear-strike
ds3478.desc: Slaps the opponent with its ears.

ds3479.name: Gallia Fissure
ds3479.desc: Tears the enemy to pieces with its tough claws, boasts the power to easily cut through Chrome Digizoid, if it has a low purity.

ds3480.name: Dragonia
ds3480.desc: Closes its wings and charges like a bullet of light.

ds3481.name: Lat: "Meteor Light"
ds3481.desc: The light from its spread wings rains down as a meteor shower.

ds3482.name: Gran Nova
ds3482.desc: Gathers all the energy in its body and fires the brightest fireball from its mouth, enveloping the enemy in a scorching-hot star.

ds3483.name: False Escape Isolation
ds3483.desc: A mimicry technique where it blends itself into its surroundings, and uses it to creep up stealthily on the enemy.

ds3484.name: Crack Piton
ds3484.desc: A long-range attack in which it throws its pitons.

ds3485.name: Dynamic Scyther
ds3485.desc: Spreads out its pickaxe arms and tears the enemy to pieces while spinning.

ds3486.name: Fillet Blade
ds3486.desc: Slashes the enemy with the sharp fins all over its body.

ds3487.name: Ripple Edge
ds3487.desc: Hurls pressurized water like a blade.

ds3488.name: Liquid Veil
ds3488.desc: Envelops itself in water armor, enhancing its physical ability and allowing it exhibit the same strength in places without water as it does when it is underwater.

ds3489.name: Innocence Blizzard
ds3489.desc: A ranged attack in which it generates a blizzard with its tail and wings.

ds3490.name: Freezing Ray
ds3490.desc: Instantly turns the enemy into dry ice with a cold beam fired from its mouth.

ds3491.name: Ruin Reverb
ds3491.desc: Sings with a beautiful cry that charms the listener, and causes those who finish listening to it to completely shatter internally.

ds3492.name: Removal Blow
ds3492.desc: Unleashes a punch attack with its enormous right arm while charging.

ds3493.name: Defrost Blade
ds3493.desc: Pierces the enemy using heat from the Heat Sword on its left arm.

ds3494.name: Glaciate Missile
ds3494.desc: Shoots ice compacted from the snow that gets sucked in by its propeller, generating huge blocks of ice on impact that can be used to stop avalanches.

ds3495.name: Whirlwind Bind
ds3495.desc: Restricts the opponent's movements with a tornado unleashed from the Kikurin.

ds3496.name: Chrysanthemum and Phosphorus Flash: Roaring Lightning Beheading
ds3496.desc: Charges at lightning speed and then bisects the enemy with the Kikurin as it surges with lightning.

ds3497.name: Sword Brilliance Tranquility
ds3497.desc: Cuts down enemies in its surroundings with a single stroke of its sword.

ds3498.name: Breaclaw
ds3498.desc: Accumulates energy in its left hand and unleashes a claw attack.

ds3499.name: Calamity Claws
ds3499.desc: Slices open the enemy's belly with its claws.

ds3500.name: Knock Down
ds3500.desc: Repeatedly swings its two longswords with all its might to pulverize the enemy.

ds3501.name: Wind Fang Intense Whirling Swiftness
ds3501.desc: Unleashes the vacuum blades wrapped around its longswords.

ds3502.name: Great Grudge Destructive Eternal Beheading
ds3502.desc: Converts all of its reason into ferocity and bisects the enemy with its two longswords, slashing them while smashing them to smithereens at the same time.

ds3503.name: Dream Hurricane
ds3503.desc: Jumps high into the sky and kicks while spinning.

ds3504.name: Marble Impact
ds3504.desc: Puts all its strength into its fist and dishes out a seven-colored punch.

ds3505.name: Lovely Shower
ds3505.desc: Punches its fist and fires heart-shaped energy shots at the enemy that have the effect of purifying their evil heart.

ds3506.name: Sand Throw
ds3506.desc: Threatens enemies that approach with a large amount of sand.

ds3507.name: Jive
ds3507.desc: Dishes out a barrage of quick kicks while standing on one leg.

ds3508.name: Ländlizer
ds3508.desc: Spins its body and slashes the enemy with the razor-sharp tips of its ears.

ds3509.name: Breakin' Stream
ds3509.desc: Unleashes a powerful tornado from both of its hands.

ds3510.name: Rhythmic Arts
ds3510.desc: Attacks the enemy with dance kenpō which incorporates capoeira and martial arts.

ds3511.name: Howling Blast
ds3511.desc: Blows the enemy away with a very loud beat emitted from the speaker in its abdomen.

ds3512.name: Upbeat Twister
ds3512.desc: Creates tornadoes and roaring sounds with its skillful footwork.

ds3513.name: Physalist
ds3513.desc: Sends an electric shock stored in its palms through the enemy's vitals.

ds3514.name: Deu: "Punish Beauty"
ds3514.desc: Shocks and punishes the enemy in a stimulating manner with the high-voltage belts that extend from its body.

ds3515.name: Vorsprite
ds3515.desc: Electrifies its body and rams into the enemy while spinning.

ds3516.name: Shock Smasher
ds3516.desc: Sends its fists flying by accumulating electricity in its palms.

ds3517.name: Hammer Thunder
ds3517.desc: Kicks the enemy up and then brings them down with both of its electrically-charged fists.

ds3518.name: Fra: Goodbye World
ds3518.desc: Teleports by removing the space between it and the opponent.

ds3519.name: Dokutease
ds3519.desc: Produces various medicines and injects them via its tentacles. It heals the wounds of its allies and temporarily boosts their power, but as for enemies, it disintegrates them from the inside out with a deadly poison, killing them.

ds3520.name: Whirlpool Spin
ds3520.desc: Rotates its body like a spinning top and performs a ramming attack.

ds3521.name: Liar Dream
ds3521.desc: Hijacks the consciousness of an opponent that meets its gaze.

ds3522.name: Reaper Strike
ds3522.desc: Shoots at the opponent's vitals with the CND-96 rifle on its right arm.

ds3523.name: Desert Deathscythe
ds3523.desc: Tears the enemy to pieces with the scythe attached to the CND-96.

ds3524.name: Wither Wing
ds3524.desc: Shoots out hordes of condors made of sand.

ds3525.name: Sedna
ds3525.desc: Shoots high-powered shells from its two cannons.

ds3528.name: Crimson Spores
ds3528.desc: Expels highly toxic spores from the protrusions on its back.

ds3529.name: Killing Cadence
ds3529.desc: Mows down enemies in one go with its enlarged wheels.

ds3530.name: Shubashuba Potato
ds3530.desc: Sends razor-sharp fries flying having been bashed down from the sky.

ds3531.name: Bashed Potato
ds3531.desc: Bashes its big, flat, piping hot fries down from the sky to crush those who criticize its fries.

ds3533.name: Zone Crackling
ds3533.desc: Sends out a bursting streak of electricity.

ds3534.name: Ear-slap
ds3534.desc: Slaps the opponent with its large ear.

ds3535.name: Digest
ds3535.desc: Swallows the enemy whole via the mouth on its head, and dissolves them.

ds3536.name: Decayson
ds3536.desc: Spews a toxic gas out of its many mouths which causes enemies that inhale it to die instantly.

ds3537.name: Marathi: Uniform Ray
ds3537.desc: Fires unparalleled, orb-shaped light energy from its palms.

ds3538.name: Marathi: Lotus Act
ds3538.desc: Hurls the rings on its arms, which change shape at will, and blows the enemy away.

ds3539.name: Marathi: Composed Devout Meditation
ds3539.desc: A rainbow-colored barrier it covers itself with in its yoga poses that does not let most attacks pass through; it can only be penetrated by those who have acquired strength through the power of yoga, like Shivamon.

ds3540.name: Cannonball Shooter
ds3540.desc: Shoots balls from its cannon at speeds exceeding 300 km/h.

ds3541.name: Wild Pitch
ds3541.desc: Charges into the enemy by utilizing its elastic, spring-like legs.

ds3542.name: Round Jail
ds3542.desc: Turns anything it touches into a ball without wasting its breath. Digimon who suffer this technique are mercilessly shot out of its cannon.

ds3543.name: Oni Instantaneous Roaring Fist
ds3543.desc: Uses its iron fists, shrouded in an ominous aura, to dish out a combo attack too quick for the eye to see.

ds3544.name: Hellfire Destructive Turning Kick
ds3544.desc: Reduces its surroundings to ashes with a roundhouse kick covered in flames.

ds3545.name: Devouring Thunder and Fire Breaker
ds3545.desc: Fires black flaming energy shots from its held-out palms, which boasts the single greatest firepower generated by a Digimon.

ds3546.name: Rock Breath
ds3546.desc: Spits out rocks from its large mouth

ds3547.name: Dark Pales
ds3547.desc: Crushes the enemy with flames of darkness that it amasses in its hands.

ds3548.name: Desdemona
ds3548.desc: Hurls flames of darkness that it amasses in its hands while maintaining their power.

ds3549.name: Dead-end Skewer
ds3549.desc: Pierces the enemy's vitals with the tip of its tail with pinpoint accuracy, killing them.

ds3551.name: Biotoxin
ds3551.desc: Spews a poison gas from the mouth on its abdomen that has the same components as its highly-toxic liquid.

ds3552.name: Grc: Intense Torch
ds3552.desc: Randomly fires beams from its three heads.

ds3553.name: Division Break
ds3553.desc: Causes the vines that it spreads into the ground to shake violently, creating fissures that completely destroy the enemy along with the earth.

ds3554.name: Shock Thunder
ds3554.desc: A paralyzing attack in which it discharges static electricity from the tips of its tentacles.

ds3555.name: Volt Knuckle
ds3555.desc: A punching technique in which it electrifies its fists.

ds3556.name: Spiral Kick
ds3556.desc: Kicks the enemy into the air while performing a somersault.

ds3557.name: Urda Impulse
ds3557.desc: Performs a ramming attack while gliding.

ds3558.name: Lamberta Kick
ds3558.desc: A somersault kick that utilizes the jets from its knees.

ds3559.name: Poison Nail
ds3559.desc: Scratches the enemy with its poison claw gloves.

ds3560.name: Howling Wiper
ds3560.desc: Leans over the opponent with its large body and scrubs them with the shaggy hair on its feet.

ds3561.name: Full-speed Run
ds3561.desc: Blows the opponent away with its violent dashing.
